Especially in real distribution networks, unlike main grids, the number of switches for fault isolation is limited, so it is necessary to study the optimal load restoration strategy that satisfies the operational constraints after distribution system faults while considering outage propagation. In this paper, an optimal load restoration method for distribution systems considering outage propagation is proposed and its effectiveness is verified using the modified IEEE 33-node test distribution system.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization of Base Station Backup Battery Considering Communication Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the penetration rate of renewable energy in the power system grows, the need for the power system to find new flexible resources to maintain its stability increases. At the same time, abundance of base stations (BSs) are constructed along with the rapid development of Information and Communications Technology (ICT). Batteries are installed as back-up power for the BSs but are rarely used in light of the high stability of power grid. In this paper, we proposed a method to use the back-up batteries as demand response resources while ensuring the safe operation of BSs.

articleTitle: Zonotope and Reinforcement Learning-based Aggregator Operation of Energy Community Resources with Water Pump
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Flexible distributed resources within the energy community at the distribution network side have considerable potential for grid-interaction. However, the aggregation and centralized scheduling of these resources confront inevitable challenges in terms of computational complexity and decision-making efficiency. This paper proposes an efficient and computational tractable aggregation and scheduling method for flexible distributed resources based on Zonotope and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) technology. Notably, this study addresses the con-current scheduling dilemma involving large-scale flexible energy devices and numerous small-scale distributed resource clusters, which would capture the characteristics of group intelligent decision-making that evolves as energy status changes. Through typical numerical results with simulation experiments, this work demonstrates and showcases a considerable enhancement in both economic benefits and decision-making efficiency for the aggregator of energy community using the intelligent scheduling framework.

articleTitle: A Fast Safety Assessment and Safety Domain of Combined Electric-Gas-Heat System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Safety assessment is of great significance in the development and promotion of integrated energy system. In order to make the traditional safety assessment can be better applied to large-scale systems, this paper optimizes the safety assessment process from the aspects of the generation of expected fault sets and the solution of multi-energy flow power flow. Implement improvements to the security assessment process.

articleTitle: Dynamic Economic Dispatch of Wind-CHP Coupling System Considering Multiple Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the swift development of clean energy, the efficient utilization and accommodation of clean energy have gained extensive attention around the world. In particular, the interaction between clean energy uncertainty and the power grid uncertainty brings great problems and challenges to the dispatch of modern power grid. In this paper, a dynamic economic dispatch model for a wind-combined heat and power (CHP) coupling multi-energy system considering the fusion of multiple uncertain factors is proposed, aiming to minimize the total cost of energy generation. In order to deal with the multiple uncertain factors with different characteristics, involving wind power, electric load, and heat load, the evidence theory (ET) combined with affine arithmetic is leveraged to convert these uncertainties into a unified Dempster-Shafer structure, thus transforming the original economic dispatch model with multiple uncertain factors into a deterministic optimization problem. Considering the complexity of the established optimization model, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed to obtain the satisfactory solution. At last, the corresponding simulations and comparative analysis are performed on a modified IEEE 30-node wind-CHP coupling test system to validate the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model and applied method.

articleTitle: A Multi-Step Real-Time Simulation Method for Integrated Energy System Based on Multi-Platform Combination
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-step real-time simulation method for integrated energy system based on multi-platform combination, which combines the IES toolbox and RT-LAB platform for real-time simulation. This method can use the highly refined models in the toolbox and multi-step simulation based on RT -LAB platform. In order to realize the real-time simulation across platforms, this paper first uses the toolbox to build the model and carry out the initial value calculation and offline simulation, in which the steady-state model is responsible for providing the initial value of topology and calculation and the dynamic model is responsible for offline simulation. After the offline simulation is successful, the toolbox dynamic model library of the Linux system is generated. Then the model configuration and system kernel separation operation are carried out on the RT-LAB platform. Finally, this paper takes the University of Manchester's integrated energy system as an example to demonstrate the process of model building and real-time simulation. It verifies the real-time simulation capability of this method.

articleTitle: Research on IES Carbon Emission Monitoring and Control System Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The carbon emissions of Integrated energy system (IES) cover all aspects of the energy production, transmission, consumption and storage. The IES carbon emission monitoring and control system (CEMCS) based on digital twin (DT) technology can improve the real-time and accuracy of the system, and is conducive to the overall carbon emission control of IES. Based on DT concept and method, this paper studies the framework and the key methods of CEMCS. The framework was analyzed and constructed from the aspects of source, network, load and storage, and the key methods including the construction of the DT architecture model of carbon capture power plant (CCPP), the data-driven method of direct carbon emission monitoring, the multi-energy carbon flow calculation based carbon emission model (CEF model), and the construction of energy storage carbon emission model. Hoping that this study could provide support for comprehensive carbon emission monitoring and control of IES.

articleTitle: Robust Damping Controller Design in Renewable- integrated Power System Considering Communication Resilience
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of renewable generation like wind power has raised the risk of low-frequency oscillation (LFO). To address this issue, in the study a multi-model, multi-objective robust controller design scheme is proposed to suppress LFO in renewable-integrated power system, in which a wide-area damping controller (WADC) is introduced to mitigate inter-area oscillation (IAO). In this scheme, a bilinear matrix inequality (BMI) optimization model considering H2/H-infinity performance along with pre-defined pole placement is first developed. To consider communication failures, a group of operating conditions corresponding to particular communication channel faults are incorporated into the multi-model system. In addition, an improved two-stage LMI algorithm is proposed to solve the BMI model. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is validated using a modified four-machine, two-area system with a DFIG wind farm.

articleTitle: Power Entity Alignment Active Learning Framework Based on Semantic and Structure Sampling Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Entity alignment (EA), which aims to match equivalent entities in different knowledge graphs, is essential in knowledge fusion. The current mainstream method is the neural network EA model, which relies on seed alignment training data and has a very high labeling cost. In this paper, we designed an active learning framework for a neural network EA model based on semantic and structure-aware sampling strategy. The framework aims to create highly informative data to produce more efficient EA models with lower labeling costs. Our framework addresses the main challenge of applying active learning techniques to EA models: how to leverage dependencies between entities and semantic information about the entities themselves in an active learning strategy. Most active learning strategies assume that the data instances to be sampled are independent and uniformly distributed. However, the entities in the knowledge graph are related. To solve this problem, we compare the effects of four sampling strategies on three EA models on power standard datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed semantic and structure-aware active learning sampling strategy reduces the labeling amount by 10%-20% compared with other strategies and dramatically reduces the labeling cost.

articleTitle: Stochastic Scenario Analysis of Photovoltaic Acceptance Capacity Considering Overvoltage Risk
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase of photovoltaic penetration rate in power system, the research on photovoltaic acceptance capacity of distribution network has attracted more and more attention, and scientific and reasonable evaluation technology of photovoltaic acceptance capacity can effectively guide the planning and construction of photovoltaic. This research presents an assessment technique of the solar acceptance capacity of distribution network taking overvoltage risk into consideration in order to address the issues of restricted analysis scenarios of mathematical optimization methods and conservative evaluation of random scenario simulation methods. First, a brief description of the impact of distributed photovoltaic access on the distribution network is provided, along with the safe operating restrictions for photovoltaic grid connection. Then, based on the random scene generating technique of photovoltaic acceptance capacity, the idea of overvoltage danger is proposed, and the calculation method of photovoltaic acceptance capacity considering overvoltage risk is given. Finally, taking IEEE33 node as an example, the validity of the model is verified. The outcomes of the simulation demonstrate the effectiveness of the suggested technique in estimating the overvoltage risk of the distribution network brought on by the ambiguity of the photovoltaic configuration mode and providing an appropriate photovoltaic configuration scheme.

articleTitle: Assessment of Emergency Control Strategy and Aided Decision Scheme for AC/DC Hybrid Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of AC/DC hybrid power systems, emergency control strategy has become an important measure to ensure the safe and stable operation of trans-region power grids. Due to the changeable operation environment of the system, the effectiveness of the emergency control strategy should be evaluated according to the real-time operation status of the power grid and the contingencies. The online tracking and integration of the adjustable resources of security control are realized by studying multi-type data extraction and association matching methods. An assessment of emergency control strategy by setting up logic assessment and index assessment. Based on the assessment results, the coordination schemes of load shedding, multi-DC emergency control, switching the pump, and other control resources are proposed, which can provide aided decision schemes for power grid dis-patching. Finally, a provincial power grid model is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the assessment of emergency control strategy and aided decision scheme under HVDC blocking fault.

articleTitle: Data Driven Electricity Theft Detection Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity theft is the main cause of non-technical loss of the power network, and it is a long-term problem faced by distribution network operators. The electricity consumption information acquisition system collects a large amount of data from electricity users, which makes it possible to carry out data driven detection of abnormal electricity consumption and identify users with electricity theft behaviors accurately. Thus, this paper presents a data-driven method to perform electricity theft detection, which combines deep learning with federated learning effectively. It is capable to not only detect electricity theft precisely, but also achieve secure data sharing among distribution network operators. The proposed method is verified on an actual Irish open-access dataset, and the results of the case studies show that it can obtain a comparatively higher detection accuracy, meanwhile ensuring data privacy of different distribution network operators.

articleTitle: Research on Static Voltage Stability Index of Regional Power Network with New Energy Stations Based on Voltage Stability Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of new energy, the problem of static voltage stability of power grid has become increasingly prominent, and there is an urgent need for a static voltage stability analysis method to simultaneously evaluate the new energy stations and load buses in a region. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a static voltage stability index based on the voltage stability criterion, which is used to judge the voltage stability of new energy station buses and load buses in the regional network. Firstly, based on the Thevenin equivalence method, the power network with a high proportion of new energy is equivalent to a single machine single load system; Secondly, the analytical static voltage stability index is derived based on the voltage stability criterion; Then the mechanism of this index is compared with L index from the analytical formula, and the reasons for the error of L index in the case of heavy load and large new energy generation are described; Finally, the validity and accuracy of the proposed index in judging the static voltage stability of new energy stations and load buses are verified based on the modified IEEE 3-unit 9-bus example with new energy stations.

articleTitle: Risk-Cost Integrated Assessment Based Overhaul Strategies for Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reliable operation of transformers is of significant importance to the entire power system concerned. Therefore, it is necessary to reduce the failure rate of transformers through timely overhaul. Given this background, the optimal overhaul planning problem for transformers is addressed in this work based on risk-cost integrated assessment. First, a linear aging regression model is established employing the Weibull distribution based failure rate model of transformers. The investment and operation costs of transformers are next classified and calculated according to the theory of Life Cycle Cost (LCC). Subsequently, from the perspective of managing risk, the optimal overhaul time under different overhaul frequencies is formulated as an optimization problem and solved by the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, and economic analysis based on the annual average LCC is carried out. Finally, a case study is conducted to demonstrate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Operation and Planning for Wind Farms Verified by Second-order Cone Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage is widely used in power system with a high proportion of renewable energy due to its high flexibility. In order to solve the challenges brought by the non-convexity of AC power flow to the operation and planning of energy storage, second-order cone programming is widely used. Firstly, this paper summarizes the research on the operation and planning problem, and second-order cone programming. Next, the mathematical model of second-order cone programming is introduced. Then, the basic operation model of energy storage is described, and its convex relaxation is performed by second-order cone programming (SOCP). Finally, the energy storage operation planning model is proposed.

articleTitle: An Accelerated Algorithm for Estimating Wake Interactions Between Wind Turbines with FLORIDyn
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Estimating the wake effect between wind turbines necessitates finding a delicate balance between accuracy and efficiency, a task that is often challenging due to the need to compute the radial distribution of wakes while also accounting for the effects of turbulence intensity and height differences. In this paper, an accelerated algorithm that utilizes the Gaussian Floridyn model is designed to estimate the wake effects between wind turbines. To achieve efficiency without affecting accuracy, the proposed algorithm reduces the search region of observation points and modify the FLORIDyn workflow to obtain wake influences among wind turbines while omitting irrelevant momentary emulation of massive observation points. Numerical tests are conducted on both a standard three-turbine case and a practical onshore wind farm to validate the correctness and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Stray Inductance on the Breaking Performance of DC Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the capacity of DC transmission and distribution systems, the parallel design of internal components in DC circuit breakers has become the conventional solution to address the requirements of high current flow and circuit interruption. To analyze the impact of loop stray inductance on the parallel breaking performance of DC circuit breakers, the effects of loop stray inductance on the parallel breaking performance of the main current branch and power electronic branch of the DC circuit breaker are studied in this paper based on a coupled negative-voltage hybrid DC circuit breaker, and verified through breaking tests. Finally, this thesis introduces the specific application of the research results in two typical flexible DC transmission and distribution projects, providing a reference for the design and engineering application of high-capacity parallel interruption DC circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Scenario Generation of PV Power Based on DDPM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with increasing penetration of renewable energy sources, such as photovoltaics, it is important to model the uncertainty of PV power output. Scenario generation is a major method to solve the problem. This paper proposes a novel model based on data driven method for PV scenario generation based on denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPM). The method combines the Euclidean distance and L2 regularization loss function as a measure of the distribution difference between the generated noise and the original noise, and designs a UNet network structure suitable for photovoltaic scenario generation. In order to capture the fluctuation characteristic and achieve the efficient generation, it continuously adds noise to the forward process and constantly denoises to the reverse process. Compared with existing data driven method, such as generative adversarial networks (GAN) and variational autoencoder (VAE), the simulation results demonstrate that, the proposed model can generate PV power scenarios effectively.

articleTitle: A Two-Layer Optimization Model for Two-Part Transmission Pricing for Special Projects Based on Multi-Scenario Operation Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the accelerated construction of new power systems under the “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” goals, the proportion of clean energy in the system is increasing and diversifying. To promote the development of renewable energy and guarantee its power consumption, it is necessary to accelerate the construction of special cross-provincial and cross-regional transmission projects for renewable energy and establish a cross-regional transmission pricing model applicable to the new power system, so as to provide space for the sustainable development of renewable energy. Compared with the traditional single-part electricity transmission price, the existence of a capacity price in the two-part transmission price will result in a lower quantity price converted to single-part electricity transmission price. For users, the more power they purchase, the lower the unit price per kWh, which inevitably promotes full utilization of the grid by users, thus increasing the utilization rate of the grid. In this article, firstly, it considers the aim at the minimum cost of system power generation and has established a multi -scenario operation simulation model to determine the actual transmission volume of cross -regional special transmission projects. Secondly, combined with the actual transmission volume, a two-part transmission price pricing model for cross-region special transmission projects is constructed based on the operating period method. Finally, taking the Gobi and Desert Areas of China as an example, it analyzes the advantages of two parts of power transmission prices compared to single power production and electricity prices, and verify the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Day-Ahead and Intra-Day Peak Shaving Strategy Considering Flexible Loads Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing integration of renewable energy sources into the electrical grid has led to a growing challenge in managing peak load fluctuations. There is a rising demand for intra-day peak shaving. The advancement of energy management systems has enabled load resources to become dispatchable, which introduces flexibility to the system. In this paper, we propose a two-stage day-ahead and intra-day peak shaving strategy considering direct control loads resources like translatable load, interruptible load, shiftable load and load demand response. By incorporating the scheduling of these DLCs, the peak regulation demand can be effectively reduced, leading to a decrease in operational costs. Finally, the proposed model is verified in a modified IEEE 30-node system.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Game Scheduling Method for Distributed Shared Energy Storage in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low utilization efficiency and unclear transaction mechanism of distributed energy storage in active distribution network (ADN), this paper proposes unified management of shared energy storage operators (SESO), taking into account SESO benefits and ADN benefits, and establishes SESO and ADN multi-objective optimization model of Stackelberg game. First, the Stackelberg gam framework of SESO and ADN is introduced, and then a mathematical model is established in which the leader SESO has the greatest economic benefits and the follower ADN has the smallest operating cost and carbon emissions. It is solved using the particle swarm algorithm and verified and analyzed through the IEEE33 node power distribution system. The results show that compared with the independent operation mode, the distributed energy storage shared operation mode of the proposed strategy has improved energy storage utilization efficiency, improved economic benefits, and reduced ADN operating costs and carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Grid-Supporting Control Strategies of MMC-HVDC Links Connected to Extremely Weak AC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more renewable power is integrated into the power grid through HVDC systems, the situation where multiple HVDC links supply power to an extremely weak AC system has become a common sight in future power grids. This paper first introduced the power-synchronization control method and the current vector control method for a modular multilevel converter (MMC). Based on the different control method of a MMC, two control strategies for the multi-MMC-HVDC system are proposed, including the peer-to-peer control strategy and the master-slave control strategy. For the peer-to-peer control strategy, all of the MMC-HVDC converters use the power-synchronization control method. And for the master-slave control strategy, the master converter uses the power-synchronization control method and the salve converters adopt current vector control method. The advantages, disadvantages, as well as application scope of these two proposed control strategies are discussed through theoretical analysis and PSCAD/EMTDC simulation verification in this paper.

articleTitle: ANovel SCUC Model Considering Area Control Errors and Resulting Penalties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional Security Constrained Unit Com-mitment (SCUC) model focuses on minimizing the total cost of electricity generation while ensuring system security and reliability. However, this model does not consider the possibility that Independent System Operators (ISOs) can intentionally allow for area control errors (ACE) to reduce energy purchase costs. This article incorporates ACE and its associated penalties into the SCUC model. Given specific penalty prices, the model can reflect the impact of considering ACE on an ISOs' power pur-chasing decisions. Experimental results show that when penalty prices are relatively low, ISOs are more profitable by generating ACE and paying penalties than by purchasing electricity from other ISOs or purchasing demand response from flexible loads. Therefore a high-enough penalty price is necessary to ensure system reliability.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement of Distribution Power Network Through Defect Location of XLPE Cables Based on BIS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) distribution cables are widely used in distribution power networks, and their insulation performance affects power supply reliability directly. Broadband impedance spectroscopy (BIS) has been proved to be an effective technique for detecting cable insulation defects, however, the longer aging segments and shorter defects coexisted in XLPE distribution cables in operation could not be distinguished effectively based on existing research, imposing large restrictions on the status diagnosis and evaluation for cables. This paper was just devoted to solve the above technical problem. A novel localization method for aging segments and short defects in XLPE distribution cables was proposed through simulation research based on BIS and the integral transform technique. And the curve features for defect identification could be summarized and obtained. Finally the validity of the localization technique proposed was further confirmed through experiments. The research results of this paper are of great significance for the resilience enhancement of distribution power network.

Author Keywords: resilience enhancement of distribution power network

articleTitle: Incentivizing EVs to Participate in Peak-Shaving Markets: A Prospect Theoretical Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the number of electric vehicles continues to grow, plenty of charging stations have enlarged to the size capable of participating in the electricity market. However, it is challenging to calculate the station's demand regulation cost and regulation capacity since the charging station does not directly control the EVs. In this paper, we propose a prospect theoretical approach to encourage EVs to participate in the peak-shaving market by reducing their charging amount and getting the compensation payment from the station. Specifically, we model the EV optimal compensation amount by prospect theory. Then, we propose an optimization method to calculate the station's minimum regulation amount. Numerical experiments are conducted using real-life data in Shenzhen, China, to calculate the regulation amount-cost relationship of charging stations. Simulations illustrate that the regulation cost increases with the regulation amount and varies with different EV individuals.

articleTitle: Analysis of Body Grid Aggregation and Sharing Via an Umbrella: A Case Study of Shenzhen Metro Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To enhance individual carbon reduction, the concept of body grid and its cluster were proposed. However, the operation mechanism and potential of the body grid cluster remain unclear due to the lack of a standardized framework and appropriate application scenario. Thus, we draw on the electric vehicle (EV) and vehicle-to-grid (V2G) studies while considering the unique properties of the body grid We present a portable body grid that uses an umbrella as the carrier and its aggregation framework. Based on the sharing business model and a specific energy management strategy (EMS), the aggregator can provide solar power and leverage batteries to support power balance and satisfy the rental demand through a DC microgrid. Moreover, the aggregator can control the charging and discharging proportion to ensure state-of-charge (SOC) balancing. Based on the simulation in the Shenzhen metro station, we find that the aggregator can save at least 1.75% per day in electricity cost. With a low rental fee, the payback time of the investment is only 2.34 years, which illustrates the high energy and economic performance of portable body grid aggregation.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation of Integrated Energy Systems Considering Tradable Green Certificate and Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to cope with the challenges of green transition of the power system, and to reach carbon neutrality and emission peak goal, enhancing the integration of renewable energy and the diversified application of hydrogen energy is essential. In this context, this paper introduces an optimal operation model of an integrated energy system that incorporates tradable green certificate and carbon trading mechanisms. Firstly, taking into account the actual carbon emissions of coal- fired generating unit and gas-fired generating units, and analyzing the plenty of green certificates that can be certified based on the output of wind power units, a green certificate and carbon trading mechanism that suits integrated energy systems is built. Secondly, by summing up the costs of energy purchases, carbon trading, and green certificate transactions, and operation and maintenance cost as the objective function, and taking into account constraints such as wind power output, unit limitations, energy balance, equipment energy conversion and storage device restrictions, a low-carbon optimization scheduling model of the integrated energy system is established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through three typical scenarios (only considering tradable green certificates, only considering the carbon market, and considering both tradable green certificates and the carbon market).

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Synchronous Condensers in Renewable Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Optimal allocation of synchronous condensers is one of the most-commonly-used ways to improve the operation performance of renewable power generators in weak grid. However, except for optimality, equity of the allocation should also be taken seriously to ensure the acceptability of the scheme. To do so, in this paper, an optimization model for the allocation of synchronous condensers considering equity is established at first. By inducing a penalty term which measures equity of the allocation, scheme with the lowest investment and the best equity can be selected. Besides, the main constraint is to ensure that short circuit ratios seen by the renewable power generators are no less than the required level. Second, since the optimal allocation of synchronous condensers is a problem of non-linear integer programming, an improved genetic algorithm is utilized for the solution of the optimization. Finally, effectiveness of the optimization model proposed is validated via study cases. The results indicate that the method proposed can ensure equity of the allocation scheme while maintaining the lowest cost.

articleTitle: Evaluation Strategy for the Complementary Characteristics of Renewable Generation at Sending and Load Demand at Receiving Ends
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind and photovoltaic power generation exhibit complementary characteristics on a spatiotemporal scale. Additionally, a degree of synchronization exists between renewable generation and load demand on a spatiotemporal scale. To assess the complementary features of the renewable power generation at sending end and the load demands at receiving end, this article primarily establishes two evaluation metrics including the temporal similarity coefficient (a) and fluctuation consistency coefficient (P). Finally, in the case study the complementary characteristics between renewable power generation and load demands are analyzed by a combined photovoltaic and wind power generation system on typical days.

articleTitle: Turn-off Control Method of the Hybrid Commutated Converter Based on Fault Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous construction of “Desert-Gobi Desert-Wasteland” new energy bases in northwest China, energy cross-regional transportation technology has become increasingly critical. Despite the fact that the transmission technology of line commuted converter high voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) plays a crucial role depending on long-distance, large-capacity, and low-loss transmission advantages, its inherent commutation failure (CF) remains to be solved urgently. Nevertheless, Tsinghua University has proposed the technology of hybrid commutated converter (HCC) based on the reverse blocking integrated gate commutated thyristor (RB-IGCT), which can completely solve this problem. In terms of the HCC, this paper proposes an active turn-off control method based on fault prediction. First, the fault prediction means used in the turn-off control method and its principle of resisting commutation failure are introduced; next, it is transformed on the basis of the original LCC control system to enable it to be the control system applicable to HCCs; last, based on the modified model, fault simulation is carried out, and the effect of resisting commutation failure is obtained through the turn-off control method of the HCC based on fault prediction.

articleTitle: Fault Characterization and Optimal Control of Crowbar Circuits for Doubly-Fed Induction Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the unit will lose controllability after the Crowbar of Doubly-fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is put into operation. Firstly, based on the vector equation of doubly-fed motor, the circuit response of its steady state and fault transient is derived, and the stator and rotor current expressions are obtained. An improved circuit that adds series protective resistors to the Crowbar branch near the converter side is proposed with the aim of making the impedance of the converter branch on the rotor side controllable as a means of limiting the inrush current flowing through it. The values of the Crowbar resistor and the protective resistor resistance are adjusted using the simulation induction method. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed protection strategy is verified by PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Visualization of Extreme Source-Load Scenarios for High Percentage of Renewable Energy Based on Improved Energy Distance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Supply-demand balance is one of the most important issues in power system development and operation, and it is also the most basic issue in system operation. The grid integration of high percentage of renewable generation energy enhances the uncertainty of power system and deepens the complexity of the supply-demand relationship between source and load sides. Therefore, in the development of new power systems, it is important to measure the degree of compatibility of the source-load scenario and identify the extreme supply-demand relationship. The identification of extreme scenarios currently lacks a method developed from the source-load matching degree perspective. In this paper, we propose a method to calculate the source-load scenario distance considering time-of-use tariff and various evaluable indicators such as net load creep rate, which can effectively identify the extreme scenarios.

articleTitle: Online Condition Monitoring Methods of Inverter IGBT Based on Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Online condition monitoring for insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs) of inverter is important part for the prognostic and health management (PHM) of DC power distribution system. Based on the aging mechanism of IGBT, the influence of IGBT characteristic parameter variation on output voltage is studied, and two non-invasive IGBT condition monitoring methods based on output voltage is proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A New Energy Consumption Capacity Improvement Method Based on Layout Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power grid is the key to enhancing the consumption of clean energy. Faced with the goal of sustained growth in new energy, whether the carrying capacity of the power grid can meet the requirements, and how to improve the new energy consumption capacity have become key issues currently faced. In order to fully tap into the distributed new energy consumption capacity of the power grid, this paper proposes a new energy consumption improvement method based on layout optimization. Firstly, taking photovoltaic consumption capacity as the optimization variable, genetic algorithm is used to calculate the maximum photovoltaic consumption capacity of the power grid. Then, a new energy consumption capacity improvement method based on layout optimization is proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed method for improving the new energy consumption capacity can effectively enhance the new energy consumption capacity of the power grid while ensuring the security constraints of the power grid.

articleTitle: Single Current Sensor Based Flexible Power Point Tracking Algorithm of PV Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Flexible power point tracking (FPPT) algorithms are proposed to make the PV inverter more friendly to the grid. However, the existing FPPT algorithm is realized based on both voltage and current sensors on the PV side. On the one hand, the cost is added by adopting both current and voltage sensors at the same time. On the other hand, the calculation burden is increased by calculating the PV power. Single-sensor-based MPPT algorithms have been proposed a lot in the past year, where the power of the PV is only calculated by PV current or voltage. Because the output voltage of the boost converter can be regarded as a constant in the two-stage PV inverter. It gives the opportunity to realize the single current sensor-based FPPT algorithm. So, in this paper, a single sensor-based FPPT algorithm with the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) operation and constant power generation (CPG) operation is proposed. As a result, the proposed algorithm shows advantages as high tracking performance and low hardware cost. The experimental results show the advantages of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Modeling Method for Clearing the Intra-Provincial Electricity Spot Market Considering Inter-Provincial Spot Market Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the new round of power system reform, the construction of China's power market has been steadily advancing. At present, a two-level spot market system has been preliminarily established for the coordinated operation of the inter provincial spot market and the intra provincial spot market. There is a coupling relationship between the inter provincial spot market and the provincial spot market, and the market entity bidding results of the inter provincial spot market will to some extent affect the trading volume and price of the intra provincial spot market. Improper connection of inter provincial spot clearance results, which may lead to an increase in the price of the intra provincial electricity spot market. This paper introduces the clearing mechanisms of inter provincial spot markets and intra provincial spot markets, and analyzes the connection methods of two-level spot market. Then an optimized clearance model was proposed. The case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the clearance model.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Platform Operation Mode Based on Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: We study the problem of choosing the operation mode of the new energy platform between the grid company and the users based on the evolutionary game theory. We first obtain the benefit matrix by analyzing the benefits obtained when the grid company and the users choose different operation modes, and based on which we find the evolutionary stable equilibrium point of the grid company and the users, and finally derive the stable results of the system evolution according to the evolutionary stable equilibrium point. The results show that the cooperative strategy is the optimal choice for users regardless of which operation mode is chosen by the grid company. Different value ranges of the user's resource input ratio will make the system converge to different evolutionary stabilization strategies, and the grid company can choose different operation modes by adjusting the unit selling price of the product and the resource input ratio of the grid company. This provides a reference for the decision-making of the grid and the users.

articleTitle: Assessing Interconnected Factors in CO2 Emissions: A Case Study of India Using Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid increase in global carbon dioxide (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) emissions due to human activities has raised concerns about its impact on climate change. This paper focuses on understanding the interrelationships among various variables related to CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions in India, with a specific focus on different fossil fuels. The study utilizes Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to examine the complex web of factors contributing to CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions. The dataset, obtained from Our World Data, comprises ten key indicators, including population, GDP, and various emissions categories. Through PCA, the paper reveals that the first two principal components explain more than 98% of the cumulative variance, indicating strong interdependence among the variables. The analysis sheds light on the factors influencing CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions and provides insights for future research and the development of predictive models. This study sets the stage for further investigations into greenhouse gases and climate change relationships and the development of machine learning models for emission prediction.

articleTitle: Inertia Evaluation of Power Systems with High Proportion of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more conventional power sources are replaced by non-synchronous power sources, the inertia level of the power system continues to decrease, which weakens the inertia support and frequency adjustment ability of the system under active power shock, and stable operation is faced with severe challenges. Inertia evaluation has become a hot research issue at present, and many research institutions have made relevant research progress. Starting from the definition of inertia, this paper first clarified the composition of inertia, then systematically sorted out the method of system inertia assessment under the introduction of high proportion of new energy in two aspects.

articleTitle: An Approach for Extracting Key Weather Processes Affecting Power Supply Driven by Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the installed capacity of renewable energy sources, the security and stability of power systems are profoundly influenced by adverse weather conditions. To enhance power supply assurance, the accurate identification and analysis of weather processes are imperative. Time-series production simulation (TPS) is a commonly employed method to facilitate the integration of renewable energy sources. This paper introduces production simulation methods into the study of meteorological impacts on the power system to extract key weather processes affecting power supply assurance. Through time-series production simulation, the impact of various weather conditions on the power system can be accurately assessed, obtaining key weather processes. Based on meteorological and load data from the provincial power grid, key weather processes are extracted, validating the method's efficacy.

articleTitle: Robust Control Method for LCL-Type Grid-Connected Inverters Based on Adaptive Correction of Grid Voltage Feedforward Considering Digital Control Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The coupling effect between the grid voltage feedforward and the current loop under weak grid reduces the stability margin of the grid-connected inverter. Meanwhile, the risk of instability will be further increased in the case of the grid voltage feedforward parameters are not designed properly. To solve the problem, this article analyzes the stability of the grid-connected inverter under different grid impedances with grid voltage full feedforward control strategy. Second, to improve the stability of the grid-connected inverter in a wide range of grid impedance variations, this articles first proposes a grid voltage feedforward parameter design method with the phase margin as the index. Then, to further suppress the influence of digital control delay, different algorithms are introduced based on the grid voltage feedforward parameters to obtain an adaptive robust control strategy. Finally, it is verified that the proposed control strategy based on adaptively corrected grid voltage feedforward LCL type considering the delay link can improve the adaptability of the grid-connected inverter under the weak grid.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Hybrid Wind Farms Considering Wake Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wake effect has different impacts on the grid connection stability of different types of wind farms. It is necessary to clarify the impact of wake effect on the stable wind speed range of hybrid wind farm grid connected system (HWF-GCS) with series compensation lines. Firstly, the two-variable admittance model of HWF considering the structure of the collector line was established, and the wind speed range of the system was analyzed under two conditions: ideal wind speed and consideration of wake effect, using the amplitude phase contours plot criterion. The results indicate that the presence of wake effects can reduce the stability of HWF-GCS, which can provide reference for the layout and design of actual hybrid wind farms. Simulation plat based on Matlab/Simulink is built to verify the correctness of the model and analysis results.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Low-Carbon Optimal Strategy in Industrial Park Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To unleash full potential of load-side dispatching in park-level integrated energy system and make rational use of demand response resources, promotion of economic, low-carbon and efficient operation in the automobile industrial park is the research objective in this paper. Against this background, we put forward a methodology for conducting day-ahead optimization of an integrated energy system, taking cost associated with carbon transactions into account. Firstly, operation characteristics of all kinds of equipment and the multi-energy flow coupling relationship are analyzed. Then, In alignment with the aim of reducing overall expenditures, optimal operation model is established under operation constraints of all kinds of equipment, which includes the ladder carbon transaction cost calculation model, resulting in optimizing the energy consumption and conversion of the system. Finally, an example based on an actual automobile industry park shows that this methodology can ensure scheduling economy of system, and also mitigate its carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Capturing Demand Response Dynamics in Market Equilibrium Using Mean-Field Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand response (DR) is one of the most crucial means to address peak-shaving and valley-filling pressures from renewable energy. Considering the increasement of DR participants and the assessment error from the neglection of demand-side price-perception process, the market regulator needs a more efficient and accurate model to examine the market equilibrium. Thus, the paper proposes a Mean-Field Game (MFG)- and Neutral Network (NN)-based bi-level framework. In the upper level, numerous DR participant's interactive gaming can be depicted by the MFG, where they all response to the uniform time-varying prices by load shifting. In the lower level, the real electricity clearing model is used as an engine providing training data, by which a chained deep NN is trained to simulate DR participants price prediction actions. Case studies based on a modified IEEE 118-bus and 200 DR participants are conducted, and the results validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the propose model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Scheduling of Wind-Solar-Hydro-Battery Complementary System Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of wind and solar power, with their randomness and uncertainty, reduces system stability. Optimizing schedules of complementary systems can help promote the accommodation of wind and solar power. However, it is challenging to formulate appropriate schedules for the multi-energy complementary systems under the uncertainty of wind and solar power. In this paper, an intelligent scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning for wind-solar-hydro-battery complementary system is proposed. Firstly, A mathematical model for the scheduling problem of wind-solar-hydro-battery complementary system is established. Then, the scheduling problem is formulated as a Markov decision process (MDP), and intelligent scheduling decisions are implemented based on the twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation examples. The simulation results show that the proposed method can adapt to changes of wind and solar uncertainty, improve the power generation of multi-energy complementary systems and alleviate the peak load regulation pressure of the receiving-end power grid.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Inertia Requirements Considering Fast Frequency Response and Spinning Reserve in Primary Frequency Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: New energy is connected to the power grid and replaces some synchronous machines, making rotational inertia a scarce commodity. Therefore, accurately assessing the minimum inertia demand of the system is particularly important. This article starts with the frequency response process of the power system and solves the inertia demand of the system under the constraints of frequency change rate and frequency deviation. The inertia demand of the system base on frequency deviation constraints considers the effects of fast frequency response (FFR) and primary frequency modulation rotation backup, and uses the System Frequency Response (SFR) model to characterize the frequency response of the system inertia center. It can accurately estimate the inertia demand of the system. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the propose method is verified by constructing an improved WSCC 3-machine 9-node system using PSCAD.

articleTitle: Effects of Positive-Negative Sequence Separation Method on the Impedance Characteristics of HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The voltage source converter based high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) technology, which utilizes the modular multilevel converter (MMC), is a crucial solution for facilitating large-scale renewable energy integration. The issue of harmonic oscillations between renewable energy and VSC-HVDC has gained significant attention in recent years, and the impedance-based method being an effective tool for analyzing such problems. The control of MMC involves positive and negative sequence inner loop control, with the positive and negative sequence separation (PNSS) method forming the basis of this control. This study aims to establish a generic impedance model of MMC AC- and DC-side, considering three PNSS methods: time delay-based method, notch filter-based method, and decoupled double synchronous reference frame-phased locked loop (DDSRF-PLL) method. The accuracy of the impedance model is verified through PSCAD/EMTDC simulation frequency scan, and the impact of different PNSS on MMC AC/DC-side impedance is revealed. The finding is significant in analyzing renewable energy DC access systems.

articleTitle: An Optimization and Dispatching Method of Shared Energy Storage Based on the Operation Risk of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The output of distributed power supply (DG) is volatile. A certain ratio of energy storage devices can smooth the output of DG, and tap the potential of DG stable power supply to the distribution network load. The scheduling of shared energy storage (SESS) based on power supply reliability is an important topic in the study of SESS operation. With the increasing operation risk of distribution network, the operation mode of SESS analyzed only from the perspective of operation cost is no longer accurate. Therefore, this paper proposes a shared energy storage optimization scheduling method that considers the operating risks of distribution network. Its characteristics are as follows: The optimal scheduling model of shared energy storage device is established considering both the operating economy and potential operating risks of distribution network. While taking into account the effect of island division, the rapid assessment of distribution network risk is realized. Finally, the optimal scheduling scheme of shared energy storage with the lowest comprehensive cost of economy and risk is obtained based on genetic algorithm, and an example analysis is conducted on the improved PG&E 69-node distribution grid, which verifies effectiveness of the optimization and dispatching method.

articleTitle: Failure Protection Method for 500kV Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Direct current circuit breaker (DCCB) is a key device for fast fault clearing in modular multilevel converter (MMC)-based DC grids, but its complex structure and numerous components may lead to internal component failures. The topology and operating principles of the hybrid DC circuit breaker are analyzed to reveal the external characteristics of breaker under different component failures. A hybrid DCCB failure protection method including DCCB failure protection algorithm and DCCB failure protection criterion is proposed, and the operation status of DCCB is classified as normal operation, partial failure and complete failure according to the number of failure sub-modules. The failure protection method is validated by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation, and the results show that the method has excellent effectiveness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Aggregate Load Prediction Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, the electricity demand also continues to grow. Demand-side energy can effectively improve the elasticity and stability margin of the power system, and controllable aggregated loads become dispatchable resources, which are of great significance for participating in grid stability regulation. Therefore, the importance of forecasting aggregated loads is increasing. Since demand-side response can guide the customer's electricity consumption behavior through tariffs, which in turn improves the reliability of the power system. Therefore, the user load is clustered and analyzed according to the demand side response, and then feature extraction is performed through deep learning to achieve accurate prediction of aggregated loads. Aggregating flexible loads and adding virtual power plants (VPPs) to participate in power market transactions after load aggregation can not only improve the economic efficiency of the user side, but also realize the “peak shaving and valley filling” of the power grid, assist in the construction of the power market, and turn the aggregated loads into potential new energy sources.

articleTitle: Optimal Joint Operation between Wind Power Plants and Pumped Storage Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Chinais in a critical period of energy sector low-carbon transformation, with renewable energy based generation such as wind generation as the representative of this transformation, the demand for regulating capability is increasing. Pumped storage power stations are good regulating sources, and can effectively alleviate anti-peaking and volatility of wind power outputs. This paper studies the different scheduling principles of wind power and wind power-pumped storage combination, establishes the benefit evaluation model of WP-PHS (Wind Power-Pumped Hydro Storage), analyzes the static benefit of the joint operation system and the carbon emission reduction benefit, and takes the example of the wind power-pumped storage joint operation system in a certain region, and analyzes the system's output power in the case of different electricity prices. The results show that this energy conversion model can not only bring benefits to wind power, but also save wind abandonment, effectively smooth the fluctuation of wind power output power, reduce the demand of wind power for system backup capacity, and improve the economic efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: The Commonality of Economic Dispatch Models Based on Scenario/Interval
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, how to maximize the acceptance of renewable energy on the basis of satisfying the economy security and reliability of the power system is an urgent problem to be solved. In this area, mathematical optimization methods such as robust optimization and stochastic optimization are generally used to construct models based on different uncertainty descriptions. Previous studies have shown that robust optimization has high computational efficiency but conservative results, while stochastic optimization has low computational efficiency but accurate results. Therefore, different studies will choose suitable methods based on the characteristics of the models to be constructed. However, existing studies have not thoroughly discussed whether there is a connection between the two methods. This paper first proposes an economic dispatch model based on scenario considering the admissible region of net load, and introduces a new affine strategy to transform this model into a deterministic form. Secondly, based on further exploration of the characteristics of economic dispatch models based on scenario/interval, the paper concludes that the two models are common when they are sufficiently precise. Finally, the correctness of the conclusion is verified on the IEEE-RTS system.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Comprehensive Energy System Participating in the Electricity Carbon Market Based on Multi Agent - Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the background of the electricity carbon collaborative market, this article constructs a mixed game model, aiming to reduce the operating costs of the comprehensive energy system while improving the consumption of renewable energy; Taking into account both carbon emission reduction and marginal contribution of economic benefits, an improved Shapley value method is proposed to incentivize entities to participate in the collaborative optimization of the comprehensive energy system while pursuing economic benefits.

articleTitle: Risk Map of Rainstorm Induced Outage of Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Extreme rainfall is one of the major adverse climate event that could result in extensive outage of distribution system. There is defect in the code to defend against extremes of rainfall in power utilities. Since distribution terminals (including distribution transformer and etc.) serve users in limited ranges and many of them locate in low-lying areas around the users, numerous distribution terminals fall outage due to extreme rainfall induced flooding. Flood risk of Nanning with extreme rainfall is analyzed with 2-dimensional hydrodynamic FloodArea model. The extreme rainfall of 10-year recurrence interval is estimated with generalized extreme value. Thereafter, geographic information and time series of rainfall are fed to 2-dimensional hydrodynamic model to implement numerical simulation. The range and depth of inundation map are generated for various extreme rainfalls. Moreover, the flood risk map of distribution terminals could be generated based on the inundation map. Simulation results show that the proposed approach could demonstrate risk map of rainfall induced inundation and outage risk map of distribution terminals, which could help harden distribution system against extreme rainfall.

articleTitle: Review on Carbon Measurement Techniques and Carbon Certification Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reducing carbon emissions is of great significance for mitigating climate change, protecting the environment and promoting sustainable development, and how to scientifically calculate carbon emissions and certify carbon emission reduction activities has become an important part of carbon reduction activities. Currently, there is a varying degree of development in carbon measurement technology internationally, with multiple coexisting carbon certification systems. However, China is still immature in the development of carbon measurement technology and carbon certification system. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the current status of carbon measurement technology and certification systems. It meticulously examines the applicable scenarios, standards, advantages, and disadvantages of various carbon measurement technologies worldwide. Additionally, it explores the policy foundation, certification bodies, and certification standards within the carbon certification system. Then, we analyze the difficulties and challenges of China's carbon measurement technology and carbon certification system, and puts forward targeted policy recommendations which is expected to provide theoretical references.

articleTitle: A Novel Generation Expansion Planning Method Considering Energy Storage Demand Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale integration of renewable energy sources (RES) has chanllenged the flexible operation of power systems. Considering the expansion of flexible resources in the power planning process is an important part of the rational allocation of flexible resources. As a kind of emerging flexible resource, energy storage systems (ESSs) will be able to efficiently replace the role of traditional peak-shaving units. In this paper, a generation expansion planning (GEP) method considering regional ESS capacity evaluation is proposed. Firstly, from the perspective of resource interconnection, the power grid is partitioned, and the chance-constrained programming method is used to evaluate the ESS capacity demand of the partition where RES is concentrated. Then it is input into the GEP model as a boundary condition to obtain the configuration capacity of different power plants. The proposed method is verified on the XJTU-ROTS test system, which proves the effectiveness of the ESS for the replacement of the traditional peaking power plants and the accuracy of the ESS capacity evaluation.

articleTitle: Assessment Method of the Impact of Energy Policies on Carbon Emission Reduction in the Power System by Using Chronological Operation Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy policies play a major role in the development of the power system's low-carbon future and are a crucial tool for macroeconomic regulation. The lack of quantitative research on energy policies, however, is a significant obstacle to the development of low-carbon transformation routes. In order to create a chronological operation simulation (COS) model that takes these policies into account, this paper first chooses a number of common energy policies. This paper then constructs a carbon reduction indicator evaluation system to assess the effectiveness of carbon reduction policies. Finally, based on the Hubei power system, this paper conducts simulation analyses for the years 2025, 2030, 2045, and 2060. Using the simulation analysis results, this paper calculates the indicators and evaluated and ranked the various policy scenarios using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), Entropy Weight Method (EWM), and Set Pair Analysis Theory (SPA). Based on the ranking results, the recommendations for policy transformation pathways are provided.

articleTitle: Dynamic State of Charge Balancing Control Strategy for Sodium-ion and Lithium-ion Hybrid Energy Storage System in DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In renewable energy-powered DC microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) play an indispensable role. Owing to the superior cyclic stability and enhanced safety features of sodium-ion batteries, this paper explores a hybrid energy storage system that integrates both sodium-ion and lithium-ion batteries. This combined approach introduces specific challenges, especially regarding voltage stability and State of Charge (SOC) consistency. To address these challenges, the paper presents a primary controller paired with a nonlinear disturbance observer, ensuring stable bus voltage despite variations in Constant Power Loads (CPLs). Furthermore, a dynamic SOC balancing control strategy is introduced to rectify SOC imbalances stemming from the unique characteristics and capacities of the two battery types. This approach not only maintains consistent SOC levels across storage units, but also meets plug-and-play (PnP) requirements. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is validated by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Review on Virtual Power Plants: Development Progress and Market Participation Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual power plants (VPPs) participate in the electricity market and interact with the power grid by aggregating user-side flexible resources, which plays an important role in improving the regulation capacity of new-type power systems (NTPS) and alleviating local power shortages. To better promote the development of VPPs and enhance the reliability of the NTPS, this review summarizes the development progress of typical VPPs at home and abroad and their participation mechanisms in electricity markets such as energy, frequency regulation, demand response, and reserve. Moreover, constructive suggestions are put forward for VPPs' development in participating in electricity markets at different market developing stages, providing references for the improvement of relevant policies, mechanisms, and business models.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Power Spot Market Boundary Data Management System Considering Data Approval and Intelligent Data Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low quality of boundary data in the power spot market under the power spot market environment. This paper sorts out the main boundary data of the current power spot market clearance. According to the actual needs of the power spot market, the data management system of the power spot market is designed and implemented based on data approval and intelligent data verification, providing strong technical support for the clearance of the spot market. The power spot market boundary data management system based on data approval and intelligent data verification solves the data quality problems faced by spot market clearance, greatly improves the success rate of spot market clearance, and provides strong technical support for dispatch staff to carry out data analysis and decision-making.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Decentralized Multi-Microgrid Collaborative Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a global focus on the applications of renewable energy in microgrid scenarios. However, due to the fluctuation of renewable energy generation, it is difficult to be controlled by centralized microgrid system. Moreover, centralized microgrid pose security risks as the entire system can be paralyzed once the central node is attacked. In this paper, a blockchain based decentralized multi-microgrid collaborative control system model for microgrid is proposed. First, for the flaws of traditional centralized microgrid system, a decentralized modeling of multi-microgrid system is achieved using blockchain technology. All microgrid nodes collaborate in the control system, thereby avoiding the risk of the central node being attacked and enhancing system security. Secondly, to address the problem of unstable decision-making time caused by traditional consistency algorithm, the Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerant (PBFT) consensus algorithm of blockchain and smart contract technology are utilized as alternatives to traditional consistency algorithms. This approach mitigates the impact of initial values on decision-making time and improves system stability. Thirdly, the presented model is implemented and simulated in the MATLAB & Simulink environment. Simulation results demonstrate that this model can ensure the stability of the decision-making time and overcome some performance problems of blockchain under the premise of solving the security problem, realizing the collaborative control of decentralized multi-microgrid effectively.

articleTitle: Joint Planning Strategy of New Energy and Energy Storage Under Regional Low-Carbon Policy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of China's new energy grid scale, the intermittency and unpredictability of its output pose significant challenges to the stable operation of the grid. Long-term energy storage is utilized to provide sustained and stable power output during extreme weather or energy supply shortages, while short-term energy storage responds rapidly to peaks and valleys in power demand to ensure grid stability. To address this, this paper proposes a joint planning strategy for new energy, short-term, and long-term energy storage, considering regional low-carbon constraints. Firstly, the paper analyzes the impact of low-carbon policies on the joint planning of new energy and short-term/long-term energy storage from multiple perspectives. Then, based on the consideration of low-carbon constraints, a joint planning model for new energy and short-term and long-term energy storage is established to meet the capacity requirements under different carbon emission constraints. Finally, a case study in selected regions of China indicates a significant increase in the demand for long-term energy storage when the carbon emission rate is below 40%. The results also demonstrate that the impact of varying low-carbon constraints on the installed capacity of new energy differs across regions, validating the effectiveness of the proposed joint planning model under low-carbon constraints and providing insights for such planning in different regions.

articleTitle: Research on Target Prediction Method for Urban Distribution Network Reliability Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the traditional distribution network reliability prediction methods need to rely on accurate distribution network structure and detailed historical data, it is difficult to adapt to the complex distribution network and planning reliability index prediction problems. For this reason, this paper proposes a BP neural network-based prediction method for urban grid reliability indicators under the condition of limited historical sample data. Firstly, we analyze and categorize the factors affecting the reliability index of urban distribution network, focusing on the configuration of primary and secondary systems, the impact of flexible loads on the reliability of the distribution network, and the differentiated needs of different types of power users; secondly, we elaborate the basic principles, relevant control parameters and training and learning methods of BP neural network, and select the ring network rate, cable rate, average power supply radius of the line, and the load transferability rate, The factors of ring rate, cableization rate, average power supply radius of lines, load transferable supply rate, and inter-station contact rate are chosen as the main influencing factors, and the historical data of these factors are taken as inputs, and the corresponding results of the distribution system reliability rate index are taken as outputs. Finally, the feasibility of the reliability index prediction method for urban distribution network planning based on BP neural network proposed in this paper is verified based on the historical sample data of distribution network in a city in southern China.

articleTitle: Rural Green Transformation of Energy in a Demonstration County in China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy is regarded as a green window to address climate change, strengthen the resilience of the energy system and drive low-carbon economic growth. Therefore, at present, several countries are trying to develop renewable energy and achieve energy transformation. In China, promoting the green transformation of energy in rural areas is not only an inherent requirement to meet the needs of people's better lives but also an important step to implement the rural revitalization strategy and achieve the “Dual Carbon” goals.
