Therefore, a shared energy storage (SES) joint planning strategy based on Nash bargaining theory is proposed for prosumers. First, the SES model among multiple prosumers is developed to characterize the energy interaction relationship between prosumers and SES. Then, the Nash bargaining theory is introduced to develop the SES joint planning model. On this basis, the original Nash bargaining-based model is transformed into two easier-to-solve sub-problems. Finally, case studies are carried out to validate the efficacy of the proposed SES model and the corresponding planning strategy. Simulation results show that the SES planning and cost distribution problems can be effectively addressed through the proposed planning strategy. In addition, prosumers can effectively reduce their costs by cooperating as an alliance to construct and utilize an SES jointly when compared with constructing energy storage independently.

articleTitle: Power Supply System Design for IGCT Gate Unit in Series Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: IGCT(Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristor) is a full-controlled high-power semiconductor device, and it can be used in the power grid field as well as IGBT. The arm bridge needs many devices in series in HVDC. So the power supply of gate unit must be isolated from each other by high voltage. The power demand of the IGCT gate unit is much larger than that of IGBT or thyristor, which increases the difficulty of energy extraction. IGCT is equipped with RC network in series applications and the energy extraction from the RC network becomes one power supply method in this field. Based on this technology, this paper proposes a new power supply system design way without high or low voltage isolation measure. The output of the power supply system is directly the cathode pole, and it can be directly connected with the turning on circuit and turning off circuit of the gate unit. The circuit form in this paper is simple, and the devices of the power system can be selected easily. It can achieve non ground power supply and non isolated power supply. It has low cost and high reliability. The most novel of this power system is that the energy extraction can be placed in the gate unit directly.

articleTitle: Intra-Hour Solar Irradiance Estimation Using Infrared Sky Images and MobileNetV2-Based CNN Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid growth in both the development and use of solar energy has spurred intensive research in solar power estimation and forecasting in energy system integration. Solar irradiance, the sun's energy incident on Earth, is subject to fluctuations caused by dynamic atmospheric particulates such as clouds, significantly impacting energy pro-duction. Ground-based sky imagers, such as the Total Sky Imager (TSI), have substantially improved forecasting accuracy by cap-turing essential cloud data. Deep learning models, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have become pivotal in this field. This paper introduces a novel method for intra-hour solar irradiance estimation using infrared sky images and a CNN-regression model. The primary objective of this research is to achieve real-time accuracy, addressing the critical need for precise solar energy forecasting. The proposed method advances the state-of-the-art by reducing the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) to an impressive 16.18 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In our study, we leveraged a pre-trained and lightweight MobileNetV2 model, underlining its exceptional effectiveness in enhancing our approach for solar irradiance estimation from infrared sky images. This utilization of advanced pre-trained CNN models underscores the potential for accelerating progress in the field of solar energy forecasting.

articleTitle: Impact of Installed Capacity and Load Characteristics on The Environmental Benefits of Pumped Storage in Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The pumped storage plants could effectively promote the consumption of renewable energy. and reduce carbon emissions and coal consumption in the hybrid system, which has significant environmental benefits. However, these benefits of pumped storage plants need more quantitative ways, failing to get reasonable cost recovery in the process of power plant operation. This paper proposes a quantitative method to transfer environmental benefits into environmental costs, constructs a short-term optimal dispatch model of a pumped storage-wind-solar-thermal hybrid system (PWSTHS) considering environmental benefits. solves it using the Yalmip toolbox, and compares and analyzes the results of optimal dispatch under different capacity configurations and different load profiles. The results show that (1) With the increase of the installed capacity of pumped storage, the growth rate of its environmental benefits gradually slows down, and this paper shows that the environmental benefits reach the maximum when the installed capacity of pumped storage is 8.9% of the total installed capacity of pumped storage-wind-solar-thermal hybrid system. (2) The environmental benefits of pumped storage are greatly affected by the load characteristics, and the more significant the difference between peaks and valleys of the load, the more significant the environmental benefits of pumped storage; Among them, the environmental benefits of the three-stage load curve and seven-stage load curve are improved by 22.6% and 22.4% compared with the five-stage load.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evolution of CS and Its Effects on Charged Particles in Vacuum Arc
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: CS emits plasma and metal vapor towards the arc gap, which influences the interruption of VCB. In order to analyze the dynamic evolution of CS and its effect on charged particles, the observation experiments of CS and charged particles were carried out. Using cup-shaped electrode of AMF, the dynamic pictures of CS in the diffusion is shot by high-speed camera, and the distribution of CS is observed. The CS is identify by Matlab software, and the diameter, diffusion rate and quantity of the CS are obtained. The dynamic evolution of them with different breaking conditions is analyzed. The characteristic parameters of charged particles were diagnosed by colorimetric method. The 2D spatial distribution was obtained. The results indicate that the change of the quantity of CS with time is consistent with that of current waveform. The rise in the quantity of CS is related to the diffusion and split of the spots. It is observed that the evolution of CS on the electrode is not completely uniform. At the more radial outward position of the electrodes, the distance between CS is greater. The diameter and diffusion rate of CS are not constant. It is observed that charged particles density decays and fluctuates radially, and the temperature increases along the radial direction. This is related to the evolution of CS.

articleTitle: Security Constrained Dimensionality Reduction Strategy for Unit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With multiple and complicated security constraints of unit commitment problem in large grids, and the difficulty of considering the uncertainty of renewable energy output, this article proposes a fast solving method for long-term unit commitment based on the construction of an effective power flow constraint set using the 0–1 relaxation method. Firstly, obtain the rough unit commitment scheduling result by using 0–1 relaxation method to quickly identify the feasible region of unit commitment. Then, identify the line that will exceed the limit under such result and include it into the effective power flow constraint set. Secondly, identify the line that may exceed the limit by considering the change in allocation between units, load and wind power prediction errors, and include it into the effective power flow constraint set. Finally, solve the mixed integer programming problem of unit commitment, considering effective power flow constraints.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Oil Breakdown Voltage Detection Method Based on Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The breakdown voltage of transformer oil is an important indicator reflecting its insulation performance, and can only be measured through destructive tests at present. This article proposes a non-destructive method using digital images to measure the breakdown voltage of transformer oil. Firstly, a semiconductor laser with a wavelength of 632nm is used to excite the scattering phenomenon in transformer oil. The image information is filtered through image cutting and filtering. Finally, the number of pixels is selected as an indicator of light intensity to establish a relationship between it and the breakdown voltage of transformer oil. Research has found that the stronger the scattered light intensity, the higher the concentration of impurities in transformer oil. Under the action of an electric field, impurity channels are more likely to form and lead to breakdown of transformer oil. The breakdown intensity of transformer oil has a good negative correlation with the brightness of scattered light intensity, and the breakdown voltage of transformer oil can be calculated using formulas. The method proposed in this article can achieve non-destructive measurement of transformer oil breakdown voltage, which has certain engineering significance.

articleTitle: A Refined Life Cycle Investment Model for Improving the Reliability of Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: By constructing typical engineering construction scenarios, the engineering construction costs required for improving various business indicators related to reliability improvement were analyzed during the life cycle. The planning cost, equipment renovation cost, and distribution automation investment for improving the reliability of the distribution network are accounted for, and an optimization model related to this is constructed, with objective function and constraints displayed. Thus, a more comprehensive and refined reliability investment optimization method is provided.

articleTitle: Topology-Adaptive Small-Signal Stability Assessment Based on An Edge-Graph Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Long-term power system operation security requires data-driven small-signal assessment (SSA). Existing SSA schemes neglect edge features like branch powers and become vulnerable when applied to inter-area low-frequency oscillation (LFO) mode prediction under unseen topologies. We propose an edge-graph learning-based SSA scheme (EGL-SSA) based on steady-state measurements. The graph construction focuses on the edge features, before edge-node convolution (ENC) layers finish the feature extraction on both edges and nodes. Then the frequencies and damping ratios of various modes can be predicted in parallel via a multi-task structure with different downstream networks. Test results on the IEEE 39 Bus system indicate the superiority of our scheme under unseen topologies, especially aimed at the inter-area LFO modes.

articleTitle: Selling Energy Strategies for Integrated Energy Service Providers in Park Based on Electricity Carbon Weighting in the Electric Carbon Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals”, the park comprehensive energy service providers will become an important participant in the electric carbon market. In this paper, under the dual environment of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals” and electric carbon market, through the sale of users' electric energy and heat energy in the park, a reasonable energy sales pricing strategy is formulated, and a multi-objective optimization model considering the weight of electric carbon price and the saleable energy pricing strategy of comprehensive energy service providers is constructed. The linear weighted solution algorithm based on the price weight of electric carbon is adopted to solve the problem. The example results show that the energy sales pricing strategy proposed in this paper can effectively improve the total operating income of the comprehensive energy service providers in the park, reduce the overall carbon emissions of the park, and has good economic and environmental performance.

articleTitle: BIRCH-AHC Two-Layer Clustering Algorithm-Based Typical Scenario Generation of Photovoltaic Output for Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The BIRCH-AHC two-layer clustering algorithm is presented to reduce a large number of photovoltaic output scenarios. In the presented algorithm, CH index is introduced to select the appropriate clustering structural parameters, which can construct a BIRCH clustering feature tree that contains different photovoltaic outputs. Then, combining the elbow method to determine the optimal number of clusters, AHC algorithm is proposed to generate a typical scenario set of photovoltaic output. Finally, the photovoltaic output data of a regional power grid is taken as an example to verify the feasibility of the proposed method, and the result shows that the clustering analysis on large-scale photovoltaic power generation data can be well performed, which means the proposed method is capable of being applied to the planning and decision-making models of power system, and thus improves the accuracy and effectiveness of power system operation.

articleTitle: Flexible Auxiliary Service Market Clearing Method Compatible with Frequency Modulation Service and Electric Energy Schedule
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To effectively connect frequency modulation service, flexible auxiliary service and electric energy trading, and support the rapid development of new energy, a flexible auxiliary service market clearing method compatible with frequency modulation service and electric energy planning was proposed. The purpose of flexible auxiliary service trading is to fully tap the power regulation ability to ensure that the grid has sufficient power deviation adjustment ability during real-time operation. The connection characteristics among frequency modulation service, electric energy planning and flexible auxiliary service are studied. Based on the connection characteristics between the above trading varieties, a two-layer architecture based trade clearing method is constructed. The upper structure is the electricity energy market trading model, and the clearing decision obtains the generation output plan of each period of time. The lower layer is a single period joint clearing model of frequency modulation service and flexible auxiliary service. The model takes the electricity energy market clearing result as the boundary, and obtains the frequency modulation capacity and flexible auxiliary service capacity of the generator set. Finally, a numerical example based on the actual data of a provincial power grid was constructed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Energy Storage Resources for New Energy Accommodation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To promote low-carbon power system development, our country is increasing new energy grid integration. However, the uncertainty of new energy output brings significant pressure to the stable operation of the power grid, where the large-scale accommodation of new energy has always been a global challenge. As an important pillar of the stability of the new power system, energy storage systems can flexibly adjust power supply and effectively alleviate the impact of new energy output fluctuations on the power grid. In response to this, this paper proposes an optimal allocation method for energy storage resources aimed at absorbing new energy, first establishing the multi-period energy-storage system integrated direct current optimal power flow model, then considering the demand for new energy accommodation in multiple scenarios, it embeds the constraints of new energy accommodation into the aforementioned model. The case study compares the results of energy storage allocation under different new energy accommodation demands, demonstrating the rationality and effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Offshore Transmission Network Planning for Wind Power Considering Economy and Grid Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transmission planning is important to ensure reliable and economic grid connection of offshore wind farms (OWF). For districts that have abundant wind resources, transmission planning may involve different groups of large-scale OWFs and different transmission technologies. At present, there are few studies related to large-scale OWF integration. This paper presents a new methodology for the transmission planning of multi-section large-scale wind farms. First, the economy and security concerns of OWF transmission planning are analyzed. Second, a transmission planning method is proposed considering the grouping of wind farms, transmission technology, voltage level, and connection points to the main grid. Finally, the method is applied in the case study to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Demand-side Flexibility Resource Planning Optimization Model Considering Multi-objective Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing of the penetration of renewable energy, the volatility and stochasticity on the source side in the power system are intensified, and it is urgent to fully exploit the various demand-side flexibility resources to solve the problem of insufficient flexibility in the power system. To address the above problems, this paper carries out a study on demand-side flexibility resource planning considering multi-objective constraints. Firstly, based on the regulation direction, regulation capacity and regulation rate, the concept of generalized spinning reserve of new power system is introduced. Then, considering the constraints of guaranteeing system power supply reliability and renewable energy accommodation, a collaborative planning model for demand-side flexibility resources, including distributed generation, demand-side response and distributed energy storage is established. Finally, a simulation study is conducted based on the data of a provincial grid in northern China in 2022 to verify the validity and applicability of the models and methods proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Suppression Strategy for Distribution System with Multiple Inverters Based on Impedance Reshaping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The impedance interaction between grid connected inverters and the distribution grid is an important cause of system resonance. Based on impedance analysis method, this paper takes grid connected inverters as the research object, considers the influence of frequency coupling, establishes an impedance model for them, proposes an inverter impedance reshaping strategy, improves the output impedance of inverters at non-fundamental frequencies, and thus improves the applicability of stability simulation for grid connected multi- inverters. The effectiveness of the system resonance suppression strategy was verified through simulations.

articleTitle: Topology of Generator Outlet Circuit Breaker and Short Circuit Fault Breaking Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The generator circuit breaker is of great significance to improve the reliability of the operation of the generator and transformer and ensure the stability of electricity consumption in the event of failure, and with the increase of the capacity of the power system, the design and development of the generator outlet circuit breaker has brought greater problems. In this paper, a topology of a large-capacity generator circuit breaker is designed and analyzed, and the action sequence of each module under the maximum asymmetry extreme fault current is simulated by PSCAD simulation, which provides some guidance for the development of large-capacity generator circuit breaker.

articleTitle: A Fast Island Partition Method Considering Energy Storage in Smart Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the fast integration of so much distributed power sources and electricity storage system devices, the 10kV distribution network becomes more resiliency. After losing the superior power during fault period, it can continue to supply some important users by the access to distributed generation. However, there will be more and more constraints, liking the sequential operation of energy storage, radial topology of distribution network, no allowed secondary outage and load supply priority. They make the island partition a difficult problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a fast island partition method considering energy storage in smart distribution network. Its characteristic is that it can use power and power balance information to establish a mixed integer knapsack model of island division considering time series fluctuations on both sides of source and load, and quickly give an island division scheme with clear physical meaning. With proposed method, the simulation analysis of the improved PG&E 69-bus system is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical System Defense Decision-Making Based on Priori Knowledge of Traffic Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Industrial cyber-physical systems (ICPSs) include energy, power and transportation systems, and their security is a critical issue due to their important status in the industrial system. With the modernization of ICPS, more nodes controlled by the cyber layer make ICPS exposed to cyber-attacks more easily on the other hand. Existing studies respectively concerned with the problems of traffic anomaly detection and defense decision-making based on stochastic games while studies integrating the two problems are relatively few. Thus, we propose a method that takes the result of traffic anomaly detection as prior knowledge and then decides defense strategy and the allocation of defensive resources. In addition, the effectiveness of our proposed method is proved valid through the experiments on an ICPS testbed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Achieving Time of Carbon Emission in Transportation Industry Based on the STIRPAT Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transportation is one of main areas of carbon emission in China. In order to forecast the time of achieving carbon emission peak, this paper firstly used STIRPAT model to build relationship among carbon emission and key influencing factors. Then by using data from Fujian province, it analyzed influencing degrees on carbon emission. Based on this, it forecast the development of these factors, and calculated carbon emission of transportation in future. The research results could provide a way to analyze carbon emission into several certain factors and forecast its development exactly.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design of Capacity Compensation Mechanism for Power Security Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the dual carbon target, new energy will still show a steady development trend. The randomness and instability of its output require conventional power supply to provide capacity guarantee. However, the utilization hours of conventional power supply are decreasing year by year, and a single electric energy transaction can no longer meet the operation and development of conventional power supply. In order to solve the power supply security challenges brought by the large-scale integration of new energy, it is urgent to improve the power capacity compensation mechanism. On the basis of combing the typical experience of domestic capacity compensation, the provincial capacity compensation mechanism is designed, and the capacity compensation standard is calculated based on the installed and operating data of coal-fired power plants in Henan, in order to help the establishment of capacity compensation mechanism.

articleTitle: A Fast Iterative Method for Dynamic State Estimation with Unknown Noise Statistics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The extensive application of phasor measurement units (PMUs) provides a solid information foundation for real-time monitoring of power system dynamic processes. To improve the robustness of unscented Kalman filter (UKF), a spherical simplex unscented transform-based iterated unscented Kalman filter (SSUT-IUKF) is proposed. By introducing spherical simplex unscented transform and iterative correction technology into UKF, the computing efficiency and estimation accuracy have been effectively improved. Finally, simulation experiments are conducted on an IEEE 39-bus system. Compared with traditional dynamic state estimation methods for synchronous generators, SSUT- IUKF has potential advantages in algorithm robustness, computational efficiency and estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: HIL-based Distributed Control of Inverter-Air-Conditioner for Power System Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The goals of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals bring a fast extension of renewable energy such as photovoltaic power(PV) and wind power. While providing abundant clean power, the intermittent output also brings power imbalance problems and results in frequency fluctuation and power shortage. Since the demotion of traditional power generators reduces their regulation ability in power balancing, demand side load is considered a satisfactory regulation resource. Inverter air conditioners(IAC) are a widely approved demand response resource because of their flexibility, universality, and ability to maintain customers' comfort. With a great amount of IAC implemented, adopting a reasonable control strategy is important. Centralized control is a commonly used method; however, to develop the communication efficiency and extensibility potential of IAC in larger city scenarios, this paper proposed a Hardware-In-the-Loop(HIL) distributed control method for IAC participating frequency regulation demand response service with Breadth First Search(BFS) strategy based on the Realtime Digital Simulator(RTDS) platform. The HIL clients are Raspberry Pi- 4B and ESP8266 chips, implemented with the IAC model for demand response service.

articleTitle: Spot Market Trading Mechanism for Electricity from Conventional Generating Units Considering the Carbon Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper considers the impact of the carbon market on conventional generating units on the power generation side, analyzes the impact mechanism of the carbon market on the electricity market, and constructs a cost-benefit model for conventional generating units to provide assistance for conventional generating units to participate in the coupled carbon electricity market, while reducing the total carbon emissions.

articleTitle: High Share Distributed PV Interactive Coordination Fast Frequency Response Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the penetration rate of renewable energy, the grid frequency stability is threatened obviously. In order to decrease the negative impact of system frequency stability with a high share of distributed photovoltaics(PV) integrated into, a system frequency response(SFR) model suitable for high distributed PV penetration is established, a coordinated control strategy between centralized frequency control mode and decentralized frequency control mode is proposed in this paper, then an optimization control model is constructed to exert the frequency modulation performance of different types of distributed PV fully, Finally, the effectiveness of the offered method is systematically verified based on practical simulation system.

articleTitle: Saturated Load Forecasting Based on Attention-LSTM Correction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurately predicting saturated load enables utilities to estimate the peak load demand after urban construction development, thereby optimizing the construction sequence and resource allocation during the transformation of distribution network infrastructure and it plays a crucial role in the effective planning and operation of the distribution network. In this paper, the traditional saturated load prediction method based on load density is improved and a saturated load prediction method based on attention-long short-term memory (LSTM) correction is proposed. First, the feature vectors describing the factors affecting saturated load are established, and an LSTM model is constructed to mine the nonlinear mapping relationship between saturated load and feature vectors. Then, an attention mechanism is embedded into the LSTM model, which enables the model to extract the main influencing factors of saturated load, thus improving the accuracy of predicting saturated load and the generalization ability of the model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by using load data from four actual substations in the cities of China to simulate load forecasting. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional method based on logistic curve fitting, the proposed method has higher accuracy in predicting the saturation load value and saturation year of high-load development level in the forecasted area.

articleTitle: Line Pilot Protection for DFIG Wind Farm Transmission Lines Based on Wasserstein Distance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When faults occur in the transmission lines of wind farms, the fault characteristics on the wind farm side exhibit significant differences from those on the AC grid side due to the control actions of the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) converters and crowbar protection. This leads to a substantial deterioration in the effectiveness of conventional protection methods relying on power frequency parameters, and even giving rise to occurrences of erroneous tripping. To address this issue, a pilot protection scheme based on the Wasserstein distance is proposed, taking advantage of the waveform shape differences of fault currents on both sides of the transmission lines. Extensive simulation analysis reveals that the proposed pilot protection scheme, based on the Wasserstein distance, remains unaffected by the fault location, fault type, and transitional resistance at the fault point. It reliably operates in various fault scenarios and offers a high level of sensitivity.

articleTitle: Frequency Modulation Strategy of Virtual Synchronous Generator Based on Adaptive Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The virtual synchronous generator (VSG) battery energy storage system (BESS) based on model predictive control can not only provide virtual inertia to the power grid, but also accurately calculate the active power increment required when the load changes through the VSG prediction model, and then superimpose on the VSG for reference to effectively suppress the frequency change. However, in practical applications, the health status of energy storage batteries plays a crucial role in safe operation. To solve this problem, based on the existing research, an adaptive model predictive control (A-MPC) is proposed. The output of A-MPC is adjusted by introducing the State of Charge (SOC) of the energy storage battery to adjust the weight coefficient of the MPC cost function. The output of A-MPC is superimposed to the active power reference value of VSG to adjust the output power of the storage. The simulation results show that the proposed method can not only suppress the frequency fluctuation of the microgrid, but also effectively prevent the phenomenon of overcharge and over-discharge of the battery, and improve the safety of BESS.

articleTitle: A Capacity Planning Methodology for Power System Flexibility Resources Considering Flexibility Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Rational planning of flexibility resources is very important for the reliable operation of new power system with a high proportion of new energy sources. In order to ensure that the power system can be operated safely and economically, it is necessary to quantitatively assess the flexibility demand of the power system and carry out the capacity planning for various types of flexibility resources. In this paper, the net load distribution curve of power system is established firstly, and the flexibility demand quantification method is proposed combined with the baseline output scheme. Then, the regulation ability of various types of flexibility resources is analyzed, and the capacity planning model of flexibility resources is constructed. Eventually, the validity and efficiency of the model is verified by referring to the example planning of a certain regional power grid setup. The results show that the planning scheme can fully take into account the regulation characteristics of various types of resources, combine with the flexibility demand of the system and obtain the optimal planning results.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Control Unit Based on Power Grid Harmonic Pollution Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The phase-locked loop (PLL) serves as the core control unit for a grid-connected inverter, providing grid phase information. Its excellent performance directly determines the quality of grid-connected current. However, the actual grid often operates under various non-ideal conditions, which will affect the PLL's operation. To this end, this paper analysis and design the control loops and parameters of two single-phase PLLs, namely the SRF-PLL and MAF-PLL. Simulation models of single-phase SOGI-SRF-PLL and single-phase SOGI-MAF-PLL are constructed in Matlab/Simulink. Their performance is analyzed under different operating conditions, such as grid harmonics, DC offset, voltage sags, frequency variations, and phase jumps. The simulation results show that the single-phase SOGI-SRF-PLL exhibits faster response to frequency variations and phase jumps, while the single-phase SOGI-MAF-PLL demonstrates better disturbance rejection under conditions of harmonics, DC offset, and unbalanced voltage sags.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Distribution Networks Based on Multi-node Interaction of Controllable PV and Supporting Storage - Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the background of the whole county photovoltaic (PV) development, a high proportion of distributed PV - supporting energy storage system(ESS)-load demonstrate a multi-node access trend. Voltage exceeding the limit and reverse power flow overloading the capacity when excessive PV output cannot be consumed locally, collaboration actions are required to ensure the safety of distribution networks operation. An optimal dispatch of distribution networks based on multi-node interaction of controllable PV and supporting storage-load is proposed in this paper. First, an optimal scheduling model of controllable PV and supporting storage-load is constructed. Second, to address the impact of PV output uncertainty on the accuracy of controllable results, the variance and mean value of PV output are introduced, and the original power flow constraints and safety constraints are reformulated into the form of opportunity constraints, and the multi-problem is solved by ε-constraint method. Finally, the economy and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by an IEEE33-node example.

Author Keywords: controllable photovoltaic (PV). energy storage system (ESS). transferable load. multi-node optimization of distribution network operation

articleTitle: Research on 750kV Transmission Line Unbalance in a New Transposition Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, 750kV transmission lines basically use two transposition auxiliary sub-tower plus a base of tension-resistant tower transposition method, a whole cycle using two or three transposition points. This traditional way covers a large area, high investment, and the topography of the transposition point requires gentle, in addition to the line lightning protection performance deterioration. This paper proposes a new type of transposition method, using two-phase transposition at each place, canceling the transposition of the sub-tower, through the construction of the simulation model of the transposition of the line imbalance simulation calculation, the results show that the transposition can really save line investment, improve the safety and reliability of operation.

articleTitle: Forced Disturbance Equipment Location Based on Spectral Residual Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A method for locating the source of forced disturbance in governing system, PSS and excitation system is proposed. The eigenfunction of each control equipment under normal operation condition is estimated according to the noise-like signal. When oscillation occurs, the unit and equipment where the disturbance is located can be judged by predicting the output of governing system and excitation system by transfer function and the spectral residual between the output and the actual measured value of power grid. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are proved by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Bidding Model for Shared Energy Storage Participation in Multi-Market Considering Multi-Timescale Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Shared energy storage (SES) can participate in multi-market transactions to satisfy the multi-timescale demand. A bidding model for SES to participate in multi-market which considers multi-timescale demand is proposed to improve the economic benefits of SES. Firstly, the net load curve is decomposed based on the intrinsic timescale decomposition (ITD) method, and the mapping relationship between multi-timescale demand and multi-market is established by quantifying the peak, frequency modulation and capacity tenancy demand. Secondly, a double-level master-slave game bidding model is established for SES to participate in the multi-market, in which SES, as the upper leader, aims to maximize its own benefit, while consumers, as the lower follower, aim to minimize the cost of purchasing electricity, to realize SES participation in the multi-market game bidding. Finally, the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) is used to transform the double-level model into a single-level mathematical programming problem, and the validity of the model is verified by test system analysis.

articleTitle: User-side Optimal Battery Storage Configuration Considering the Costs of Degradation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the expanding capacity of user-side energy storage systems and the introduction of the “14th Five-Year Plan” new energy storage development strategy, battery energy storage systems (BESS) have gained widespread use among consumers. This paper explores the maximum benefit of user-side BESS, and establishes a mixed integer optimization model of BESS operation strategy with the optimization goal of maximum user comprehensive income. With the installation of BESS on the user side, the total cost primarily comprises the initial investment and the operational battery loss cost, and the complex battery degradation cost function is constructed into a simple linearized function without losing too much accuracy. In terms of revenue, it manifests as decreased electricity expenses due to peak cutting and valley filling, along with reductions in monthly maximum demand and improved demand response. The proposed model is solved by GUROBI solver. The simulation results demonstrate that optimizing the BESS operation strategy leads to a reduction in overall power consumption costs. If the capacity of BESS access users is properly selected, the benefits can cover the cost, which is economically feasible.

articleTitle: Self-Adaptiveive Step Size Adjustment Method of Digital-Analog Hybrid Simulation towards Urban Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The digital-analog hybrid simulation for urban energy internet is an significant technical method to verify the optimization strategy of urban energy internet operation. A comprehensive optimization objective design method is put forward in this paper. The method is used for the simulation step size of urban energy internet in the mixed simulation of digital and analog. Also an adaptive mechanism for the simulation step size according to an adapted filtering ideal transformer interface model is designed. The degree of effectiveness and degree of accuracy of the proposed method were verified through numerical examples.

articleTitle: Vertex-Scenario Robust P2P Energy Trading for Multi-Energy VPPs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper investigates the peer-to-peer (P2P) trading framework in a multi-energy virtual power plant (VPP). The aim is to deal with the uncertainty of renewable energy. To solve this problem, a vertex-scenario robust optimization (VRO) method is developed in this paper, which, through Taguchi's orthogonal array testing method, can effectively reduce the number of scenarios and increase the computation efficiency. On this basis, this paper establishes a P2P trading model of multi-energy VPPs, and uses the tracker-based distributed algorithm (TBDA) to solve this optimization problem, which can increase the consumption rate of renewable energy and realize collaborative optimization among multi-energy VPPs. Finally, the rationality and availability of the advanced model are testified in case studies.

articleTitle: A VCG Energy Price Mechanism for Day-Ahead Market Clearing in Electricity-Gas Combined System Considering Energy Contracts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The locational marginal pricing mechanism is difficult to incentive market members to bid true cost information, and the coupling between power networks and natural gas networks poses new challenges to the research energy price mechanism for day-ahead market clearing in electricity-gas combined system. To incentive market participants to truthfully bid and thereby achieve an rational allocation for social resources, based on VCG in mechanism design theory, a VCG energy price mechanism of the day-ahead market clearing of electricity-gas combined system considering energy contracts. The day-ahead market clearing model of electricity-gas combined system considering energy contracts is established. The payment of each market member is defined as the substitution benefit of the member to other members, which give the settlement formula of each market member, and it is proved that the mechanism meets the requirements of incentive compatibility, individual rationality, and the minimization of power grid companies purchase electricity fees and natural gas company purchase electricity fees. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed mechanism is verified by the numerical examples.

articleTitle: Expert Incorporated Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Market Arbitrage Strategy of the Battery Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Peak-valley arbitrage is one of the important ways for energy storage systems to make profits. Traditional optimization methods have shortcomings such as long solution time, poor universality, and difficulty in applying to non-convex problems. This study addresses this issue by utilizing Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to optimize the market arbitrage of battery storage system (BSS). Firstly, the market arbitrage problem is presented as a typical Markov Decision Process (MDP). Secondly, an expert incorporated DRL approach is proposed to seek for the optimal control strategy for the energy storage systems. Finally, the proposed algorithm is verified based on the U.K. electricity market background. The numerical simulation result show that the proposed method can achieve refined power control on the premise of preventing overcharge and over-discharge of the battery storage system, and achieve higher training efficiency comparing with existing deep reinforcement learning approach.

articleTitle: Two Stage Scheduling Optimization Model for Micro Energy Grid Considering the Uncertainty of Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As demand-side distributed renewable energy is rapidly expanding, micro energy grid is a new vehicle to drive the development of demand-side energy transformation in the future. Aiming at the uncertainty of wind power generation and demand response within the micro energy grid, this paper proposes a two-stage scheduling optimization model of micro energy grid considering the uncertainty of demand response. First, this paper analyzes the energy coupling relationship among micro gas turbine, electric boiler, electric-to-gas conversion, energy storage device and other equipment, and establishes the appropriate energy input/output model. Afterwards, the prediction error of wind power generation and load is analyzed, and then the impact of user demand response behavior on its prediction error is analyzed. Finally, in order to control the deviation of the day-ahead dispatching schedule, this paper constructs a two-stage day-ahead-intraday dispatching optimization model for micro energy grid. In this paper, we design examples to confirm the validity and applicability of all models.

articleTitle: A Peer-to-Peer Trading Mechanism of Virtual Power Plant Considering Contact Line Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The article focuses on the study of virtual power plants (VPP) participating in the electricity market in the region. Based on the traditional centralized trading model, considering the connection between the virtual power plant and the power grid, contact line constraints are added in the trading process to make the trading model closer to reality. Meanwhile, in order to fully protect the interests of the virtual power plant, while considering the contact line constraints, the peer-to-peer (P2P) trading model between aggregators was established to realize the resource synergy within the virtual power plant. Compared with directly processing the transaction results of the centralized transaction model through the way of equal proportion reduction, the mechanism model designed in this paper can make the transaction closer to reality and fully guarantee the interests of the virtual power plant through simulation.

articleTitle: Study on Nano-A12O3/Epoxy Composite Coatings to Enhance Surface Flashover
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Epoxy micron composite dielectric materials are widely used in power equipment, especially in gas insulated switchgear (GIS). However, under DC high-voltage conditions, epoxy resin insulators under the action of electric field will occur surface charge accumulation, so that the nearby electric field distortion caused surface flashover, threatening the power system and the safe operation of electrical equipment. Curing coating on the surface of epoxy micrometer composite dielectric material are considered to be one of the effective measures to improve the flashover voltage along the surface, for this reason, this paper adopts the coating method, the nano-A1<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/EP composite coating is coated on the surface of the micrometer epoxy composite matrix, and respectively, DC flashover experiments were carried out in SF6 under 0.1 MPa, as well as the surface potential attenuation experiments. The experimental results show that the flashover voltage in the specimen containing nano-A1<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/EP coating is enhanced by 14.57% compared with the matrix, and its surface potential decay rate is also enhanced.

articleTitle: Adaptive Energy Balance Control for DC-DC Converter with Auxiliary Current Module in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC-DC converter with auxiliary current module (ACM) is usually taken to interface the dynamic loads that have large disturbances and even power steps, such as pulsed power loads. Instantaneous voltage disturbance occurs in the converter when the load power changes, and may be delivered to the whole microgrid if fast voltage regulation is not achieved. To this end, this paper proposes an adaptive energy balance control (AEBC) for the converter. First, the estimation of system energy balance is proposed to explore the tradeoff between accelerating voltage regulation and reducing the risk of voltage overshoot. Based on the concept of energy balance, AEBC is achieved by the adaptive adjustment of the inductor currents. Under the auxiliary energy provided by the ACM, fast voltage regulation is always obtained not only under varying load transients but also under converter startup. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the control performs well in accelerating voltage regulation, and it is easy to implement in practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Method of New Energy Generation about Randomness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It's significance to establish a rational model of the randomness of new energy power for the analysis and control of new energy power system. One way to realize the probability prediction of new energy power generation is to model and quantify the probability distribution of prediction error based on the deterministic prediction results. Based on Itô process model, this paper describes the stochastic characteristics of new energy power in the form of stochastic differential equation. Firstly, the model based method is used to construct Itô process parameters under the condition of given statistical model, and the probability distribution of prediction object is obtained by superimposing the probability distribution of prediction error on the deterministic prediction results. Secondly, the method based on historical data is used to estimate the Itô process parameters with the maximum likelihood value given the historical data. Finally, a numerical example proves that Itô process is practical in describing the randomness of new energy sources.

articleTitle: Economic Impacts of the Capacity and Topology Design on the Wind Power-to-Hydrogen Cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) limits the development of green hydrogen from renewable energy. Under the current facilities prices, the optimal design of the capacity and topology of the power-to-hydrogen (P2H) cluster is expected to reduce LCOH further. This paper proposes an LCOH-based economic evaluation method with the input of the topology and capacity design parameters for the wind power-to-hydrogen cluster. The analytical optimal control law of the P2H cluster is first derived to determine the optimal production curves with different topologies. Then, the hydrogen production duration curve is proposed to consider the capacity and the optimal production curve. On this basis, LCOH is expressed as the function of the topology and capacity. Case studies based on a real offshore application reveal an LCOH valley around the optimal capacity and topology design parameters for the P2H cluster. The optimization of the capacity and topology can bring a maximum 2% reduction in LCOH.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Storage Configuration Suitable for Rural Distributed Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve the dual-carbon goal, China continues to vigorously promote the clean and low-carbon transformation of energy, and distributed power access, mainly photovoltaic, will become a trend in the future development of the distribution network. Due to the intermittent and fluctuating nature of distributed photovoltaic power generation, a large number of connections will bring challenges to the safe operation of weak rural distribution networks. In this paper, by analysing the rural power supply system structure and rural electricity load, and considering the economy of distributed energy storage devices, we propose a capacity allocation model with the maximum annual energy storage revenue as the objective function, which provides a basis for the distributed energy storage capacity allocation under the rural distribution network.

articleTitle: A Method for Low Carbon Operation Decision Support of Thermal Power Plants Based on Data-driven Causal Inference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The national carbon market is one of the core policy tools to achieve the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. In 2021, the first performance period of the power generation industry in the national carbon market was officially launched, and the thermal power industry is the only emission control industry in the national carbon market. Under the background of the current dual carbon revolution, emission control requirements are gradually increased, and the impact on the economic efficiency of thermal power plants is further amplified by whether low-carbon operation can be realized. However, due to the impact of technology and other objective factors, the carbon emission intensity of thermal power units is affected by the unit characteristics, fuel, load rate and other factors, and there are many factors affecting the carbon emission level of thermal power plants. Therefore, how to achieve reasonable control of thermal power plant carbon emissions under given conditions becomes an important factor affecting the economics of thermal power plants. Since various operational control quantities of thermal power plants, such as power supply and heat supply, are closely related to carbon emissions, it is effective to construct a cause-effect diagram to fit the relationship between operational control quantities and carbon emissions based on data-driven cause-effect inference, and to perform sensitivity analysis on carbon emission levels to achieve reasonable control of carbon emissions for low-carbon operation of thermal power plants. In this paper, we present a data-driven causal inference method for low-carbon operation of thermal power plants. The causal diagram is constructed through a priori knowledge, and the relationship equation between the intervening variables and the outcome variables is fitted based on the matching model, and the sensitivity analysis of the unit carbon emissions is carried out to realize the auxiliary decision-making for low-carbon operation of thermal power plants.

articleTitle: Minimum Inertia Requirement Evaluation Method of Power Systems Considering Frequency Stability Constraints and Spatial Distribution Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The frequency stability of power systems under large disturbances has been severely hampered by the low inertia issue caused by the high proportion of renewable energy systems, resulting in frequency-related indicators closer to the boundary of the safety domain. This paper proposes a minimum inertia requirement evaluation approach for renewable energy power systems considering frequency stability constraints and spatial distribution characteristics. Firstly, a mathematical model of system frequency dynamic response is established, and the inertia center frequency is introduced to represent the frequency of the whole system (or regional system) to solve the problem of inconsistent frequency response process of different nodes. Then, an evaluation method is proposed to estimate the minimum inertia requirement of the system taking into account the frequency stability constraints, which avoids the issues of complex model construction and poor solving efficiency. This method combines the time-domain formulation of the inertia center frequency and the time-domain formulation of power systems frequency response with the primary frequency modulation dead zone. Finally, this paper verifies the validity of this method in a certain regional power grid and provides theoretical support for ensuring stable system operation and operating mode arrangement.

articleTitle: Real-Time Perception Approach of Power Supply Capacity of Active Distribution Network Driven by Hybrid Data-Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Real-time and accurate perception of active distribution network (ADN) power supply capacity (PSC) has important guiding significance for active control and real-time scheduling of ADN. In order to achieve this goal, we propose a hybrid data-model driven approach. Firstly, the uncertain factors in the system are modeled, and generation of multi-run scenarios for perception the PSC of the system by Monte Carlo Based Simulation Approach. Secondly, identifying the index to measure the PSC of the system, and the model-driven approach calculates the PSC of the system in different scenarios to obtain the training samples for data-driven approach. The PSC index calculated by the trained data-driven model are transmitted as the initial value to the model-driven algorithm to further analyze the PSC of the system. The data-model hybrid driven approach can effectively combine the advantages of the two approaches to achieve real-time accurate perception of the of the system's PSC, so as to guide the active control and real-time scheduling of the ADN. We finally use a modified IEEE33 node example to test the correctness and efficiency of this approach.

articleTitle: The Coordinating Thermal Energy Storage Capacity Planning of Concentrated Solar Power Considering Demand Side Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an emerging power generation method, concentrated solar power (CSP) has the same dispatchability as thermal power generation units. It can increase the penetration rate of renewable energy while ensuring grid security and economy, which can play a certain role in promoting the development of the renewable energy industry. Considering the demand-side response, a novel thermal energy storage capacity planning method for concentrated solar power is proposed in this paper. Since the energy storage capacity is closely related to the demand-side response, it is necessary to establish a coordination optimization model which can effectively improve the economy of the system. Lastly, to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, a case study of China western province is provided in this paper.

articleTitle: Wind Power Output Limitation Pattern Recognition under Cold Wave Weather Conditions Based on Spatiotemporal Characteristics and GoogLeNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The limited wind power output caused by cold wave weather poses challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power system. In order to improve the accuracy of wind power output recognition under cold weather conditions, this paper proposes a wind power output limitation pattern recognition method under cold weather conditions based on spatiotemporal characteristics and GoogLeNet. Firstly, construct a spatiotemporal characteristic set of wind power in the target wind farm; Then, the characteristic matrix is imaged to construct a wind power output limited characteristic mapping; Finally, a wind power output limitation pattern recognition model is constructed based on GoogLeNet. The calculation results show that based on the proposed method, the accuracy of wind power output recognition under cold weather conditions reaches 84.2%, which can effectively achieve wind power output limited warning.

articleTitle: Federated Learning based Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring in Domestic Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the smart grid continues to evolve and the quality of life improves, the demand for electricity services by residential users is increasing. The combination of non-intrusive load monitoring technology and smart meters is helping address these user needs. It enables companies to provide more intelligent and precise services to users while promoting scientific and rational electricity consumption. In response to the significant risks of centralized database data leakage and the lack of personalized models in current non-intrusive load monitoring models, a personalized federated learning-based non-intrusive load monitoring model is proposed. The study compared bidirectional long short-term memory, federated bidirectional long short-term memory, and non-intrusive load monitoring models based on personalized federated learning under the same experimental conditions and simulated real-world scenarios using the REDD dataset. The results indicate that the non-intrusive load monitoring model based on personalized federated learning balanced model availability and model security.

articleTitle: An Online Estimation Approach for the Aggregate Model of District Heating Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An accurate yet concise district heating network (DHN) model is essential for the dispatch of the integrated energy system (IES). Owing to the changes in the operation conditions, such as the topology changes and mass flow rate adjustments, the parameters of the DHN model may change during operation. Hence, the accurate online parameter estimation of the DHN is the basis of the real-time analysis and control of IES, which, however, has received little attention. To this end, this paper proposed an online parameter estimation method for the DHN aggregate model based on the recursive least square with a forgetting factor. In this method, the aggregate parameter matrixes of the DHN model are reconstructed and updated online using the latest data to track the model changes. Case studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Effects of Operating Range of Hydropower Units in Hydro-Wind-PV Hybrid System Considering Benefit, Risk and Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale grid integration of wind and PV power is important for achieving decarbonized development. This integration requires frequent regulation of flexible power sources for complementary operations such as hydro-wind-PV hybrid system (HWPHS). However, most of the existing operational range of hydropower units is relatively limited, making it difficult to provide sufficient flexibility to cope with the uncertain wind and PV power. This can result in hydropower units being forced to operate in the risky part-load region. To analyze and evaluate the effects of different operating ranges of hydropower units in hybrid system, this work proposes an evaluation model for HWPHS via five indicators considering benefit, risk and stability. Moreover, the model is applied to a large hybrid energy base in China. The results show that the proposed model and method provide support for the evaluation and decision-making regarding the stable operation range of hydropower units in the transformation and upgrade of hybrid energy systems.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based on Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization and Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the realm of power distribution systems, the optimization of network configuration plays a pivotal role. The significance of this task lies in its ability to enhance system performance and efficiency. This paper underscores the imperative need to employ a hybrid approach, marrying the capabilities of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) for distribution network reconfiguration. Through the synergistic collaboration between these methodologies, a refined network configuration is achieved, resulting in minimized power losses, improved load balance, and heightened system reliability. The outcomes demonstrate substantial improvements in terms of system performance, highlighting the potential of the proposed hybrid approach for reconfiguration in power distribution networks.

articleTitle: Recognition System for Safety Helmets and Reflective Clothing in Power Transmission Engineering Construction Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The safety production management of power transmission engineering is an important guarantee for improving the infrastructure work of the power grid, and safety helmets and reflective clothing play a crucial role in protecting personnel's heads and bodies in the construction and production environment. The supervision of wearing safety helmets and reflective clothing is an indispensable link in high-risk working environments. For this purpose, this article designs a multi node transmission engineering helmet reflective vest recognition system based on machine vision. The system includes sensor nodes, center nodes, computing nodes, and a front-end panel program responsible for displaying information. The four programs communicate through the MQTT protocol and a built MQTT Broker program. The sensor node transmits the data of the connected camera to the front-end program through the MQTT protocol. At the same time, under the scheduling of the central node, the camera data is sent to the computing node for target recognition calculation using the YOLO algorithm to identify the wearing status of the personnel's safety helmets and reflective clothing in the image. The recognition result is then sent to the front-end program, which displays the camera image together with the recognition result. The research results of the paper not only accurately identify the wearing of safety helmets and reflective clothing by personnel during power construction, but also provide an effective solution for the design of intelligent monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Research on a Rapid Active Power Control Method for Wind Farms Based on Dynamic Operating Points
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The overuse of traditional fossil fuels has affected the living environment, and our power system is undergoing a period of transformation towards cleanliness. Therefore, it is an important issue to study the operation of wind farms by reasonably determining the operating point of the turbine and the control strategy to reduce the power loss due to the wake effect. This paper focuses on the working point of wind turbine under the wake effect, and establish the combined wind speed model. Divide the wind turbine operating state into four control intervals to model individual wind turbines. Introducing the wake effect, coupling the operating states of upstream and downstream wind turbines with the help of the Jensen wake model, introducing the wake superposition model, and modelling the wind turbine in the cases of no wake shading, full wake shading and partial wake shading, respectively. Based on some problems encountered in the optimisation process of the standard genetic algorithm, the standard genetic algorithm is improved, and a coordinated optimisation algorithm based on the genetic algorithm for wind farm dynamic operating point is proposed, and the axial induction factor is used as a decision variable, which realises the research of the wind farm control strategy with the maximum power as the optimisation objective. The current mainstream MPPT control strategies are introduced and compared with the algorithm of this paper. Aiming at the total output power of the wind farm station, the study explores the power effect of the wind farm under different optimisation schemes, and discusses the calculation method of the tail current of the wind farm under different incoming wind directions.

articleTitle: Method and Application of Energy Storage Spot Trading Based on Dual Settlement Market Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A decision method and software system are proposed of energy storage spot trading based on dual settlement market model, for operation scenarios of independent storage power stations operating within the market in scheduling mode under the dual settlement market model, based on the results of the electricity price forecasting model, and considering the charging and discharging schedule of the energy storage power station and the possibility of arbitrage in the market. Taking into account the charging schedule and discharging schedule of energy storage plant and the possibility of arbitrage in the market, we give the optimization decision scheme of self-scheduling of energy storage plant based on the algorithm of self-scheduling optimization decision module of energy storage plant under the dual settlement market model; and we also develop the auxiliary decision system of energy storage spot trading, with the aim of accomplishing the function of optimization of the decision-making of charging and discharging declarations of energy storage and to validate the validity of the approach introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Bidding Mechanism of Aggregated Buildings with Various Flexible Loads Participating in Demand Response Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of renewable energy resources, the regulation potential on the demand side is being harnessed to address the challenges of supply-demand balance. Buildings consume a significant proportion of electricity and possess various flexible loads, thereby they are regarded as the important participants in the demand response market. The market aims to determine appropriate regulation capacity and clearing price under different scenarios. However, the regulation costs of buildings vary with regulation capacity, and they need to be aggregated to satisfy the participation requirements, so an efficient bidding mechanism should be developed to coordinate the interests of both aggregators and buildings. At first, the piecewise model on regulation costs and regulation capacities is developed to indicate the variable relationships. Then, the bidding mechanism for buildings is proposed to generate the capacity-price curves, which can guarantee the regulation profits by regarding the maximum value as the price at different intervals. On this basis, the bidding mechanism for aggregators is proposed to formulate the capacity-price profiles, followed by the profits allocation method. Not only the aggregation complexity with lots of couples of capacities and prices is simplified effectively, but also can adjust profits between aggregators and buildings in accordance with practical situations. Lastly, the case study is conducted to prove the effectiveness of the proposed bidding mechanism, and the profits allocation method is also discussed to analyze its contribution to regulation performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reconfiguration of Microgrids Considering Mobile Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The global climate environment is gradually becoming harsher, meteorological disasters are occurring frequently, and the accident rate of the distribution grid is also growing. Distributed Generation (DG) and mobile energy storage vehicles, as an important part of the new power system, are worth exploring their potential for preserving supply during outage accidents. In this paper, a strategy to consider the participation of mobile energy storage vehicles in dynamic reconfiguration of microgrids under the distribution system is proposed. First, a static configuration model of the microgrid that maximizes the power restoration value is established by considering the formation constraints of the radial microgrid with DG as the power source. Then, considering the maximization of power restoration value in a long time, the scheduling model of mobile storage vehicles is introduced, and the microgrid dynamic reconfiguration strategy considering mobile storage vehicles is proposed. Case studies on IEEE 37 node power system are served for demonstrating the proposed strategy, and the results show that the proposed strategy can enhance the power restoration value in local outage accidents and ensure the continuous power supply of important loads under extreme disasters.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Carbon Emission Accounting Method for Multi-Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To achieve carbon neutrality and effectively record carbon emissions, it is imperative to establish a user-friendly and tamper-proof carbon emission accounting method. Considering that most of the existing studies focus on single loads, this study designs a multi-energy flow framework encompassing electricity, heating, gas, and cooling loads, and presents the corresponding user-side carbon emission models. In order to ensure the safety and traceability of carbon emission data, this paper proposes a user-side carbon emission accounting method empowered by blockchain smart contracts. By conducting several experiments in a simulation environment, this research analyzes the seasonal variation of user-side carbon emissions in Hengqin, China and verifies the feasibility of blockchain technology for carbon emission accounting.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Impact of Large-Scale Development of New Energy Storage on the Operation of Provincial Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: New energy storage is key equipment in energy internet. Provincial power grid enterprises play a significant role in serving the integration of new energy storage into the grid, optimizing scheduling and operation management, and improving the utilization of energy storage. Before entering the spot electricity market, the “low charge and high discharge” of new energy storage affects the sales revenue and purchase costs of provincial power grid enterprises. In order to accurately grasp the impact of the large-scale development of new energy storage on the operation of provincial power grid enterprises, and to sort out the scale, operation mechanism, and charge and discharge price of new energy storage development in Henan Province, the impact of new energy storage development on the company's operation in 2024 and 2025 is quantified and calculated based on two types of independent energy storage power stations and user-side energy storage, divided into two scenarios: limit and reality. Countermeasures and suggestions such as cost diversion, market construction, and optimized scheduling are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Risk and Investment Prediction Method for Power Grid Equipment Based on Asset Wall Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces the method for predicting operation and maintenance resources in power grid enterprises. Firstly, it provides the design principles and specific analysis process of asset mapping models based on asset wall theory. Then, it analyzes the method for selecting the lifespan of physical assets in power grid enterprises. It provides a Monte Carlo stochastic simulation based method for predicting operation and maintenance resources, as well as investment and operation strategy decision-making methods for asset wall prediction results.

articleTitle: Research on the Stage Division Standard for the Transient Response in Active Distribution Networks
