The results show that the proposed power supply strategy can realize three power supply modes, and the switching between modes is smooth, which effectively guarantees the continuity and reliability of the power supply of the diesel storage DC microgrid.

articleTitle: DC Fault Characteristics Analysis of Full DC Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Offshore wind power is the key to achieve carbon neutrality goal, and full DC scheme is a competitive choice for offshore wind farm integration. However, there are little researches focus on the DC fault characteristics of the full DC scheme. This paper firstly develops the equivalent converter model for fault characteristics analysis. Then the equivalent model of full DC offshore wind farm is derived. Based on fault path analysis, the fault development mechanism of full DC system is discussed. A full DC offshore wind farm is built in PSCAD/EMTDC and the validity of the proposed equivalent model proved by comparing the simulation results and analytical results.

articleTitle: Multi-Physical Field Coupled Method for Temperature Rise of Winding in Oil-immersed Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power transformer failures often result from elevated hot spot temperatures, which disrupt the regular operation of power systems. To precisely determine the hot spot temperature of transformer windings, this paper employs a 110kV oil-immersed power transformer as a case to develop a three-dimensional electromagnetic-temperature-fluid multi-physics coupling simulation model for the transformer. The core and winding loss density distribution is obtained through magnetic field calculations. On this basis, the loss density serves as the heat source, and temperature and flow field simulations for the transformer are conducted using thermal-fluid coupling. In addressing the issue of temperature discontinuity at the interface of fluid and solid coupled heat transfer, an adaptive grid refinement method is adopted to enhance grid resolution at the interface while employing a coarser grid in flatter regions, thus enhancing the precision of numerical simulations. Finally, the simulation results are compared with hot spot temperature calculations obtained through empirical formulas, confirming the method's feasibility.

articleTitle: Topology Identification of Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Signal Injection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power outage research, load forecasting, intelligent optimization, and other tasks related to the distribution network rely on accurate and comprehensive network topology information. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the low-voltage side of the distribution network and address the issue of decreased accuracy in topology identification caused by the integration of distributed photovoltaic systems, it is essential to not only identify the connection relationship between network nodes but also determine the distance relationship between these nodes. In this paper, we propose a method that utilizes pulse current signal injection to obtain the distance matrix between two nodes. By performing calculations, we obtain an information matrix that contains both the topological connection information and distance information. This allows us to identify the node connection relationship and distance relationship. The simulation results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in identifying both connection relations and distances.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of 550kV 1000H Grounded Reactor for Offshore Wind Power Flexible HVDC Transmission Projects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of offshore wind power projects in recent years, as a large-scale offshore wind farm group transmission mode, flexible HVDC transmission technology has the advantages of flexibility, reliability, and strong fault crossing ability. This paper focuses on the key technologies of 550kV 1000H grounded reactor products for offshore wind power flexible HVDC transmission projects. The structural characteristics of the products are analyzed, the insulation design and vacuum casting measures of the reactor products are discussed, and the insulation reliability of the products is verified through finite element simulation and test. The prototype model of 500kV grounded reactor developed in this paper has been verified by partial discharge test and insulation test, and the research results have guidance and reference significance for the research and design of ultra-high voltage class dry coil.

articleTitle: Compound Voltage Control Based on Ramp Charging Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper we come up with three-stage voltage control to solve the voltage overshoot, consist of OLTC (On-Load Tap Changer) BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) and PRPC (Photovoltaic Reactive Power Control) to strengthen control capability. As the amount of home energy storage increases, SOC (State Of Charge) unified management becomes more and more complicated. Therefore, slope charging algorithm is proposed to unify SOC, simplify management and extend battery life. Experiments show that this method can improve the quality of power grid effectively and simplify the SOC management process in the later stage.

articleTitle: The SOC Balance Scheme of Multiple Grid-Forming Converters Connected to the Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the widely use of distributed energies (DG), the power electronics converter, which interface the DGs and power grid, is becoming more important in the power grid. The grid-forming converter has been proposed to enhance the inertia of modern power system. Besides, it is promising to overcome the power fluctuation of DGs by using the energy storage systems. However, the state of charge of energy storage systems may encounter the unbalance when connected to the converters which are adopted to form the grid voltage. To suppress unbalance of state of charge among energy storage systems, a compensation control method in grid-forming converters is proposed in this paper. The proposed compensation control method is validated by the simulation system.

articleTitle: Modeling and Coordination Strategies for the Cluster Effects of Distributed Photovoltaic Power and Air Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On the one hand, the continuous high temperature in summer leads to a surge in electricity consumption, and even regional electricity shortages, which puts enormous pressure on the power grid's security. On the other hand, the explosive growth of electrical measurement data collected by data acquisition and monitoring control systems requires the integration of big data technology and power system models to analyze and to analyze and improve the operational performance of the power grid. This work summarizes various related studies on modeling and coordination of electric load clusters, such as distributed photovoltaic energy and air conditioning load, and introduces three related methods. Firstly, this paper introduces a method to maximize the integration benefits of new energy generation and demand response in the scenario of air conditioning cluster. Secondly, research on key technologies of ordered and electrically related correlation analysis is introduced. Finally, a distribution network power flow calculation model considering dynamic correlation is presented.

articleTitle: The Direct-drive Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator Based on an Improved VSG-controlled High Voltage Ride-through Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an expression of the relationship between the voltage of the grid-connected point of the direct drive permanent magnet synchronous generator and the reactive power demand of the DC transmission system is established for the scenario of direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) being transmitted through UHVDC. In order to improve the transient response characteristics of active and reactive loops controlled by conventional virtual synchronizers, a virtual synchronous machine control strategy based on transient current compensation is proposed, and the active and reactive loops controlled by the conventional virtual synchronous machine are improved. The improved control strategy is verified by PSCAD simulation to provide some active support to the transient voltage and power of the delivery system while effectively avoiding the large-scale off-grid of wind turbines in case of commutation failure faults in the DC system.

Author Keywords: direct drive permanent magnet synchronous generator

articleTitle: Distribution Network Precise Investment Strategy Based on Hierarchical Identification of Weak Links
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to find a precise distribution network investment strategy based on hierarchical identification of weak links, firstly, sensitivity analysis is carried out from two aspects of equipment failure parameters and distribution network characteristic parameters, and an analysis method of multi dimensional factors is proposed to identify the hierarchical weak links. Then, the investment cost and benefit of reliability improvement measures are calculated, and the precise investment strategy based on weak links is proposed. Finally, a city distribution network is selected for analysis. The sensitivity of reliability parameters is calculated, and the optimal investment strategy for each region is put forward. The results show that this method can identify hierarchical weak links and obtain the optimal investment. It is a feasible method for the distribution network transformation.

articleTitle: A Noval IR Drop Elimination Methond for Polarization Potential Detection of Grounding Grid in Homogeneous Soil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To address the lack of high-precision trenchless detection technology in current polarization potential detection of grounding grids, this paper proposes an IR reduction and elimination strategy based on the finite difference method. By arranging a reference electrode array on the surface to detect the second-order derivative distribution of potential within the range of the array, the IR drop in the polarization potential detection of the grounding grid can be calculated, and the measurement results can be corrected. At the same time, based on CDEGS simulation software, this article studied the IR reduction calculation accuracy of the proposed method under different reference electrode spacing, and concluded that the optimal spacing is 1/4 of the buried depth of the grounding grid. After simulation analysis, the detection accuracy of the polarization potential of the grounding grid at this spacing is better than that of the near reference method.

articleTitle: Effect of Incorporation of Air Gap to Depress DC Components in Current Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Current transformers with anti-DC component function are meaningful to achieve accurate measurements in power transmission systems. In this paper, new structure of magnetic core in an anti-DC component current transformer was studied. Ansys Maxwell is used to model and analyze the core structure of anti-DC transformers. Application of material with low and constant permeability in composite cores can expand the flux margin, and allow them to work properly in DC environment. Introduction of an air gap in the magnetic linkage in a high permeability core can reduce the permeability and improve its tolerance to saturation. A new structure with partial air gap in the magnetic core was designed to achieve anti-DC performance. Effect of geometry of the air gap on depression of DC components in a transformer was researched. The simulation results show that the integrated magnetic core with partial air gap can improve anti-DC characteristics in terms of accuracy and linearity. And the proposed magnetic core structure has potential to be manufactured with low cost.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Coordinated Source-Grid-Load-Storage in New Power System Based on Low-Carbon Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of China's “double carbon” goal, energy saving and emission reduction has become one of the primary strategic objectives of the current power industry. Aiming at the carbon measurement and low-carbon regulation operation of the new power system, a low-carbon demand response scheduling strategy based on carbon emission flow is proposed. First, we analyze the carbon emission influencing factors of each link of source-network -load-storage of the new power system. Firstly, we analyze the carbon emission influencing factors of each link of source-network -load-storage of the new power system, and establish an accurate carbon measurement model based on the carbon emission flow theory. carbon emission factor is used as a guiding signal to establish a low-carbon demand response mechanism for optimised dispatch. Finally, the proposed strategy is verified through examples to stimulate the carbon emission flow theory. Finally, the proposed strategy is verified through examples to stimulate the emission reduction potential of each link in the system, reduce carbon emissions and improve the rate of new energy consumption.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Transformer Based on WSO and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the diagnostic accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis model, this paper proposes a transformer fault diagnosis method with White Shark Optimizer (WSO) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Firstly, the uncoded ratio method is used to obtain the ratio of dissolved gases in transformer oil input to the support vector machine; secondly, the White Shark algorithm is used to optimize the two parameters (kernel parameter and penalty factor) affecting the diagnostic performance of the support vector machine; lastly, the method proposed in this paper is used to diagnose the faults of the transformer, and the results of the example simulation show that The support vector machine optimized by the WSO algorithm has higher fault diagnosis accuracy than the particle swarm optimization support vector machine and the ant colony algorithm optimization support vector machine. The average correct diagnosis rates of WSO-SVM, PSO-SVM and ACO-SVM are 91.6%, 86.7% and 87.5%, respectively, which validates the excellence of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Power Supplier Bids in Interprovincial Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power suppliers and consumers are the main participants involved in transactions of electricity market, whose bidding strategies are related to the operation of the entire electricity market. In this paper, the real-world data from a recent transaction in the interprovincial electricity market in China was analyzed. By using the capacity and price index (CPI) and herfindahl-hirschman index (HHI), the bidding behaviors of each province and its impact on the market price were analyzed. The results show that each province as a power supplier has different resource endowments, and there exists great difference among decisions of different provinces in power generating and bidding strategies. Moreover, some provinces as power suppliers occupy most market share, which has a decisive impact on the overall market price level, leading to a high degree of market concentration.

articleTitle: Line Commutated Converter Based on Integrated Gate Commutated Thyristor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: UHVDC transmission technology has been widely used in China. However, the commutation failure of multi-infeed HVDC systems has been a persistent issue affecting the safe and stable operation of large power grids. To address this problem, a converter based on the integrated gate commutated thyristor (IGCT) is proposed. By conducting a detailed analysis of the topology and commutation process of the IGCT converter, as well as comparing the steady-state and transient performance with a thyristor converter, it has been verified that the IGCT converter can effectively prevent commutation failure by actively turning off the current. This research paper reveals the principle of commutation area invariance in line commutation converters and offers a new direction for the application of IGCT in HVDC transmission technology. These findings hold significant theoretical and practical significance for establishing a safer, more efficient, and higher-power HVDC transmission system.

articleTitle: Transient Synchronization Stability Mechanism of PLL-Based VSC During Grid Fault Considering Different LVRT Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the stability issue of voltage source converter (VSC) interfaced renewable power system, the transient synchronization stability mechanism of phase-locked loop (PLL)-based VSC during low-voltage-ride-through (LVRT) process is analyzed in this paper considering two typical active power strategies, i.e. the zero active power strategy and the maximum active power strategy. The existence condition of stable equilibrium point (SEP) during LVRT is deduced. The PLL transient stability mechanism is revealed and the transient stability criteria are given based on virtual swing equation and the equal area criterion. In case study, a single-VSC-infinite-bus system is used to verify the theoretical analysis conclusion.

articleTitle: Unified Modeling of Physical- Cyber -Logic -Attack - Protection for Digital Substation by Extension of IEC61850 Logic Space Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: IEC 61850 provides an excellent physical-cyber-logic model for substation networked automation, to describe the data and logic relationships between atomic elements of physical power system as well as communication network and automation system. As a fact, cyber-attack and corresponding cyber security protection belong to information and communication technology whose behaviors are all automated, and targeting substation networked automation. Therefore, unified modeling of physical-cyber-logic-attack-protection for digital substation becomes necessary and possible. The existing cyber security protection system does not model functions according to 61850 logical nodes and logical devices, and IEC 61850 does not model function-based logical nodes for cyber security protection and attack behavior, which makes the security system not transparent. In this paper, the basic functions of cyber-attack and corresponding cyber security protection are decomposed into atomic scale, which are modeled as logical nodes to establish a unified 61850 logic space model for digital substations in the future.

articleTitle: Contact Pressure Calculation Based on Vacuum Contact Materials and Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Pressure of vacuum circuit breaker contacts should meet the requirements of contact resistance, and inhibit contact bounce when short-circuit current is flowing. However, the value of contact pressure is often obtained empirically. This paper analyzes the worst electrical contact conditions based on the contact resistance of the electrical contact surfaces, and propose a method to calculate the contact pressure based on contact material, radius and short-time current withstand, which is based on the melting of the conductive spots. Finally, hrough the comparison of several sets of working conditions, it is verified that the calculation method is effective.

articleTitle: Impact of Turbine Governor on Stability of Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Units with Full-Size Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The variable-speed pumped storage with full-size converter (FSC) technology, which can effectively provide services to a power grid and ensure the safe and stable operation of a power system, is one of the two mainstream variable-speed pumped storage technologies. In this paper, a simplified numerical simulation model for small disturbances of a system of a variable-speed pumped storage plant (VSPSP) with FSC under the power control strategy is built by applying MATLAB/Simulink. The state matrix of the system is derived, and a damping ratio is calculated to determine the stability region of turbine governor parameters. Numerical simulations of model power generation conditions are conducted to analyze the dynamic characteristics and investigate the impact of turbine governor parameters on system stability. The results demonstrate that, unlike conventional synchronous generators, under grid-connected conditions, inappropriate turbine governor parameters may still lead to governor instability in the system. This paper could contribute to a method for exploring the influence of parameters on the stability of VSPSPs with FSC.

articleTitle: High Share Participation of Grid-Forming InverterBased Resources in Grid Frequency and Voltage Support
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The call for a drastic increase in non-synchronous inverter-based resources (IBRs) like wind power, re-emerges challenges like voltage and frequency support. The conventional Grid-Following (GFL) controllers are unable to fully support the grid, hence hindering the higher integration of IBRs in power systems. Contrariwise, Grid-Forming (GFM) controls with Synchronous Generation (SG) -like abilities can potentially support the grid. Here a type of virtual synchronous machine called Synchronverter-based GFM (SynC-GFM) is adopted to investigate a system with a 98% share of IBRs. A comparison is drawn between extended Direct Voltage Control (DVC-GFM) and SynC-GFM. It was found that the SynC-GFM controlled and stabilized the voltages and frequency better when the system was exposed to a three-phase short circuit fault and sudden load change. Besides, the inertia constant and integral gain (inertia dual in voltage control loop) are adjustable, hence its variation impact on RoCoF and voltage respectively was also investigated. The test-bed system here is based on DigSilent PowerFactory software that contains two wind farms and SG sources. This study is hoped to be a gateway for a sustainable 100%-IBRs-based power system.

articleTitle: Electric Field Simulation of 120 kV Hybrid Commutation Converter Valve
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In an effort to improve the insulation reliability of the hybrid commutation converter valve tower and realize the optimized design of the converter valve's insulation under a small safety margin, this paper adopts the hybrid modeling technology of SolidWorks and ANSYS to establish a 3D model of the converter valve tower, and simplifies the model to facilitate mesh generation and calculation. 1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>V/m is selected as the fitting surface operation control electric field strength, and the electric field simulation of the single-valve insulation type test and the multi-valve DC voltage withstand test was carried out on the model. Then, its electric field distribution is obtained, so as to observe whether the electric field of the valve tower meets the requirements; Lastly, the correctness of the electric field simulation is verified by the insulation type test.

Author Keywords: fitting surface operation control electric field strength

articleTitle: Identification of Abnormal Users based on Isolated Forests during Electricity Price Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of electricity price implementation, users' abnormal electricity consumption will seriously lead to income decrease of power company. Therefore, it is necessary to choose a method with excellent performance to intelligently identify abnormal users in massive electricity consumption data. For this purpose, principle of isolated forest algorithm as well as its modeling steps are firstly analyzed. Then, based on data from electric energy data acquisition system, attributions used in screening abnormal users are extracted, and abnormal user identification model based on isolated forest is constructed, some index used in evaluating identification effect of the model is also given. Lastly, with data from field system, the proposed model is verified to be valid. And compared with other approaches, isolated forest algorithm is with higher identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Inertia Evaluation Strategy for Power System Partition Based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to realize the effective and rapid evaluation of inertia distribution characteristics of power system with new energy, this paper proposes an inertia evaluation strategy for power system partition based on GPU. The characteristics of new energy inertia sources in power system is analyzed. The power system is partitioned according to geographical factors. In the single partition the state-space model is identified by Numerical Algorithm for Subspace State Space System Identification (NASID). In order to meet the demands of power grid analysis and dispatching, accelerated calculation of inertia evaluation is realized by paralleling computing through GPU. Finally, The effectiveness and rapidity of the proposed strategy are verified by a detailed experimental test.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Management of Electricity-Heat-Hydrogen Integrated Energy System Based on Neurodynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the increasingly prominent multi-agent, large-scale and decentralized characteristics of the integrated energy system (IES), the traditional centralized optimization method that needs a global processor is no longer applicable. This paper adopts a distributed optimization method based on neurodynamics to address the energy management of the electricity-heat-hydrogen IES. The optimization results can converge within a limited number of iterations times. In addition, the validity and superiority of the method are verified through comparative analyses with results obtained from both centralized optimization methods and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). In response to the malicious eavesdropping behavior that may exist in the process of information interaction among agents in the system, a protocol incorporating noise item and secret function for information exchange is devised to provide effective privacy protection for transmitted data. Case studies based on a testing system are carried out and the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Method for Route Programming in Puzzle-Based Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, many energy storage-related enterprises have been facing difficulties brought out by the limitation of land and the increase in loan cost. As a promising approach to improving space utilization rate, puzzle-based energy storage systems (PBESSs) are drawing more attention from logistics researchers. In previous research about PBESS, concentration has been paid to single target item problems. However, there are no consensus algorithms to solve load retrievals route programming in PBESSs with multiple target items. In this paper, a heuristic algorithm is proposed to solve load retrieval route programming in PBESSs with multiple target items, multiple escorts, and multiple (Inputs Outputs) IOs. This paper defines new concepts about the proposed algorithm, including target IOs, target position of escorts, number of escorts required, et al. Then, the decision procedures are designed according to these concepts. Based on the Markov decision process, the proposed algorithm makes the decision of the next action by analyzing the current status, until all the target items arrive at the IOs. The case study results have shown the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed heuristic algorithm.

articleTitle: A Demand-Side Adjustable Resource Response Interaction Capacity Assessment Method Based on Scale-Space Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems such as the continuous increase of peak-valley difference of electric load, the fluctuation of new energy output and the tension of power supply at peak, considering the characteristics of image feature extraction and the demand response characteristics of adjustable resources, a method of evaluating the response and interaction ability of demand-side adjustable resources based on the theory of scale space is proposed. By utilizing the load data input into the scale space Gaussian kernel for convolution operation, the load characteristics of demand-side adjustable resources are obtained based on image matching, and the interactive capability of adjustable resource response is more conveniently portrayed. This has important application value for integrating decentralized demand response resources and awakening the potential of network-load interaction.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Importance of the Factors Affecting the Comprehensive Capacity of Power Selling Companies Based on Weight Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the improvement of user status and the transformation of power demand, it is urgent to improve the comprehensive capacity of power selling companies in the power market. This paper first constructs an evaluation index system for the comprehensive capacity of power sales companies, analyzes the factors that affect the power sales companies by using the analytic hierarchy process, and simulates the possible changes in the importance of indicators over time, guiding the power sales companies to focus on key indicators and improve their comprehensive capacity.

articleTitle: Identification of the Ground Wire-Suspension Clamp Damage Under the Effect of Lightning Current
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Effective identification of the ground wiresuspension clamp damage under the effect of lightning currents is crucial for protecting both the clamps and the ground wires, ensuring normal operation of electrical equipment. Currently, infrared temperature measurement technology is primarily used to measure the temperature of the overall ground wire-suspension clamp. However, it cannot determine the location of the most severe heat and the specific temperature. This paper proposed a mechanical temperature-sensing device to replace the platen of clamp (hereinafter “platen-type device”). It triggers the response of the clamp when the temperature of the prominent part of the clamp reaches the specified temperature. Firstly, a simulation model of the component is established. Then, lightning current excitation is simulated, and the results are calculated to determine the main heating area of the clamp and the temperature change curve. Experimental results demonstrate that the platen-type device reliably operates at 80°C, indicating high reliability. Therefore, it can be applied in lightning strand damage identification technology.

articleTitle: A Study on the Framework in Evolving Energy Trading from Web 2.0 to Web 3.0
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Energy Trading System is a platform that enables energy providers to participate in the trading market and gain profits. Historically, traditional energy sources such as coal-fired power plants, natural gas-driven power plants, and nuclear power plants have held a dominant position in the energy market. However, since the 2000s, the development of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), including solar panels and wind generators, has given rise to the concept of Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) and microgrids. These systems aggregate DERs for active participation in the energy market. In recent years, some aspects of Web 3.0, including AI and blockchain, have been incorporated into VPPs and microgrids. Nevertheless, the evolution of the new Energy Trading System is ‘Web 3.0-like’ but may not fully embody the spirit of Web 3.0 which aims to create a more open, equitable, and collaborative online ecosystem that empowers individuals. This article addresses issues, such as the transparency challenge, that run counter to the Web 3.0 spirit and proposes a framework for an open Energy Trading Market based on Web 3.0 principles to resolve these challenges.

articleTitle: Bidding Strategy for Pumped Hydro Storage Station Based on Information Gap Decision Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Pumped hydro storage station face uncertainty factors in price fluctuations when participating in market competition, resulting in certain market risks. The information gap decision theory uses an unknown uncertainty set to quantify the uncertainty of parameters, without the need for information such as probability distribution functions, and is an effective tool for dealing with un-certainty problems. In this paper, the Information Gap Decision Theory (IGDT) is introduced to deal with the market price uncertainty, and the bidding strategy for the day ahead energy and ancillary services market of pumped hydro storage station is proposed. Firstly, with the objective function of maximizing the revenue of pumped storage power stations, considering the power out-put, operating conditions, frequency regulation capacity, spinning reserve capacity, and upper reservoir capacity constraints of pumped hydro storage units, a deterministic decision-making model for the participation of pumped hydro storage station in the energy market and auxiliary service market bidding was established. Secondly, the deviation coefficient is constructed to measure the fluctuations of the market prices in the model, and the deterministic bidding model is modeled as a robust bidding decision-making model based on IGDT. Finally, case analysis shows that the participation of pumped hydro storage station in both the energy and auxiliary service markets can improve operational economy. At the same time, the bidding strategy for pumped hydro storage station obtained using the IGDT robust decision-making model can effectively manage market risks caused by market price fluctuations while ensuring market returns.

articleTitle: Short-Term Photovoltaic Prediction Based on Transfer Learning and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the proposal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, the proportion of renewable energy generation continues to increase and the number of new photovoltaic power stations is growing rapidly. Accurate photovoltaic power prediction is of great significance for the safe, stable and operation of power system. In order to solve the problem of insufficient historical data of newly constructed PV power plants, this paper proposes a short-term PV power prediction model based on Long Short Term Memory and transfer learning. The model uses meteorological data, numerical weather forecast data and PV power as features. According to the transfer learning theory, the Long Short Term Memory model is pre-trained using the historical data of other previously-built PV power plants, and then a small amount of local operation data is used to fine-adjust the model. Case study based on Hebei open source photovoltaic and meteorological data set proves that the proposed transfer learning model can effectively improve the short-term PV power prediction accuracy, and the MAPE can be improved by up to 15%.

articleTitle: Fault Segment Detection Method of Multi-Terminal Hybrid Overhead-Submarine MMC-HVDC Transmission Lines Based on Waveform Similarity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of offshore wind power, the emerging multi-terminal hybrid overhead-submarine MMCHVDC transmission lines system has become one of the important directions for the development of DC transmission technology today. Fault segment detection is essential for ensuring the protection of multi-terminal hybrid overhead-submarine MMCHVDC transmission lines to complete fault isolation and recovery. Consequently, studying the fault segment detection method of these lines is of great significance. Therefore, this article firstly analyzes the transient propagation mechanism of faults in the multi-terminal hybrid overhead-submarine MMC-HVDC transmission lines system of offshore wind farms. Then the differences in transient traveling wave propagation of different lines at faults occur are explored and the waveform characteristics of fault transient voltage at the measurement end of onshore converter station under different line section faults are qualitatively analyzed. Furthermore, the highly similar characteristics of transient voltage waveforms under faults in the same section have been revealed. Based on the similarity characteristics of fault traveling wave waveforms, the fault segment of multi-terminal hybrid overhead-submarine transmission lines can be detected by establishing a sample dataset of fault transient voltage waveform and using the waveform matching technology. Finally, the offshore wind power multiterminal hybrid overhead-submarine MMC-HVDC transmission lines system model, which is built using PSCAD/EMTDC electromagnetic transient simulation software, was simulated for various fault situations to verify the proposed fault section localization method based on waveform similarity. The results showed that the proposed method was feasible.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling and Sharing Model for Electric Vehicle Battery Swapping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have become more and more popular over the past decade due to their advantage of reducing carbon emissions and increasing penetration of renewable energy. However, the promotion of EVs is still facing challenges owing to battery material characteristics and inconvenient charging facilities, resulting in range anxiety among drivers. To address these challenges, battery swapping stations (BSSs) have emerged as a promising solution. There has been research on single BSS scheduling, however, multiple BSSs scheduling and battery sharing problems have not been taken into account yet. This paper presents a novel approach to optimize the scheduling and sharing operation of multiple BSSs based on user arrival data, with the aim of minimizing operational costs. The proposed model considers both the number of fully charged batteries to stock and the efficient charging strategies for swapped batteries, while emphasizing the importance of battery sharing mechanisms among BSSs to further reduce costs. The proposed model employs a genetic algorithm to solve the optimization problem efficiently. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheduling and sharing scheme in reducing operational costs and enhancing the efficiency of BSSs.

articleTitle: Power Frequency Breakdown Characteristics of C6F 12O/ Air Mixture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, the clean extinguishing agent perflourohexanone (chemical formula C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>O) is an alternative material for the elimination of electrical fires. In order to study the power frequency breakdown characteristics of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>O /air gas mixture under different working conditions, a breakdown experimental platform was built in this paper to obtain the power frequency breakdown voltage of the gas mixture under different working conditions. The results show that the breakdown voltages of the gas mixture increase by 12%~77% after adding 5% C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>O, and the breakdown voltages increase approximately linearly with the increase of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>O in the gas mixture. The breakdown voltages increase approximately linearly with the increase of pressure in the case of different electrodes. And the breakdown voltage increases significantly with the increase of pressure in the case of different gas gap distances, but when the uniformity is larger, the breakdown voltage grows more slowly.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Assessment of the Power System Blackout Source Events Damage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A Power System Blackout Source Events can trigger a power system great blackout, and its damage reflects the ability of the Power System Blackout Source Event to damage the system. To quantitatively assess the Power System Blackout Source Event damage, firstly, this paper describes the basic concepts of Power System Blackout Source Event and their damage; Secondly, based on the public safety triangle theory, a comprehensive assessment index system and calculation model which covers the ontological damage and functional damage are constructed, and the mutation level method is used for assessment; Finally, the rationality of the proposed index system is verified by the improved IEEE30 node arithmetic system, and the differences in the damage of different Power System Blackout Source Event are further compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Power Distribution of One-Machine, Dual-gun Charging Pile
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles powered by battery energy storage have become a new green and clean energy vehicle. To this end, the system structure of the 160kW electric vehicle charger is introduced, with two independent PWM and Buck converters, which can be charged with a single gun or with two guns, which improves the utilization rate of the charger and can output a wide range of DC voltage to meet the battery working voltage. MATLAB simulation and experimental results verify that the charger can effectively charge constant current and voltage.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Pressure on Bubble Movement in Silicone Gel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Silicone gel has sealing, viscosity, high temperature resistance and good insulation properties, and is widely used in the packaging of high pressure IGBT devices. The residual bubbles in the process of potting and degassing of silicone gel are easy to produce partial discharge or even breakdown, which seriously affects the insulation reliability of IGBT devices. The motion characteristics of bubbles in silicone gel during potting and degassing were studied in this paper. The motion characteristics of bubbles are simulated by VOF method. The results show that the bubbles in silicone gel are spherical and their trajectories are straight lines under different pressure changes. The bubble rises at a constant speed under normal pressure, increases rapidly during depressurization, decreases during pressurization, and increases slowly under vacuum. The research results in this paper provide guidance for bubble removal and degassing curve optimization of silicone gel in IGBT device potting and degassing process.

articleTitle: Power Control Strategy of Energy Storage System in Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In conventional substation DC systems, the common approach involves rectifying AC power and integrating battery energy storage technology. However, this traditional battery-only systems is plagued by challenges such as a short battery lifespan and diminishing capacity over time. In response to these issues, this paper introduces a hybrid energy storage system designed for substation DC systems. This innovative approach combines supercapacitors (SCs) and batteries, harnessing the respective advantages of these two energy storage technologies. Furthermore, the paper devises a power dynamic allocation strategy for the hybrid energy storage and a state of charge (SOC) management method for SCs. These strategies effectively address the limitations typically associated with traditional battery -only systems while also enhancing battery lifespan. The hybrid energy storage power sharing strategy presented in this paper not only resolves the shortcomings of existing substation DC systems but also contributes to the advancement of reliable and efficient hybrid energy storage solutions for critical substations.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Steelmaking Process Considering Multiple Electricity Bill Components
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The steel industry faces significant economic challenges due to increasing energy costs. To mitigate these challenges, steel plants can strategically engage in demand response to reduce their electricity costs by taking advantage of the time-varying electricity prices. However, electricity bills include not only time-varying-based components (e.g. wholesale electricity costs), but also capacity-based components (e.g. distribution network capacity costs), and constant components (e.g. government obligations). Therefore, responding solely to time-varying electricity prices cannot guarantee a minimal electricity bill. This study addresses this gap by introducing an optimal scheduling model for steelmaking considering multiple electricity bill components. Through case studies conducted in high- and low-level wholesale electricity price scenarios, our proposed approach is shown to be effective in reducing electricity bills and peak demand, implying its significance in improving cost efficiency and strengthening grid stability.

articleTitle: Oilfield Load Flexible Adjustment Characteristics based Optimal Operation Regulation Strategy of Multi-energy Complementary System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The multi-energy complementary system has become a hot topic in industry research due to its advantages of high energy utilization efficiency and low operating costs. There is limited research on multi-energy complementary systems in the context of oilfield well sites. This paper conducts research on the electrical and thermal load flexibility and its optimal operation regulation strategy for the Multi-energy Complementary System in Oilfield Well Sites. Based on the diverse load demand and heterogeneous energy endowment in oilfield well sites, an electric-thermal coupling interconnection structure is constructed. This paper studies the flexible model of electric and thermal loads in oilfield well sites, considering the integration of new energy consumption and electricity pricing mechanisms. Considering energy costs and system losses, an optimization operation control strategy for multi-energy complementary systems in oilfield well sites is established. Through a comparative analysis of case studies, the effectiveness of the optimization control strategy is validated.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Management for Multiple Data Centers in Transactive Electricity Market: A Cloud Federation Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The efficient operation of data centers necessitates a resource management strategy to cope with stochastic incoming workloads. Meanwhile, with an increasing amount of fluctuated data center loads integrated into the distribution network, it is critical to alleviate the deviation between actual and forecast data center demand to ensure economic grid operation. To this end, this paper proposes a cloud federation framework dedicated to managing workload uncertainties of multiple data centers as a coalition while mitigating their power deviations. In this framework, a model that can obtain the desired workload adjustment towards zero deviation for each data center is proposed. Upon receiving the workload adjustment willingness of all data centers, a cloud federation broker is responsible for determining the optimal workload migration among data centers with complementary deviation patterns. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed cloud federation framework, as the total penalty cost decreases by 35.2% and the average power deviation decreases by 57.5% compared to no federation case.

articleTitle: Evaluating Reserve Capacity for Electric Vehicles Based on User-Intention Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are seen as important demand-side flexible resources to provide ancillary service for the power system with the gradual spread of EVs. However, evaluating response capacity of EV s is difficult to determine in advance due to the uncertainty of user intentions. To solve the above problem, the model of reserve capacity evaluation for EV s based on user-intention uncertainty is investigated in this paper. Firstly, overview user intention and constructe probability distribution functions of typical user intentions based on historical data. Generate uncertainty scenarios through the Monte Carlo method combined with Latin Hypercubic Sampling and reduce scenarios by the fast antecedent elimination method of probability distance to obtain the scenario set. Then, the reserve capacity evaluation model of EV s is proposed, which is dealt with stochastic optimization mothed under uncertain scenario set of user intentions. Finally, the case study is carried out to verify the correctness and effectiveness of proposed models.

articleTitle: An Accurate Auxiliary Monitoring Method for Substation Environment Based on Dynamic Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous change of engineering requirements and the deepening of research on prefabricated compartments, the existing extensive environmental monitoring and control technology of prefabricated compartments has a large room for improvement. In this paper, an accurate auxiliary monitoring method for substation environment based on dynamic simulation technology is proposed. Through thermal simulation, the working effects of different existing temperature control modes are compared. Then feasible optimal control schemes for temperature and humidity, energy consumption and noise of prefabricated chamber are studied in combination with practical engineering applications. So as to effectively improve the monitoring and control level of prefabricated chamber environment. Finally, through technical and economic analysis, the optimal precast environment dynamic accurate monitoring scheme is determined.

articleTitle: A Scenario-Based Transfer Learning Approach for Stable Distribution Network Structure Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable energy sources and dynamic loads, short-term voltage stability (STVS) issues have become increasingly prominent in distribution networks. Network structures have been recognized to play a critical role in the voltage stability of power systems. To identify stable distribution network structures for STVS enhancement, we propose a scenario-based transfer learning approach that considers various operating conditions and critical internal faults. First, we generate typical fault scenarios by using the K-means clustering method. Then, we develop a scenario-based transfer learning algorithm that efficiently trains a convolution neural network (CNN)-based STVS evaluation model for each scenario with small datasets. Moreover, a complex network-based method is employed to select representative network structures for sample generation. Numerical results on the IEEE 33-bus distribution network models verify the high reliability of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Transmission Communication Method for Client-Side Heterogeneous Resource Information Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we firstly analyze the characteristics of customer-side heterogeneous resources and put forward the demand for unified modeling of customer-side heterogeneous resources; then we study the transmission process of sending and receiving packets in unified information model, put forward improved Hoffman coding, improve Hoffman coding through the LZ77 algorithm, and design the sliding window for distributed compression of data, which is processed in parallel through multiple windows to greatly improves the compression efficiency. Realize fast communication for information model transmission.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Method of Integrated Energy System Considering Virtual Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES), contributing to energy utilization and system economy, is characterized by multi-energy complementarity. Firstly, the paper studies the energy transportation model of heat and cold system. Secondly, considering the system cost and network loss, by analyzing the flexibility and storage characteristics of heating and cooling load, a new IES optimization scheduling method considering virtual energy storage of heating and cooling network is proposed. Finally, IES system is designed and compared with different case to verify the validity of IES optimization scheduling model. The experimental simulation results show that by considering the virtual energy storage characteristics of the cooling and heat supply network, the energy can be transferred across time periods and the system economy can be effectively improved.

articleTitle: Fault Line Selection Method for Non-effectively Grounded Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to deal with the issue of low accuracy of the single-phase ground fault line selection method in conventional non-effectively grounded distribution network, this paper proposes a Gramian Angular Field and convolutional neural network (CNN) method. First, the Gramian Angular Field is used to convert the one-dimensional zero-sequence current signal into a two-dimensional image to form a single-phase ground fault data set. This method retains the original data characteristics and makes the fault characteristics more prominent and facilitates CNN processing. Then, the two-dimensional CNN is trained by inputting a training set, and then input into a test set for testing. Finally, the parameters are optimized to obtain the ideal results by repeated training iterations. The experimental data show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has a higher accuracy comparing to other methods in distribution network.

articleTitle: Oscillatory Stability Analysis of Direct-Drive Wind Power Grid-Connected Systems During Fault Transient Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the unclear oscillation mechanism of the direct-drive wind-grid-connected system during the fault transient, this paper proposes an oscillation stability assessment method based on the negative energy gradient and reveals the influence of the control link parameters on the oscillation stability. Firstly, the port energy function of the direct-drive wind grid-connected system during fault transient is constructed considering the oscillation component. Second, an oscillation stability criterion based on the negative gradient of system energy is proposed. Then, based on the oscillation stability criterion, the influence of key parameters on the stability of the grid-connected system is analysed, and the parameter influence law of the grid-connected system during the fault transient is obtained. Finally, a direct-drive wind power grid-connected system model is constructed on the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform to verify the correctness of the analysis results, which show that the proposed criterion can accurately determine whether the system is stable or not, and the increase of the phase-locked loop integral and proportional parameters is not conducive to the oscillatory stability, while that of the current inner-loop integral and proportional parameters is conducive to the oscillatory stability.

articleTitle: Multiphysics Coupling Simulation Calculation of Anode Saturable Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a key equipment in the converter valve, the anode saturable reactor has to withstand the high-order harmonics generated by the thyristor when its turning-on and turning-off state, which will cause the vibration of the reactor. In this paper, a simplified model of anode saturable reactor is established for vibration and sonic analysis. First, the magnetization characteristic and the magnetostrictive characteristic of the silicon steel sheet are measured. Second, a multiphysics coupling model is established, and the measured data are used into the simulation calculation. Third, the simulation results are analysed and compared with experimental data. The results indicate that the model can basically fit the experimental vibration, which has certain guidance for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Overvoltage and Insulation Coordination of $\pm 500\text{kV}$ Offshore Wind Power Flexible DC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the fast development of offshore wind power technology, for the sake of increasing the security and dependability of wind farm operation, this paper mainly investigates the overvoltage and insulation coordination of offshore wind power grid-connected flexible direct transmission system. Firstly, the structure of offshore wind power network system is introduced. Then, employing the simulation platform PSCAD/EMTDC, based on a domestic engineering parameter, a simulation model of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm \mathbf{500}\mathbf{kV}/\mathbf{2000}\mathbf{MW}$</tex> flexible DC transmission system is established. According to the actual engineering situation, the typical fault condition setting, the voltage observation points setting and the arrester configuration scheme are expounded. Finally, the insulation level of the key equipment in the flexible DC converter station is obtained by simulating the key fault conditions and calculating the overvoltage level of each observation point and selecting the appropriate arrester parameters. The research results provide basic technical support for engineering implementation, and also provide reference for solving practical engineering problems.

articleTitle: The Enlightenment of Foreign Energy Storage Market Development Experience to China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of energy storage is still in its early stages, and a series of policies have been formulated both domestically and internationally to support its development. Compared to China, countries, and regions such as the United States, Europe, and Australia have more mature policies and business models related to energy storage, effectively promoting the rapid development of energy storage, which has certain reference significance for China to promote the large-scale development of energy storage. This article introduces the situation of the United States, Europe, and Australia from the perspectives of industrial development, policy support, fiscal and tax subsidies, and market rules. It compares the actual situation in China and combines the demand for energy storage development in the construction of new power systems to propose inspiration and suggestions for the development of domestic energy storage.

articleTitle: A Projection-based Clustering of Flexibility Resources for Peak Load Shaving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand response is an effective means for peak load shaving in power systems. Clustering flexible resources is necessary to implement demand response due to the inability to directly manage resources with small capacity and large quantity. However, existing clustering models cannot accurately portray the adjustable region of flexible resources, resulting in poor performance in peak load shaving. Hence, this paper proposes a projection-based cluster approach of flexible resources. First, the high-dimensional adjustable region of each flexible resource is projected to the low-dimensional region corresponding to peaking periods. Second, a large number of resources are clustered into several aggregators using the extreme points of low-dimensional regions. Last, these aggregators are scheduled by the dispatch center to shave peak load. The numerical results show that the proposed approach achieves a better performance in peak load shaving compared to traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Generation Schedule Generation Method Based on Joint Clearing of Electric Energy and Operational Reserve
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to guarantee the overall benefit maximization under the stepwise clearing of electric energy and reserve, a generation plan generation method based on joint clearing of electric energy and reserve was studied. From the two dimensions of grid absorption capacity and unit regulation capacity, the coupling characteristics between electric energy and reserve are analyzed. On this basis, combined with the needs of centralized optimization, the coupling relationship between electric energy and reserve is divided into two types: static relationship and dynamic relationship. A centralized clearing model considering the static coupling characteristics is constructed to obtain the electrical energy and reserve operation plan of the generator set. Furthermore, considering the dynamic relationship, the cleaning results are checked until the generation planning results that meet the coupling characteristics requirements are obtained. Finally, a numerical example based on IEEE 30-node system was constructed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The example results show that the proposed method can avoid the problem that the clearing results do not meet the operation requirements caused by factors such as the limit of power grid transmission capacity, and improve the effectiveness of the joint clearing results.

articleTitle: Distribution Pattern and Differentiation Thresholds of Gas Content in Large Oil-Filled Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the existing threshold calculation methods, there are problems such as establishing distribution models based on large group data of different types of oil-filled equipment, or specifying the threshold using normal dissolved gases analysis (DGA) data of some individuals while fault data of others, etc. In order to address these problems, this paper proposes a differentiation gas content threshold calculation method applicable to large oil-filled equipment individuals. The method is based on the gas content normal data and fault data of individuals of oil-filled equipment, establishes parameter model based on the Weibull distribution to fit the data, and uses the inverse cumulative distribution function and the P-R curve to calculate and select the reasonable thresholds as the attention value and warning value. The differentiated thresholds are obtained for five kinds of large oil-filled equipment individuals, and compared with the traditional threshold calculation method, the thresholds obtained by this method are more effective in identifying defects and faults, and can significantly reduce the occurrence of false alarms and omissions.

articleTitle: Self-Organizing Aggregation of Massive Distributed Flexible Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed flexible resources show a trend of massive development, which will be a blue ocean participating in power grid active power balance. However, how to effectively utilize these distributed flexible resources with the characteristics of small, large and scattered, and reach their full potential, faces the problem of efficient organization of massive resources. Thus, this paper proposes a self-organizing architecture based on social networks and a dispatch process from ISO, which can aggregate those massive distributed flexible resources into self-organizing group efficiently and conveniently. The key technologies about self-organizing group are analyzed from four aspects: attraction, portrait, matching and response, including the reference ideas and implementation methods of each key technology.

articleTitle: Research on Charging Control of Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on New Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to cope with the load operation problem of large-scale electric vehicles connected to the grid, it is necessary to optimize the load of charging and switching stations through orderly charging so as to promote the consumption of wind power. In this paper, an EV charging optimization method considering the wind power consumption problem is proposed. Firstly, this paper establishes an EV charging optimization model; secondly, based on the wind power generation and EV charging demand, considering the change of wind power generation and the dynamic adjustment of time-sharing tariff, and taking the difference between peak load and valley load is minimal and the minimum user charging cost as the control objectives, it constructs an EV sequential charging model; finally, it adopts the improved particle swarm algorithm for optimization and solving, and puts forward the case of the entirety of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Nearshore Wave Prediction for renewable energy: Initial Results with Remote Sensing and Buoy Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wave energy offers a promising source of clean and renewable power with wide-ranging applications. This paper focuses on the prediction of nearshore waves, aiming to understand their complex characteristics and behaviors. Accurate nearshore wave predictions are essential for activities like maritime planning and coastal development. Our study explores the relationship between Sentinel-2 Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) data and ground truth buoy measurements using linear regression. Additionally, we investigate the connection between Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and buoy measurements, employing the same linear regression approach. However, we find that linear regression, while useful, is not fully suited to tackle the complexity of nearshore wave prediction. The results indicate no relationship between NDWI values and buoy data. The SAR data exhibits an existing linear relationship with buoy data, however, it is a weak relationship. These findings underscore the potential of SAR for future research in this field. In the next phase of our research, we will further explore the use of Sentinel-1 SAR, either independently or in combination with Sentinel-3 altimeter technology, within a Regression Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN). This approach aims to better capture the nature of nearshore waves by combining the non-linear visual characteristics of the SAR images while also implementing the continuous data provided by the SAR and buoy data. In summary, our work contributes to understanding nearshore wave behavior and prediction. We emphasize the need for more advanced modeling techniques to address the intricate nature of nearshore wave prediction in the future.

articleTitle: Resource Loss Detection Method for Fixed Power Virtual Power Plant Considering Spatio Temporal Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Resource shortage detection can avoid the phenomenon of abandoned wind and light in distribution network. In order to fix the performance of resource shortage detection on power demand side, a fixed resource shortage detection method considering temporal and spatial correlation is proposed. Using outlier data mining algorithm, the outlier data of power demand side resources are obtained, and the power load is predicted by normalizing the power load data. The multivariate normal distribution is introduced to analyze the time correlation of wind farm output, and the Copula function is used to analyze the spatial correlation of wind farm output, thus completing the time-space correlation analysis of wind farm output. The fixed power demand side resource tracking filter is used to suppress the eigenvectors of missing resources, and combined with cluster analysis, the fixed power demand side resources are classified and tested, and the constraint conditions are obtained through expectation operation, so as to realize the detection of missing resources on the fixed power demand side. The experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the resource utilization rate of fixed power demand side and the energy storage capacity of energy storage device to above 90% and above 800 kW·h respectively.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influence of Contamination and Wear on the Surface Discharge Characteristics of Insulated Blankets Used in Live Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In distribution network live operations, insulated blankets are often used for insulation shielding to protect the safety of operators. In order to study the influence of surface contamination and wear on the insulation performance of the insulation blanket during operation, resin insulation blankets were selected for experimental research. The main components of the surface contamination and wear of the in-service insulation blanket were analyzed, and artificial simulation experiments were carried out on test insulation blankets with different degrees of wear and contamination. The surface discharge characteristics of the insulation blanket under different degrees of wear, contamination and discharge spacing were studied. The test results show that the wear and contamination on the surface of the insulation blanket have little effect on the leakage current; the more severe the wear and contamination, the more the discharge voltage of the insulation blanket decreases, and the greater the influence on its insulation performance. Therefore, in actual live operations, attention should be paid to the cleaning of the surface of the insulation blanket.

articleTitle: A Cluster Control Simulation Method for High Penetration Distributed Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of node voltage overruns and voltage fluctuations of distributed PV power plants connected to the distribution network, and the current power communication network faces the challenge of not being able to effectively control access with PV centrally, a cluster control method for distributed generation is proposed. This method divides the optimal cluster according to the electrical distance of distributed generation (DG), takes the constraint range of node voltage and power and the economic level of input equipment as the cluster optimization objective, and calculates the sensitivity of each voltage within the divided cluster, selects the one with the highest integrated sensitivity as the dominant node of the cluster, and for the nodes that do not meet the constraints, the cluster with the largest reactive power margin and sensitivity factor with the dominant node is selected, and the dominant node voltage control is carried out to regulate the voltage. Through the cluster division, the most suitable nodes can be found to maximize the reactive power compensation for the nodes with voltage overrun, which can effectively improve the stability of the distribution system operation and solve the problem of voltage overrun. IEEE 33 node distribution system as an example for simulation and analysis, to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this method, can solve the problem of uneven distribution of node voltage.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization and Evaluation of Integrated Energy System Operation Considering Time Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the face of the gradual depletion of fossil energy sources and the increasing demand for energy by human beings, the Integrated Energy System (IES), which is centered on the electric power system, promotes the consumption of renewable energy sources and realizes the complementarity of different energy sources by coupling various energy sources, such as electricity, gas, and heat, etc. However, IES brings great flexibility to end-users through the coupling of multiple energy sources, and at the same time poses challenges to the reliable supply of energy. However, IES brings great flexibility to end-users through the coupling of various energy sources, and at the same time brings challenges to the reliable energy supply of the system. Therefore, in this paper, we firstly construct an operation optimization model of IES considering time constraints; then, we randomly sample the system states and calculate the corresponding reliability indexes of energy supply. Finally, the reliability and economy of the IES under different operation modes are evaluated through case analysis, so as to provide a theoretical analysis basis for the construction of the actual park.

articleTitle: Low-Order Frequency Response Modeling for Offshore Wind Farm-MTDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing penetration of Renewable Energy Sources (RES) and (Multi-Terminal) High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) is challenging the system frequency stability. The RES such as Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) are being required to automatically provide frequency regulation support for the main grid. A Low-Order Frequency Response Model (LOFRM) is proposed for the complete Wind Farm (WF)-MTDC system in this paper. First, a high-order model that can be regarded as the virtual governor turbine is developed for the WF-MTDC system whose structure is similar to that of conventional generators. An LOFRM is then proposed to surrogate approximately the high-order model, whose parameters are determined by using a regression-based numerical method. The results show that the proposed LOFRM can properly approximate the complicated high-order model, and be acceptable if used for stability analysis and even maybe optimization problems.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Peaking Approach with Electric Vehicle Cluster Participation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a rapidly growing new type of load, electric vehicles (EVs) can give full play to their bidirectional response capability through orderly regulation of EVs, which in turn can assist in grid peaking. It becomes a feasible measure to alleviate the grid peaking pressure by regulating electric vehicle clusters (EVC), but at the same time, the disorderly charging and discharging of EVs will bring about the anti-peaking phenomenon and the problem of decision variable explosion.
