To address the above issues, firstly, with the objective of minimizing the sum of peaking cost, generation cost, wind energy curtailment cost and load fluctuation cost, the model of EVC participation in power system peaking is established to determine the charging and discharging tasks of EVC; and then, the model of individual task allocation is established to formulate the optimal charging and discharging strategies for individual EVs under the scheduling tasks; Finally, it is solved by the multi-objective aggregation peaking method. The results show that the multi-objective aggregation peaking method can ensure the economy of the grid and users under the premise of satisfying the peaking demand.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Power Grid Analog Device for Voltage Adaptability Test of New Energy Transmission Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of new energy in China, UHV AC-DC hybrid cross-region transmission has become a typical feature of China's power grid. When continuous commutation failure occurs in the DC transmission system, it will cause serious fluctuations in the voltage and frequency of the new energy transmission grid, and even lead to the collapse of the power grid. Therefore, the voltage adaptability test of the new energy transmission terminal grid is an important index of access to the grid. In order to meet the needs of the voltage adaptability test of the new energy transmission terminal grid, a power grid simulation device is proposed to simulate the phenomenon of voltage and frequency fluctuations, so as to realize the continuous crossing of high and low voltage and frequency disturbance test. By adopting the double closed-loop control scheme of instantaneous value of voltage and current, and introducing negative feedback current feedforward into the inner current loop, the dynamic response of the inverter is accelerated, and the response of voltage disturbance and frequency disturbance is realized quickly, and the voltage can be accurately controlled from 0.2p.u to 1.3p.u within 10ms. In this paper, by using PSIM simulation system, a power grid simulation device model is built to verify the feasibility of the control strategy, and the field test in Golmud new energy power Station in Qinghai province further verifies the reliability of the simulation device.

articleTitle: Interaction Stability Analysis between the Grid and the Voltage Source Controlled Direct-Driven Wind Turbine with Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To address the issues of lacking frequency regulation and susceptibility to instability of high-proportion wind power system, this paper proposed a voltage source control strategy for the direct-driven wind turbine with energy storage on the DC side. Then, the output impedance of wind turbine is built, and interaction stability is researched based on the frequency-domain modal analysis method. Next, the interaction mechanism between the voltage source controlled wind turbine and the grid is revealed based on the complex power coefficient method. Research results show that functions of inertia response and primary frequency regulation are able to be achieved through the added control loops in the energy storage converter, without affecting the wind turbine's operation mode of maximum power point tracking. Besides, ancillary control loops in the energy storage converter can improve the voltage source controlled wind turbine's stability margin. Finally, the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis and control strategy are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An Optimal Scheduling Model for Orderly Charging and Discharging of Electric Vehicles Considering New Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the” dual-carbon” target takes effect, the electric vehicle industry and renewable energy are developing rapidly. However, the widespread integration of electric vehicles into the power grid may lead to grid instability concerns, and on the other hand, the uncertainty surrounding renewable energy capacity restricts its potential for increased share in the overall energy mix. The friendly interaction between electric vehicles and the grid has limited the development of both industries to some extent. Therefore, this study introduces an optimal scheduling model for electric vehicle charging and discharging, considering new energy consumption, and formulates systematic strategy for charging and discharging electric vehicles, so as to improve the overall system revenue while enhancing new energy consumption.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Methods of Key Parameters for Regulating the Heat Supply in District Heating System with Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data-driven accurate regulation of heat supply plays an important role in the operation of district heating system(DHS), but there is a problem of insufficient data in actual DHS such as newly built or technologically innovated boiler rooms and heating substations, which affects the accuracy of regulation. In this paper, a prediction method of key parameters for regulating the heat supply with data augmentation is proposed, firstly, a data generative model established based on the diffusion model, then a prediction model for key parameters is establish, and the training data of the prediction model is augmented by the generative model so as to improve the accuracy of the prediction model. The method proposed in this paper was validated and practically tested in a heating substation and an electric boiler room in Beijing, the prediction bias of the secondary loop supply temperature (SLST) and the primary loop valve opening (PLVO) of the heating substation were reduced by 9% and 5% respectively, and the prediction bias of the active power of the electric boiler was reduced by 5%. The research in this paper shows that the prediction method of key parameters for heat supply regulation with data augmentation can effectively improve the prediction accuracy and provide support for improving the level of accurate regulation of heat supply.

articleTitle: A Clearing Model for Cross-Provincial Spot Market Based on Network Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the increase in the proportion of distributed energy resources and the reverse distribution of source and load in China, it is necessary to organize large-scale cross-provincial power transactions to achieve optimal allocation of power resources. The graph theory method can effectively solve the problem of optimizing the cross-provincial electricity trading path. However, existing graph theory methods only consider Kirchhoff's current law and ignore Kirchhoff's voltage law in the construction of trading paths, which makes the model results infeasible in practice. Therefore, this paper introduces the transfer constraints of transaction paths and transmission channel power flow into the cross-provincial market model based on network flow, ensuring the feasibility of the solution in practical operation. An illustration case is designed to show how the method works. The case study shows that the proposed model can find the optimal solution and effectively ensure the physical execution of clearing results. At last, the conclusion of the example analysis and the prospect of future research are given.

articleTitle: Fast Modeling Algorithm for Power Systems Based on RSCAD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of modern power system, the requirements for safety and stability are becoming increasingly strict, and the requirements for simulation accuracy are also increasing. Quasi-steady state models are usually used in electromechanical transient simulation, which have enough simulation efficiency and can meet the requirements of daily planning and research. Therefore, most power grid data is currently stored in electromechanical data such as PSASP. However, electromechanical transient simulation cannot accurately describe the dynamic characteristics of the AC/DC system during asymmetric faults in the AC system. Electromagnetic transient simulation such as RSCAD can accurately simulate the switching process of power electronic components, which is more suitable for simulation analysis of modern power system. However, there is often a lack of RSCAD electromagnetic transient simulation models in practical calculations, which require manual re modeling in RSCAD based on PSASP electromechanical transient data, and the problems such as high workload, low efficiency, and error susceptibility are caused. In response to the above issues, an automatic conversion program which can automatically recognize the data exported from PSASP and generate corresponding RSCAD models is proposed in this paper. Through simulation verification of WSCC9 power system, the effectiveness of the conversion program is demonstrated, which can significantly improve modeling efficiency and is great practical significance in engineering.

articleTitle: Heavy Overload Warning of Distribution Station Area Based on VMD-LSTM-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of load prediction and heavy overload warning, and prevent overload and fault occurrence in distribution station area, a heavy overload warning strategy based on VMD-LSTM-CNN is proposed. This strategy first decomposes the original load sequence by applying the VMD algorithm. Secondly, the LSTM network is used to analyze the time series features of each component, multiple prediction results are obtained, and the feature extraction and data feature learning are carried out through the CNN and the fully connected layer respectively to obtain the final load prediction results. Finally, according to the load prediction results, it is converted into an early warning level to realize the early warning of heavy overload. Through the data verification of a distribution station area in a certain area of Hebei, the research results show that the proposed basic strategy can accurately predict the load of the distribution station area and timely warn the risk of heavy overload operation. The successful application of this early warning strategy will play a positive role in promoting the safety and reliability of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Objective Complementary Operation of Wind-Photovoltaic-Cascade Hydropower Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper takes three kinds of renewable energy sources, namely cascade hydropower, wind power and photovoltaic power, as research objects, and explores the short-term scheduling of hydro-wind-photovoltaic complementary system based on the characteristics of energy forms and their operation. Firstly, considering the randomness of wind power and photovoltaic, a typical scenario generation model for wind power and photovoltaic is established with the help of Latin hypercube sampling and the fast backward reduction algorithm, which concludes that there is a certain degree of complementarity between wind power and photovoltaic, but the degree is weak, and even exacerbates the fluctuation of system output, so that cascade hydropower is added as a flexible power source for compensatory regulation. Taking the minimum fluctuation of residual load and maximum utilization of water resources as objective functions, a hydro-wind-photovoltaic complementary scheduling model is established, and solved by the GUROBI solver. The results show that when cascade hydropower participates in dispatching, the fluctuation of residual load is reduced, which has obvious effect on calming the fluctuation of wind power and photovoltaic, which not only enhances the power grid's ability to track load changes, but also maintains the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Distribution Strategy for Wind Power and Hybrid Energy Storage Combined System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of voltage fluctuations caused by renewable energy sources connected to the power system, this paper proposed a reactive power distribution strategy for a combined system of wind power and hybrid energy storage. The strategy divided the power allocation process into three layers. The first layer is to receive the reactive power command and convert it to the reference reactive power target. The second layer is the preliminary allocation of reactive power between wind storage integrated units by using an equal margin allocation method. The third layer is the internal allocation of the wind storage integrated unit. In the third layer, a type factor is introduced for measuring the energy storage reactive power capacity. And the reactive power target is allocated proportionally. Finally, the effectiveness of the strategy is verified through simulation. This strategy can improve power quality by fully utilizing the reactive power regulation capabilities of wind power and energy storage devices.

articleTitle: Insulator Defect Detection in Power Transmission and Transformation Based on the Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Insulators play a crucial role in both power trans-mission and transformation scenarios, and leveraging object detection to analyze insulator defects in images holds significant value for power production. This paper focuses on the distinct aspects of candidate box processing in object detection models, utilizing the diffusion model for perceptual understanding of images to enhance the model's performance in insulator defect detection. The proposed model demonstrates a performance improvement of +6% and 2.9% over Faster R-CNN and DETR, respectively, in power transmission insulator defect detection. Similarly, in power transformation insulator defect detection, the model achieves improvements of +5.8% and +1.7% over Faster R-CNN and DETR, respectively, thereby achieving state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: A Staged Strategy for MMC Offshore Converter Station Under Asymmetric AC Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, offshore wind power has become an important development direction for wind power generation. Offshore wind farms often use high-voltage direct current transmission technology with modular multi-level voltage source converters (MMC-HVDC) to transmit electricity to the grid. However, the fault response characteristics of offshore wind farms through the MMC-HVDC transmission system are different from those through AC transmission way. Therefore, it is significant that studying the fault ride through (FRT) technology of offshore wind farms through the MMC-HVDC grid connection system for practical engineering. An electromagnetic transient simulation model for an offshore wind farm composed of a direct drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (D-PMSG) connected to the grid is established through MMC-HVDC transmission technology. The mechanism and suppression strategy of overvoltage generation in the transmission network are provided during the fault clearance and recovery phase of the offshore wind farm HVDC transmission system under AC asymmetric faults. A two-stage improved control strategy for MMC-HVDC offshore converter station in response to asymmetric faults has been proposed, which is beneficial for the joint system to quickly recover from the post fault system voltage and suppress the overvoltage risk during the fault clearing phase. Finally, the proposed strategy is validated based on a domestic ± 500kV project in China, demonstrating its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Online Reconciliation Method for Short-Term Hierarchical Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hierarchical load forecasting (HLF) is a type of multi-load forecasting problem with cumulative consistency, which is usually decomposed into multiple single load forecasting and hierarchical optimization problems. However, the prediction results of this model are often biased. In addition, compared with offline learning methods, online learning methods are considered to be a more effective and adaptive prediction method. In this paper, we propose an improved reconciliation method on batch and online model that guarantees unbiased prediction results. Case studies on the power load data of one province in China shows that this method is superior to traditional methods in terms of prediction accuracy and adaptability.

articleTitle: Influence of Carrier Phase Difference on Supraharmonics in Grid-Connected Photovoltaic System with Parallel Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage source converters (VSCs) can generate supraharmonics in grid-connected photovoltaic system (GCPVS). Parallel VSCs with common AC and DC links have been widely applied, and supraharmonics in GCPVS can show new characteristics due to unsynchronized carrier signals. Therefore, dual-reference dynamic phasors (DRDPs) and dual-reference dynamic phasor sequence component (DRDPSCs) are adopted to analyze the new characteristics of supraharmonics and realize accurate calculation on the relationship between supraharmonics and carrier phase difference. First, the dynamic phasors (DPs) and dynamic phasor sequence components (DPSCs) are transformed into DRDPs and DRDPSCs by implementing double Fourier decomposition. Second, a harmonic analysis model of GCPVS is proposed. Then, the influence of carrier phase difference on supraharmonics is calculated and analyzed. Simulation results verify the correctness of the analyses.

articleTitle: Modeling of Three-Winding Transformer Based on Shifted-Frequency Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of small step-size and low efficiency of traditional electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation of power system, a large-step shifted frequency-based EMT (SFEMT) simulation method has been proposed in literature. However, there is still a lack of SFEMT model for three-winding transformer, which makes it difficult to realize SFEMT simulation of large-scale ac power grid. To this end, an SFEMT simulation model of three-winding transformer is proposed. First, the principle of SFEMT modeling and simulation is introduced. Then, the SFEMT models of three-winding transformer are constructed, respectively. Finally, the proposed models are tested on both small-scale and large-scale systems and the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed model of three-winding transformer are validated.

articleTitle: Hybrid MMC AC Side Smooth Start-Up Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters are currently the mainstream topology in flexible HVDC projects. Compared with half-bridge MMC, hybrid MMC has DC fault ride through capability, and has economic cost advantages over full-bridge MMC and has broad application scenarios. At present, the main problem of hybrid MMC is that it is difficult to start smoothly, and it is difficult for the full-bridge sub-module and half-bridge sub-module to achieve capacitor voltage balance during the AC side start-up process, and the converter is easy to generate inrush current when unlocked, threatening the system safety. In order to solve the above problems, a three-stage AC start-up scheme is proposed, which can ensure that the half-bridge submodule and the full-bridge submodule can reach the self-absorbed energy voltage during the charging process, and the proposed dynamic grouping and sorting algorithm can improve the calculation efficiency of the traditional sorting algorithm and accelerate the capacitor-voltage balance process. The proposed method is verified by ADPSS, an electromagnetic transient simulation platform independently developed by China Electric Power Research Institute.

articleTitle: A Novel Modular Multilevel Converter-Based Hybrid Photovoltaic and Battery Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale development of photovoltaic (PV) requires the PV grid-connected system to have the ability to actively support the grid. The existing PV converter topology has problems of small capacity and weak transient support ability. This article proposes a novel converter topology (HMMC) that integrates PV and battery into the submodules of modular multilevel converter, which can effectively enhance the capacity of a single converter. Based on the analysis of the capacitor energy and energy storage energy inside HMMC, a grid-forming (GFM) control strategy for HMMC was designed, which can achieve self-synchronous operation and support grid frequency and voltage. The effectiveness of the proposed topology and control strategy was verified through simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordinated and Optimal Allocation Strategy of Power- Storage-Load in Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasingly severe ecological pressure, distributed energy resources such as photovoltaics and wind energy have developed rapidly, and people's willingness to use and develop pollution-free distributed renewable green energy is unprecedentedly strong. However, large-scale and high-proportion distributed new energy access will bring huge changes to the distribution network, directly affecting the safe and reliable operation of the distribution network. In order to achieve better integration of these distributed generation resources, based on the new energy distribution status and multiple application scenarios in Haining Jianshan New Area, this paper proposes a coordinated control method of the Power-Storage-Load in virtual power plants, which can significantly reduce the complexity and dimension of operation control, ensure the global coordinated operation of the system, realize the autonomous control of hierarchical partitions, tap the utilization potential of adjustable resources, and further improve the safety, stability, scalability and comprehensive efficiency of active power distribution system operation.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Forecast of Wind Power in High Wind Scenarios of Cold Wave Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the proportion of installed renewable energy in the power system increases, the weather attributes of the new power system become more and more. And the current meteorological changes are becoming more and more complex, with frequent occurrence of cold wave weather, triggering large fluctuations in wind power output. The traditional wind power forecast method is difficult to adapt to the cold wave weather scenario. The large deviation of the forecast brings a great challenge to the wind power consumption. In this paper, we analyze the characteristics of wind power forecast error fluctuation and the mechanism of error generation based on wind power forecast and measured data during cold wave weather. On this basis, we extract the wind power data and numerical weather prediction data under the cold wave weather, and select the strong correlation meteorological factors based on the Pearson correlation coefficient to determine the inputs of the forecast model. Use the generative adversarial network algorithm to expand the samples, so the wind power dataset under the cold wave weather is constructed. Finally, the quantile regression wind power probabilistic forecast model based on the support vector machine is constructed, and an example is set up to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Resource Allocation Method for Power Systems Considering the Characteristics of Nuclear-Storage Joint Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the fact that the vigorous development of renewable energy (RE) can effectively alleviate the increasingly serious world energy crisis, RE such as wind power, photovoltaic and nuclear power (NP) may become the main energy to support the power system in the future. However, wind power and photovoltaic power generation are easily affected by environment, weather and other factors, and have great uncertainty, which is not conducive to the peak regulation (PR) of the power system, and it is difficult to meet the needs of rapid response to load changes. For the benefit of solving the problem of insufficient peak regulation capacity of nuclear power, it can be considered to establish a long-term bundling cooperation mechanism with a certain capacity of PR power supply, and jointly carry out PR to match the actual load changes of the power system. In this paper, according to the characteristics of NP, the operating characteristics of NP units are proposed, and then as a part of the local power planning model, considering the optimal configuration of NP and energy storage system (ESS) for local power planning. Through the verification of the XJTU-ROTS test system, it is proved that the combined peak regulation of nuclear-storage can effectively improve the regulation ability of nuclear power units.

articleTitle: Material Parameters Optimization of Suspension Porcelain Insulators with Cylindrical Head
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of UHV transmission technology, disc type suspension insulators with cylindrical head have attracted wide attention due to their advantages of light weight, good stability, good weather resistance and easy mass production. However, further research is needed to select appropriate material parameters in order to improve electrical and mechanical performance of porcelain insulators with cylindrical head. In this paper, the influence of cement, porcelain and steel parameters on the electric field and stress distribution of the insulators is studied by finite element simulation. And the optimized material parameters are obtained to minimize the maximum electric field and stress of porcelain parts by using the coordinate search method. After optimization, the maximum electric field strength of the porcelain part decreased by 6.47% while the maximum first principal stress of the porcelain part decreased by 21.44%. The research provides guidance for the selection of insulator parameters in the industrial production.

articleTitle: Application of One-Key Sequence Control Transformation and Efficient Acceptance Technology of Substation Based on Evidence Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the digital reform of the power grid and the “two alternatives”, landing continues to be promoted, a key to the sequential control of technology, while the grid operation and inspection experts of the State Grid Corporation continue to explore the main means of development. At present, the power grid company adheres to the principle of “change when you can” to carry out the promotion and application of one-key sequence control, which is through the prefabrication of the operation project software, the modular structure of the operation content, and the automatic identification of the equipment state, fail-safe interlocking intelligent calibration, automatic sequential execution of the operation process, the traditional manual filling of the operation ticket will be based on the cumbersome, repetitive and easy to misoperation. It transforms the traditional manual filling of operation tickets into a cumbersome, repetitive and easily misoperated reverse gate operation mode into a “one-button sequence control” operation mode, reducing the operation time from 60 minutes to 20 minutes. The operation and maintenance costs are significantly reduced and work efficiency is effectively improved. Based on the current one-key sequence control family planning budget in the process of substation reconstruction and expansion project application, the one-key sequence control transformation scheme and verification technology are studied and applied, and it is found that 100% correctness.

articleTitle: ADRC Limited Power Control Strategy for Single Stage Photovoltaic Inverter Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: After the large-scale grid connection of photovoltaic power generation, the volatility and randomness of photovoltaic power generation will have an impact on the traditional power grid. Therefore, it is necessary to limit the power generation of photovoltaic power generation systems and inject stable power into the power grid to reduce the impact on the power grid. This article proposes a combined control strategy of maximum power tracking (MPPT) and limited power control based on auto-disturbance rejection (ADRC) technology for single-stage photovoltaic inverter systems, achieving flexible control of grid connected power generation in single-stage photovoltaic inverter systems. Simulation has verified the effectiveness of this control strategy in situations of light changes, limited power changes, and grid voltage fluctuations.

articleTitle: Simulation-Based Analysis of Active Infrared Thermography for Detecting Internal Void Defects in Silicone Rubber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Silicone rubber (SIR), a commonly used polymer insulation material in power systems, requires timely detection of internal defects. Active infrared thermography (AIT) technology, as an emerging non-destructive testing technique, holds significant potential for detecting internal defects in SIR. In this paper, we conducted simulation research on the thermal wave propagation characteristics of internal air-filled defects in SIR. We systematically analyzed the relationship between thermal wave propagation features and the depth and size of defects in the time, space, and frequency domains. Firstly, from a time-domain perspective, we analyzed the temporal characteristics of thermal wave propagation, deriving the relationship between temperature during the cooling phase, temperature deviation time, and defect depth and size. Secondly, in the spatial dimension, we analyzed the defect outlines in thermal images and their relationship with defect depth and size. We also measured defect size using the full width at half maximum method and determined the relationship between measurement errors and defect information. Finally, we analyzed the relationship between defect size, depth, and frequency domain characteristics. This research work establishes a connection between thermal wave features and defect information, providing a theoretical basis for quantitatively measuring internal defects in SIR using AIT.

articleTitle: A Wind Power Forecasting Method Using Causal Inference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Most wind power forecasting is based on neural networks (NN) techniques. In this work, we use a causal inference approach in wind power forecasting techniques. First, the results from numerical weather prediction (NWP) are analyzed using potential-outcomes models from causal models. Then, based on the results of the causal discovery, the meteorological data obtained from NWP are judged and filtered by the variables that have a causal effect on the wind power output. Finally, the strength of the causal effect of each variable will be quantified and used as the basis for a new algorithm to optimize the wind power output forecasting method. Case study is a forecast analysis based on one year's NWP data from a single wind power plant.

articleTitle: Classification of Frequency Disturbance Event in Power Systems Considering Optimal PMU Placement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system frequency disturbance events are caused by various generation and transmission events, including generator tripping, load disconnection, line tripping, etc. Accurately determining the frequency disturbance events is of great significance for the subsequent reasonable suppression measures and improvement of grid stability. In this paper, we take advantage of the far-reaching development of deep learning to establish a convolutional neural network model applied to the IEEE 39-bus system, in which frequency, voltage, rate of change of frequency, and relative angle shift are converted into images as inputs to the model, to detect the events accurately and directly; furthermore, we propose a greedy algorithm embedded in the optimized arrangement of PMUs trained by a deep learning model, which is based on the optimally ranked PMU node feature data as inputs in the context of partial observability. PMU node feature data as input to obtain the most suitable PMU placement location under partial observability, and ultimately the FDEs classification is achieved accurately, quickly, and economically.

articleTitle: Modeling of Carbon Emission Features of Electric Energy Substitution Users with Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the condition of electric energy substitution, the features of carbon emission of users are affected by various factors such as energy consumption characteristics and demand response. This paper proposes a method for analyzing the features of carbon emissions in response to user participation. Firstly, the mathematical model of the adjustable capability of the user key electric energy replacement equipment is constructed. Secondly, sequential energy usage models that cover interruptible and shiftable loads are built. Finally, the modeling method of user carbon emission features considering user energy characteristics and demand response is presented. Through the case study, it can be seen that the carbon emission of electric energy substitution users fluctuates in the time sequence. The reduction periods and potentials of carbon emission among three typical users are different, and the carbon emission reduction can be achieved through complementary utilization.

articleTitle: Thermal Fault Detection of Power Equipments with Low-Rank Tensor Decomposition and Guided Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This work introduces a thermal fault detection method with low-rank tensor decomposition and guided filter (LRTD-GF). This method contains two main steps. First, based on the sparsity of the thermal fault and low rankness of the image background, thermal fault detection is modeled as a low-rank tensor decomposition, and an initial detection result can be obtained. Then, a guided filter technology produces the initial detection result, utilizing the spatial correlation between pixels in the spatial domain to improve the detection performance. Experiment results demonstrate that the LRTD-GF method has obvious advantages in detection accuracy, compared with other widely used anomaly detectors.

articleTitle: Interzonal Carbon Emission Flow Minimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Global warming necessitates a shift towards low-carbon power generation. Despite significant advancements in this arena, research on inter-regional carbon emissions remains limited. To bridge this research gap, we introduce the Interzonal Carbon Emission Flow Minimization (ICEFM). This method, grounded in the carbon emission flow theory, aims to curtail carbon emission factors during inter-region transmissions. By tracing the origins of electricity it effectively reduces inter-zonal carbon emission factors. We employ genetic algorithms to tackle the non-convex nature of the ICEFM problem. Empirical evaluations validate our approach, highlighting its capability to diminish interzonal carbon emissions and optimize the use of renewable energies during dispatch.

articleTitle: A Three-Phase Hybrid Transformer Topology and Its Control Strategy for Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid transformer topology and its control method for active distribution networks. The hybrid distribution transformer consists of transformer windings and a back-to-back converter. The transformer windings are composed of a high-voltage winding, a low-voltage winding, and a control winding. The back-to-back power converter is formed by connecting two fully controlled SiC inverters in a back-to-back configuration. Its two AC ports are connected to the high-voltage and control windings through filtering inductors. When the hybrid transformer is used as a distribution transformer in an active distribution network, the low-voltage side can seamlessly switch between voltage-frequency control and active-reactive control strategies based on the comparison between the renewable penetration level and the renewable hosting capacity of the distribution network. This allows for constant voltage-frequency control when the renewable penetration level is low, and bidirectional power flow control when the renewable penetration level exceeds the hosting capacity, thus ensuring the safe integration of renewable generation systems and improving the power quality of active distribution networks.

articleTitle: Evaluation Study of Deep Learning-Based Models on Probabilistic Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Probabilistic load forecasting (PLF) aims to predict the probabilistic distribution of the future power load. It can provide useful information for supporting upper-level uncertainty-aware energy management applications. In recent years, taking advantage of their strong ability to extract nonlinear patterns from time series data, deep learning models have been actively applied in PLF tasks. This paper provides a mechanistic introduction to the application of deep learning models in PLF tasks. Based on this, it evaluates the performance of several common deep learning models on an Australian public residential power load dataset. The experiment result reported in this paper is expected to provide a reference to students, researchers, and engineers in the related fields.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Method of Multiphase Generator Based on Low-Phase Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the improvement of power supply requirements, multiphase generators with low voltage, high power and high reliability have attracted more attention. However, the complexity of mathematical model of multiphase generator increases greatly with the increase of phase number, which brings challenges to simulation modeling. In this paper, a modeling approach of multi-phase generator using the existing low-phase generator model is proposed. The method is verified by modelling a six-phase generator from three-phase model as an example. Firstly, the mathematical model of the standard double Y-shift 30° six-phase generator is expounded. And then the three-phase generator model is introduced. Finally, a six-phase generator model based on two three-phase generators is built in Matlab/Simulink. Compared with the standard dual Y shift 30°six-phase generator model, the external current characteristics of the load step test from the proposed model is consistent, which verifies the modeling idea proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Adaptive Smoothing Optimization Method for Dynamic Load Shedding Based on CVaR under Photovoltaic Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy like photo-voltaic (PV) introduces uncertainty and variability to power grids, jeopardizing stability. In order to optimize dynamic load shedding and lessen such risks, this research offers a conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) model under PV uncertainty. To improve the computation efficiency, we then propose an adaptive smoothing method (ASM) to solve the CVaR model by smoothing maximal function. Extensive experiments on the IEEE-RTS79 system show that the proposed ASM method solves the CVaR model more efficiently than the traditional linear programming method (LPM) and direction solution method (DSM). In terms of reliability assessment indicators, the ASM method significantly outperforms the LPM method and the DSM method. Overall, the CVaR model can be successfully solved using the proposed ASM method based on smoothing technique to identify the best dynamic load shedding strategy under PV uncertainty.

articleTitle: Steady-State Performance Modeling and Simulation Analysis for All-DC Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of DC collection scheme in wind farms will effectively reduce losses and improve operational reliability, which has practical engineering significance. The study of all-DC wind power system is in the early stage, and there are still many aspects for optimization especially in system's control scheme. Therefore, this paper takes the all-DC wind power system as the object. This paper first introduces the mathematical models of the key equipment, including the DC wind turbine generator (DC WTG), DC/DC converter and MMC inverter. Then, this paper adopts a steady-state control scheme under different wind conditions. Finally, a 10 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MW}/30\text{kV}$</tex> all-DC wind power system model is established in Matlab/Simulink, the simulation results of steady-state opeartion verify the feasibility and accuracy of the adopted steady-state control strategy in all-DC wind power system, which is of guiding significance for the future project.

articleTitle: Stealth FDIA Localization in Power Systems Using Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Stealth false data injection attacks (FDIA) pose enormous threats to cyber-physical power systems. These attacks exhibit spatial stealthiness, making it challenging for existing bad data detection to accurately locate them. In this paper, a novel Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (STGNN) model is proposed to detect and locate FDIA accurately. First, FDIA is proposed to be generated by regional state estimation where only measurements and topology parameters specific to the attacked area are required. Then, state estimation is performed to convert line flow signals into node state signals to reduce the impact of noise with redundant measurement information. Finally, STGNN is proposed to extract the temporal and spatial features. The proposed model is evaluated on an IEEE 14-bus system. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high-resolution localization of FDIA leveraging the STGNN model.

articleTitle: Electricity Markets with Complex Orders: A Review of Theory and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of the electricity markets that use combined block and hourly orders. As power systems evolve and electricity market reforms progress, there is a growing need for more flexible and diverse bidding mechanisms. One possible way to address this need is to adopt the European model of block orders with complex orders, which can accom-modate various preferences and constraints of market entities. This paper examines the different types of trading products, their features, benefits, and impacts on market behavior and bidding strategies. Finally, through concrete examples, we illustrate the effectiveness and advantages of these trading products, and provide insights for establishing a market system with complex orders.

articleTitle: Hybrid Time Domain Simulation Based on Numerical Integration and Holomorphic Embedding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Time domain simulation plays an important role in power system transient stability analysis. The time domain simulation based on numerical integration has the advantages of mature research and strong adaptability, but its computational efficiency is low.The time domain simulation based on holomorphic embedding has the advantage of high computational efficiency, but its simulation step size and order are difficult to determine, and it is difficult to balance computational efficiency and stability.In order to combine the advantages of the two methods, a hybrid time domain simulation method based on numerical integration and holomorphic embedding is proposed in this paper. The proposed method discrete the differential algebraic equations by numerical integration to obtain a set of algebraic equations, then select the appropriate root solution and embedding method to solve the algebraic equations according to holomorphic embedding method. Simulation results on IEEE9-bus system show that the proposed method has higher computational efficiency than the time domain simulation method based on numerical integration and Newton-Raphson, and the simulation step selection strategy of the proposed method is the same as that of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on Location Selection of Power Grid Material Distribution Center Based on Entropy Weight TOPSIS Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This article establishes a site selection index system for power grid material distribution centers from three dimensions: economy, transportation, and environment. By using the TOPSIS entropy method based power system material distribution center location evaluation model, the location selection scheme for the four locations of power system material distribution was optimized, effectively improving the rationality and scientificity of distribution center location selection.

articleTitle: Research on Strategy of Voltage Sag Mitigation With Configuration for Dynamic Voltage Restorers in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of the optimal configuration scheme for dynamic voltage restorers (DVR) in distribution networks. The allocation of DVRs serves as an important mean to mitigate the voltage sags that frequently occur and seriously affect the distribution networks. The strategy of the configuration for DVRs have always been concerned by investors, and the appropriate investment decision-making recommendations for DVRs are beneficial for investors to reduce the cost of investment on the premise of satisfying certain governance effects. Therefore, based on the investigation of the current market price of DVRs, the strategies of the configuration for DVRs are given in this paper. The simplified models for series DVR and parallel DVR have been analyzed, and the optimal sizing and placement model for DVRs is implemented to compute the optimal configuration scheme for DVRs. Then, considering the major factors influencing the configuration scheme, including the market price and the proportion of sensitive loads capacity in all loads, the optimal configuration schemes for series DVRs and parallel DVRs are calculated respectively under varying conditions. Finally, the configuration schemes are categorized into three configuration modes and the optimal configuration mode under diverse conditions are summarized for practical application.

articleTitle: Internal and External Collaborative Dispatching Optimization Model of Micro Grid Cluster Considering Response to Superior Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: After meeting its own supply and demand balance, micro grid can respond to dispatch demand of the superior power grid according to the surplus output. However, a individual micro grid has weak response capability and poor anti-interference. To address this situation, this paper proposes an internal and external collaborative dispatching optimization model of micro grid cluster considering the response of superior power grid. First, the basic operating structure of micro grids is introduced, which responds to the superior power grid by aggregating multiple micro grids with similar locations in a clustered manner. Second, an internal dispatch optimization model is established with the objective of minimizing the operation cost, and the external diffusion response capability is measured according to the self-optimal dispatch plan to achieve the internal and external collaborative dispatch optimization. Finally, a certain area in southern China is used as an example for arithmetic demonstration to verify the model validity. The results show that compared with a single micro grid, the ability to respond to the superior power grid can be significantly improved in a clustered manner.

articleTitle: Capacity Planning of Park Integrated Energy System Considering Carbon Market Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Park Integrated Energy System (PIES) efficiently integrates multiple energy sources to meet the load demand, making it a practical approach for achieving low-carbon energy systems. PIES planning and research are crucial steps in ensuring the economic and low-carbon operation of the energy system. Based on the calculation of carbon emissions, consideration is given to PIES participation in carbon market transactions and the introduction of a ladder-type carbon trading and green certificate trading mechanism. Subsequently, a bi-level planning model is established with annual total cost and daily operating cost as objectives, and the NSGA-II algorithm and the CPLEX solver are employed to solve the capacity planning problem for various types of equipment in the PIES. The results of a case study have validated the feasibility and applicability of the proposed PIES bi-level capacity planning model.

articleTitle: Locational Marginal Electricity-Carbon Price Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An electricity-carbon coupling market clearing model was established in the paper, where the deviation cost of wind power output is introduced into objective function in the formulation to evaluate the uncertainty of wind power. Carbon-related costs and constraints are considered together to balance electricity economy and decarbonization. Based on this model, locational marginal electricity-carbon prices (EC-LMP) containing the uncertainty component of wind power were derived by Lagrange multiplier. Examples are utilized to analyze the impact of wind power uncertainty on EC-LMP quantitatively.

articleTitle: Optimization Design and Dynamic Compensation Strategy of Inverter Parallel Virtual Impedance Based on Residual Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the power imbalance problem caused by the difference between the equivalent impedance of the inverter and the line impedance, and the power quality problem caused by the disturbance of load mutation, unbalanced load and nonlinear load, this paper proposes a closed-loop feedback dynamic compensation strategy based on the equivalent virtual impedance of the residual generator. Firstly, based on the parallel topology of inverters, a quasi-steady-state model is established on the dq axis. Based on the model, the power imbalance caused by the difference of output impedance and line impedance of different inverters and the power quality problems caused by load switching, unbalanced load, nonlinear load and other disturbances in parallel inverters are analyzed.Secondly, a residual generator is established based on the inverter model. A virtual impedance equivalent controller Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vir</inf>(S) based on the residual generator is designed by the Luenberger observer principle. The disturbance information is fed back in real time through the feedback structure, and then the virtual impedance is adjusted to realize the power sharing of the inverter parallel system. Then, based on Euler parameterization and coprime factorization theory, a dynamic compensation architecture based on residual generator is designed. The transfer function of the dynamic compensation controller Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">com</inf> (S) is obtained by model matching to realize the steady-state operation of parallel inverters and the improvement of system power quality. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed architecture is verified on the experimental platform.

articleTitle: Lifespan and Carbon Cost of Battery Storage in Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The widespread use of energy storage batteries alarms the consideration of its operational characteristics. In addition to measuring the lifespan of batteries based on the number of charges and discharges, their capacity loss during use has also to be addressed. To avoid situations where the real capacity in operation fails to meet the planned capacity for use, this paper proposes a life-constrained battery energy storage system (BESS) planning model that takes the storage degradation into consideration. To enable this planning model, a linear approximation of the battery degradation process is first proposed, which can be embedded into its battery operation model and in turn the planning framework. Alongside, the carbon cost of the entire life cycle of energy storage batteries can also be calculated, which facilitates the precise carbon calculation of energy supply. Simulation shows that the proposed purposed life-constrained BESS planning helps to accurately assign the battery size for its real use, and at the same time reduce the carbon emission of the whole system.

articleTitle: Equivalent Modeling of PMSG Based Wind Farm for Subsynchronous Oscillation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind farms typically consist of numerous wind turbines connected through a collector network. Constructing an appropriate equivalent model is crucial for understanding the oscillation mechanism while preserving key characteristics. To this end, a full-order linear model of a wind farm based on Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) is created using the graphical block modeling method. By applying the principle of similarity transformation, an equivalent model capable of maintaining dominant oscillation characteristics is derived. The findings indicate that this equivalent model accurately retains the dominant oscillation features, reduces model complexity, and enhances simulation efficiency.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Modular Multilevel Converter Considering Damping Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wideband oscillation problem of modular multilevel converter (MMC) has received much attention. It is difficult to effectively consider the harmonic interactions using traditional modeling and analysis methods, and there is a lack of analysis methods for the stability of the system in steady state. In this paper, a harmonic state-space model of MMC is established based on its linear time-periodic model. Considering the influence of damping sensitivity, the characteristic root stability contribution index is proposed to realize the discrimination of the trend of stability change of the MMC system in steady state. And then the key state variables affecting the stability of the system are analyzed. The method is validated with the time-domain simulation for the test case using MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Offensive and Defensive Game Method for FDIA on Power CPS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of information and communication technology has made the power system a typical cyber physical system (CPS). While the grid-side control is becoming more and more intelligent, the power CPS is also facing the risk of potential cyber-attacks. In this paper, the feasibility of the false data injection attack (FDIA) against power CPS is first analyzed, and then a game-theory-based staged dynamic defense method for key measurement devices is proposed for the multi-stage dynamic interaction process between the attacker and the defender. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by IEEE standard system examples.

articleTitle: Application and Verification of Trusted Computing for Substation Automation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for applying trusted computing on substation automation equipment. The method builds trusted hardware and integrates the TPCM module on the CPU board of the substation automation equipment, making the TPCM the root of trust and gradually passing on the trust chain through the trust chain construction method. At the same time, dynamic and static trustworthiness methods are used to enable the device to eventually enter a trusted execution environment. A trusted computing management method for embedded automation equipment in substations has also been implemented. The trusted verification test shows that this method can achieve trusted verification without affecting the original functions and performance of the device, and the trusted verification accuracy reaches 100%.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Model Repair of DNN for Power System Transient Stability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Deep Neural Network (DNN) has been introduced to power system transient stability assessment (TSA) and achieved quite remarkable success. However, since the DNNs are ‘blackbox’ models, it is very hard to reveal misbehaviors of the DNNs and repair them to get better performance. To address these challenges, this paper proposes to use Arachne, a fresh program repair technique for DNNs, to repair TSA DNNs. Arachne can fix DNN's specific misclassifications at little cost to overall accuracy. In TSA, missed detections is more severe to the system than false alarms due to the conservation requirements. Case studies have demonstrated the usefulness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Denoising of Partial Discharge Signals in Converter Valves Based on Improved Wavelet Threshold
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Converter valves is one of the key equipment in the power system, and online monitoring of partial discharge is one of the important means to evaluate the operating status of converter in real-time. This paper introduces two improved methods proposed domestically and internationally and proposes a new threshold denoising function to remove interference in partial discharge signals of converter valves. The simulation experimental results of signal denoising show that these improved methods have better denoising performance than the soft threshold function and the hard threshold function. Among these five threshold functions, the newly proposed threshold function can achieve the best denoising effect by simply changing the variable parameter and is more flexible than traditional threshold functions. It provides a new choice for wavelet threshold denoising, allowing the advantages of wavelet threshold denoising methods to be more fully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study and Application of New Rock Dumping Protection Technology for Ultra-Long Suspended Submarine Cable
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Rock dumping has been successfully applied in submarine cable protection, while there is currently no experience in rock dumping construction on for super large, suspended submarine cable. This paper focuses on the handling of the hidden danger of a large suspended submarine cable in the South China Sea, conducts an force analysis of the submarine cables under the impact of falling stones, and develops a detailed process program and quality control requirements for rock dumping protection. A new method has been proposed that the rock dam designed as “bottom layer “M” rock dam + inner layer of small rocks + outer layer of large rocks”, which has pioneered the completion of the rock dumping protection and repair of oversized suspended submarine cables. That is a brand new construction technology and the first successful application on oversized suspended submarine cable in China.

articleTitle: Optimal Joint Bidding and Pricing of Electricity Retailers Using Multi-agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In real electricity markets, it is more valuable and difficult to study the optimal decision-making of a price-maker entity than those of a price-taker entity. This paper concerns with the optimal joint bidding and pricing problem of a price-maker electricity retailer. After formulating the original optimization problem into a Markov decision process (MDP), a novel multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) approach is proposed to solve for the optimal joint bidding and pricing strategy. Two agents are responsible for the bidding strategy and pricing srategy respectively. Numerical results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method. Insightful comparative analysis is also conducted for price-maker and price-taker cases.

articleTitle: Towards Zero Emissions: Coordinated Energy Management and Flexible Voyage Scheduling for Hydrogen-Based Multi-Energy Vessels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rising concerns over pollution from vessels and the implementation of stringent environmental regulations, hydrogen-based vessels have emerged as promising and optimal solutions for waterborne transportation. However, current re-search primarily focuses on utilizing onboard fuel cells solely for electricity generation, and the valuable thermal energy they produce is often neglected, leading to potential onboard energy wastage. Additionally, as multi-energy mobile microgrids, the pivotal role of flexible voyage scheduling as an adaptive electrical demand response still needs to be explored for hydrogen-based vessels. In response to these gaps, this paper proposes a coor-dinated energy management and voyage scheduling method for zero-emissions vessels (ZEVs), taking into account the combined heat and power generation of hybrid fuel cells. To minimize overall operational costs, the waste heat recovery of hydrogen fuel cells (HFCs) is harnessed to serve the onboard thermal load, promoting optimal energy utilization within the vessel. Fur-thermore, an integrated demand response (IDR), encompassing propulsion load and indoor temperature, is flexibly scheduled to maintain comfort ranges and ensure voyage punctuality. Various case studies are conducted to verify the efficiency and efficacy of the proposed method. Simulation results indicate that the proposed method can reduce the operating cost and enhance energy efficiency.

Author Keywords: coordinated voyage scheduling and energy management

articleTitle: Influence of Capacity Configuration on Stability of Hydropower-Photovoltaic Hybrid Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydropower (HP) and photovoltaic (PV) hybrid energy systems could reduce the impact and influence of PV output power randomness and volatility on the power grid. To study the stability of the HP-PV hybrid energy system operating under different scenarios, in this paper, we first establish a mathematical model of the system. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation methods are then adopted to obtain the stability region and stability margin of the system with different PV shares. Besides, the preferred operating range of the HP system is explored. The results show that: (1) the system stability decreases with the increase of the PV share in the hybrid energy system, and the preferred HP operating range shrinks; (2) the basic law in which the PV share and the HP control parameters jointly affect the system stability is revealed. This work provides a theoretical basis for subsequent physical model experiments in the future.

articleTitle: Development Analysis and Prospective Research for New Type Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building New Type Power Systems will reduce China's dependence on foreign oil and gas, and improve the country's energy security guarantee capacity significantly. Five key areas for New Type Power Systems are analyzed and proposed: green and low-carbon, safe and efficient, value empowerment, forward-looking applications, and industrial ecology. Based on the five key areas, taking full account of the progressiveness technology and multidimensional value, a construction effectiveness evaluation index system is constructed, which provides methodological support for evaluating the development of provincial (municipal) New Type Power Systems.

articleTitle: Unified Model of Substation for Dispatching and Centralized Control Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The IEC 61850 model has been widely used in substations nowadays, but it is quite different from the IEC 61970 model, and each one has its own emphasis, resulting in the two model systems being unable to communicate with each other. In this paper, a unified model of substation is constructed based on the analysis of various applications. The modeling idea, model architecture and organization are introduced, the entity model and relation model are introduced in detail, and finally the construction and maintenance process of the model are introduced, and the feasibility of the unified model is verified through practical application.

articleTitle: Coordinated Scheduling of Frequency Regulation Resources Based on the Coordination Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy, the proportion of electricity generation capacity from conventional power generation units is steadily decreasing, resulting in insufficient frequency regulation resources which are usually provided by conventional power units. Therefore, there is a growing need for coordinating multiple types of frequency regulation resources to fulfill the frequency regulation tasks. However, the reliability of load side frequency regulation resources is limited, so it is necessary to coordinate the proportion of load side resources and traditional resources. Firstly, the concept of coordination coefficients is proposed in this paper, which is used to limit the proportion of resources on load side to the whole frequency regulation resources. Secondly, a two-layer optimization model of day-ahead market clearing based on coordination coefficients is established. The upper layer takes the balance of resource unit income between the generation side and the load side as the optimization objective, and the lower layer takes the lowest market clearing cost as the optimization objective, to optimize the coordination coefficients of long-term operation income balance. Finally, through the simulation of the IEEE system example in Matlab, it is verified that when the coordination coefficient is 0.13, the resource of the generation side and load side can achieve the unit income balance while ensuring the minimum cost of resource scheduling.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Regulation Strategy for 5G Base Stations Considering Power Supply Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of 5G has greatly increased the total energy storage capacity of base stations. How to fully utilize the often dormant base station energy storage resources so that they can actively participate in the electricity market is an urgent research question. This paper develops a simulation system designed to effectively manage unused energy storage resources of 5G base stations and participate in the electric energy market. This paper proposes an analysis method for energy storage dispatchable power that considers power supply reliability, and establishes a dispatching model for 5G base station energy storage to participate in the electric energy market. Experimental results show that the energy storage regulation strategy proposed in this article can reduce base station operating costs to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Path Transmission in Direct Drive Grid Connected System Under Transient Fault Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response to the issue of unclear oscillation transmission paths in direct drive wind power grid connected systems during fault transients, this paper describes the energy transmission paths under oscillation in grid connected systems based on transient energy flow analysis methods. Based on the positive and negative damping properties, the key links affecting the grid connected system during oscillation divergence are identified. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis results is verified by building a direct drive wind power grid connected system model on the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform, The analysis results indicate that the key factors affecting the stability of the grid connected system during oscillation divergence are the current loop integration and decoupling current links.

articleTitle: A Novel High-Gain Converter Based on Three-Winding Coupled Inductor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel single-switch converter that incorporates a three-winding coupled inductor, integrating the switched capacitor and the three-winding coupled inductor (TWCI) into a new boost unit to enhance its voltage gain. At the same time, a passive clamp circuit is utilized by the converter to reclaim energy from the leakage inductor and alleviate voltage stress on power switch S. Consequently, a power switch S featuring low forward voltage and reduced on-resistance may be chosen to minimize switching conduction loss in the converter. In addition, the proposed converter achieves high voltage gain under low turns ratio and low duty cycle conditions. Furthermore, it utilizes only one switch, resulting in a simple control scheme for the circuit. The principle of operation and steady state analysis of the proposed converter is described in detail and the design principles of the device are given. The relevant performance of the proposed converter is verified through simulation and the simulation results are given.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Park Integrated Energy System Considering Time-of-Use Price Incentives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To more fully harness user-side demand response and obtain a rational equilibrium solution for multi-objective optimization., this paper proposes a multi-objective optimization method for park-level integrated energy system that considers time-of-use price incentives. Firstly., a demand response model under time-of-use price is established based on the traditional fixed-price demand response model. Then., to further exploit the potential of the user side., a multi-objective optimization model is developed that considers the variance of load curves on the user side in addition to the system-side optimization objectives of operating cost and carbon emission. Secondly., based on non-cooperative game theory., these three optimization objectives are treated as virtual players in a non-cooperative game model. The model is linearized., further reconstructed into a global optimization model., and thus., facilitates obtaining a global optimal solution. Finally., the results of case analysis demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve rational equilibrium solutions and fully leverage the potential of the user side.

articleTitle: Resonance Participation Factor Evaluation for Renewable Energy Systems Based on Impedance Scanning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the access of grid-connected renewable energy systems, the problem of system harmonic stability analysis is becoming more and more prominent. This paper investigates the grid-connected system participation calculation method, which performs impedance scanning on the basis of the electromagnetic transient simulation model of the grid-connected system, and obtains more accurate impedance characteristics of the grid-connected system, so the results of the system resonance analysis are more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Energy Services Evaluation System for the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an evaluation method of integrated energy service business development level for new power systems. Firstly, On the basis of analyzing the evaluation ideas of integrated energy service under the background of new power system, the evaluation index system is proposed from three dimensions: grid support level, economic benefit level and service friendliness level. Secondly, the corresponding evaluation method is proposed by using fuzzy principle. Finally, six typical integrated energy services such as integrated energy station, distributed photovoltaic, user-side energy storage, power trading agent service, comprehensive energy efficiency improvement service and electric vehicle charging service are selected for case verification. The proposed method can evaluate the development level of various subdivisions of integrated energy services under the consideration of the supporting role of the new power system, the characteristics of power enterprises, economic benefits and user experience, and provide a theoretical and practical basis for decision-making of integrated energy services under the new power system.

articleTitle: CamDetector: Detecting and Positioning Hidden Cameras with Raspberry Pi 4 via EM Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The illicit use of spy cameras poses a significant threat to scenarios where privacy is paramount, such as in hotel rooms and home rentals. Owing to advancements in miniaturization and camouflage techniques, these covert cameras have become increasingly difficult for victims to detect in their surroundings. In this paper, we introduce a proof-of-concept system called CamDetector, designed to identify spy cameras based on their electromagnetic (EM) radiations. Our initial step involves characterizing the EM radiation emitted by cameras. We then uncover the shared pattern stemming from the signal coupling on the CSI cable, which can be used to detect hidden cameras. We use USRP B200 mini and Raspberry Pi 4 to build the prototype and proceed to assess the performance on 6 commercially available small cameras. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CamDetectorwith an average accuracy of 90.08% and a recall of 88.21% at a distance of 0.4m. Moreover, our evaluation based on user involvement confirmed that CamDetector can achieve 85% accuracy in an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$18 m^{2}$</tex> room, with an average time of 16.9 minutes.

articleTitle: Dynamic Clustering and Operation Evaluation of Renewable Energy Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the difference of dynamic characteristics about doubly-fed wind turbines and the complexity of equivalence problems, a multi-machine dynamic equivalence model for wind farms based on improved K-means algorithm is proposed. Considering the input wind speed and the different state parameters of the units, several indexes are selected to dynamically group the units in the wind farm. Based on the clustering results, the proposed wind farm's equivalent model is established in MATLAB/Simulink. According to the simulation results, the multi-machine equivalent model has higher accuracy and better application effect than the single-machine equivalent model, which can more effectively depict the grid-connected characteristics and operational state of doubly-fed wind farms.

articleTitle: Incremental Learning Based on V-I Trajectory Feature for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) implements energy decomposition in a non-intrusive manner and provides a promising path to tap demand response potential for flexible load resources in residential and commercial buildings.
