Modern deep neural networks (DNNs) have succeeded in NILM fields, especially under offline settings where the task for a network is fixed and all training data are provided simultaneously. However, these algorithms face an inevitable challenge. When new or unknown appliances are added, the learning algorithms mentioned above exhibit a pronounced susceptibility to catas-trophic forgetting as they undertake the incremental acquisition of knowledge associated with these new appliance classes. To tackle this challenge, a novel incremental learning method is proposed in this paper. An effective linear model is introduced to correct the strong deviation when learning unknown appliance class. Numerical results on the PLAID public datasets illustrate the effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Impact for Mechanical Performance of Submarine Cable During the Rock-Dumping Deburial When Repaired
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Rock-dumping is a quite effective method of submarine cables protecting, but in the case of fault repair, the deburial of this dam is a challenge, requiring large flow of excavation equipment and ensuring that the cleaning process does not cause secondary damage to submarine cable. A load model was established for the cleaning process of the rock-dumping. The external load during the cleaning process was applied to the cable model, and the force on the cable under the external load was analyzed. Through numerical simulation, the dynamic cleaning process of the riprap dam model was simulated, and the stress-strain situation of the submarine cable during the cleaning process was studied. After simulation, it was found that while cleaning, maintaining a jet velocity of 30m/s, the stress on the submarine cable did not reach the yield stress, which can ensure safety; At a jet velocity of 40m/s, the yield stress can be reached within 10ms; At jet speeds of 70m/s and 100m/s, submarine cables will quickly reach yield stress and be damaged. Therefore, when using the jet method to clean the riprap dam, the jet velocity should be kept within 30m/s. At the same time, an analysis was conducted on the splashing and falling of stones caused by the jet. During this process, the maximum stress caused by the stones on the submarine cable was 0.9Mpa, which is much smaller than the yield stress, and the cable will not be damaged.

articleTitle: Recognition and Grasping Technology of High-Voltage Transmission Lines Based on the Humanoid Robot Arm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The practical method and device of hanging ground lines have always been a research hotspot for electric power workers. Based on the actual background, this paper studies the recognition and grasping technology of high-voltage transmission lines based on the humanoid robot arm. Aiming at the common split wire structure of high-voltage transmission lines, the traditional YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm is optimized, the visual control system of the robot arm is developed, and the control strategy of nearest grasp is proposed. A preliminary experimental platform was built to verify the feasibility of the robot arm control algorithm.

articleTitle: A Carbon Emission Flow Model for the Distribution System Considering Network Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The further promotion of carbon peak and carbon neutrality targets puts forward higher requirements for the measurement of electricity consumption for power consumers, but traditional carbon emission measurement method can not realize the real-time and accurate measurement of electric power carbon emission of power consumers in the distribution system, which is not conducive to release carbon reduction potential and promote the low-carbon transformation of energy system. To solve this problem, a carbon emission flow(CEF) calculation model in the distribution system considering network characteristics is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the CEF of distribution system is established considering the distributed renewable energy integration and the radial topology. On this basis, a calculation method of CEF of active distribution network in a backward/forward framework is proposed. Finally, an improved IEEE 33-bus system is adopted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Sequential Coordination Method of Multiple HVDC Commutation Failures Based on Voltage Stiffness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In a multi-infeed LCC-HVDC power system, simultaneous recovery of multiple LCC-HVDCs from commutation failures will absorb a large amount of reactive power at the same time, which is not conducive to the voltage stability of the receiving end grid. For this reason, staggered recovery of multiple LCC-HVDe commutation failures is an economical and effective means to improve the voltage stability of the receiving-end grid. First, the system model of the multi-infeed power system is introduced, and the voltage stability constraints are deduced based on the voltage stiffness. Then, the sequential coordination method of multiple HVDC systems is proposed. Finally, the modified IEEE 39-bus system is tested to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Security Region-Based Economic Dispatch of Distribution Grids with Multiple Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As virtual power plants (VPPs) integrate a high penetration of renewable distributed generations, the intermittent and uncertain outputs make the power flow-coupling relationship between virtual power plants and the distribution grid complex. Without the guidance mechanism for energy resource coordination, the return of the power market might be less, and the problem of power flow violation might occur. Therefore, coordinated plans are required for the entire grid. Solving the existing nonlinear coordinated model takes a long time, so this paper establishes a linear coordination method based on the static security region (SSR). First, based on the grid topology, a generation method is proposed for hyperplane expressions of the distribution grid SSR. Second, based on the SSR, this paper established an optimization model to minimize the overall operating cost of the distribution grid with multiple VPPs. Third, based on the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, the amount and price of electricity transacted are scheduled, and a coordinated strategy is derived for the distribution grid and VPPs. A modified IEEE-33 node grid with three VPPs is used for the simulation, and the results indicate that the proposed method significantly accelerates the calculation speed by orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Classification of Electric Power Equipment Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the size of power facilities grows and expands, op-erational monitoring is an important part of system management, and a key step in power system operational monitoring is the prediction of equipment defects. Power equipment defects refer to abnormalities or hidden dangers that occur during the use of the equipment, and these hidden dangers may cause the power system to malfunction. To solve this problem, artificial intelligence technology is combined and taken to the field of knowledge graph, through knowledge fusion, using the relationship-aware graph neural network to get the representation of entities and relationships. A series of data collected on power equipment defects are input into the jieba participle tool for processing, and then the pre-processed data are subjected to entity recognition and relationship extraction, etc. Subsequently, knowledge fusion is realised by means of pairing entities and stored in the Neo4j graph database to construct a knowledge graph oriented to the grading of power equipment defects for better knowledge querying and assisted decision making.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Steady State Voltage Control and Transient Voltage Prevention Considering STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization method and a reactive power substitution strategy for steady state voltage control and transient voltage prevention with STATCOM participation. In the first stage, STATCOM and generators are jointly included in the automatic voltage control (AVC) mathematical model to take advantage of the fast response capability of STATCOM. In the second stage, the transient voltage safety index (TVSI) is introduced, and the trajectory sensitivity of the TVSI to STATCOM reactive power reserve is analyzed on the basis of the system state, and the optimal reference value of STATCOM output is determined by maximizing the TVSI. In the third stage, through the reactive power substitution between generators and STATCOM, the reactive power output values of STATCOM are controlled to the reference value obtained in the second stage. For the voltage control and safety assessment problems, a continuous three-stage framework with different objective dimensions is constructed, and the optimization method is tested in the IEEE 39-nodes system in Simulink.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis and Simulation of Quad Flat No-Leads Packaging on Printed Circuit Board with ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern electrical and electronic technology, there is a growing challenge for traditional quad flat no-leads (QFN) packaging to meet the demands of high voltage and current in power systems. QFN packaging has gained popularity as a preferred choice for microelectronic devices due to its high integration and excellent thermal performance. Notwithstanding its advantages, QFN packaging is susceptible to significant power loss, inducing substantial heat during operation that may result in chip damage and eventual device functional failure. Therefore, maintaining temperature stability within QFN packaging is pivotal. This article proposes a thermal resistance network model that analyzes the heat dissipation path from the QFN packaging to the surrounding environment. The commercial simulation software ANSYS serves as a valuable reference for evaluating the thermal performance of QFN packaging. The obtained data results demonstrate the effectiveness of the simulation in efficiently and accurately calculating the temperature distribution of QFN packaging. The proposed analysis model can provide valuable guidance for optimizing the layout design and material selection of QFN packaging.

articleTitle: Research on cooperative control of distributed microgrid groups based on improved lookahead algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Scale distributed power single machine into the network makes the power system inertia weakening, the frequency problem is more and more serious, in order to improve the reliability of the distribution network, can support each other distributed multi-area microgrid group came into being. However, the topology and operating environment of the microgrid cluster are more complex, in order to realize the problem of multi-region cooperative control of microgrid cluster, this paper proposes a novel control algorithm, i.e., the improved lookahead algorithm. Compared with the traditional reinforcement learning, the maximum expectation estimation represented by Q-learning overuses the greedy strategy, which in turn results in the overestimation of the action value; while the dual estimation method represented by DQ-learning uses too conservative a strategy and always abandons the greedy strategy in strategy selection, resulting in the underestimation of the action value in the process of strategy exploration. The interleaved Q-learning (IQ) algorithm uses the coupled estimation method to avoid the overestimation problem arising from the maximum estimator (ME) and the underestimation problem arising from the double estimator (DE). In this paper, based on Q-learning, interleaved Q-learning (IQ) is integrated into the lookaheadQ algorithm to design an improved lookahead algorithm, and at the same time, the qualification traces are integrated into the improved lookahead algorithm for algorithmic backtracking to obtain the maximum return in the past and the future.

articleTitle: Design of Capacity Market Mechanism under High Proportion of New Energy Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the electricity market and the increase of the installed proportion of new energy sources in China, higher requirements are put forward to meet the flexibility and stability of power system operation. It is urgent to establish a capacity market to handle supply availability. This paper studies the capacity market construction path under the current power system mechanism in China. Through the reasonable mechanism and the transition way to construct the capacity market, the price fluctuation caused by introducing the capacity market in the electricity markets is reduced.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Planning Contributed by Energy Storage Under Uncertainty of Renewables and Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reactive planning of the power system aims to optimize the location and capacity of the reactive power sources to minimize the economic cost of the system while improving the voltage security of the system using the optimization theory. However, the randomness of renewable sources and the variety of loads challenge the system by introducing uncertainty to the system. Therefore, a multi-scenario based reactive planning method is proposed in this paper by combining the typical scenario generation technique and the coordinated dispatch model of active-reactive power, which can be modelled as a second-order cone programming problem. Finally, this reactive planning model is validated in an IEEE-14 system.

articleTitle: A Electricity Price Prediction Method Based on Improved Long Short Term Memory for High Proportion New Energy Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electricity price of electricity market with high proportion of new energy has great volatility, but the prediction effect of traditional deep learning model is not good. This paper proposes a price forecasting method using ATT (attention mechanism) to improve LSTM (long short term memory) and DBO (dung bee optimizer) to obtain the optimal parameters. Firstly, the attention mechanism is used to improve the extraction ability of the input features that play a key role in the electricity price forecasting. Secondly, the DBO algorithm is used to optimize the model to obtain the optimal parameters. Finally, the optimal parameters ATT-LSTM model is used to obtain the optimal forecasting results. This paper uses the real data of the electricity market with a high proportion of new energy to verify the proposed method. Compared with the LSTM algorithm, the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is improved by 65% under the MAE index, and compared with the single GRU and BP algorithm, the prediction accuracy is improved by 74.9% and 83.1%, respectively, which has high prediction performance.

articleTitle: A Multi-Level Driver for Switching Trace Regulation Method of SiC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SiC MOSFET has small on-resistance, low switching losses, high switching frequency, high withstand voltage values, and excellent reverse recovery characteristics. Excessively fast switching speeds of the SiC devices can lead to severe switching overshoot, oscillations, and crosstalk. These negative effects affect the application prospects of SiC devices. In this paper, a multi-level driver(MLD) for SiC MOSFET and regulation method for switching trace are proposed, which addresses the co-optimization of multiple objectives of the switching trace. It not only ensures switching speed and low switching loss, but also effectively suppresses overshoot and oscillation. The feasibility and effectiveness of the designed multi-level driver are verified using double-pulse test.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization Planning for Shared Energy Storage Systems in Multi-Microgrid Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage plays an important role in integrating renewable energy sources and power systems, thus how to deploy growing shared energy storage systems (SESSs) while meeting the technical requirements of microgrids (MGs) is a challenging problem in distribution networks. This paper proposes a two-level optimal configuration method of multiple microgrids (MMGs) based on SESSs service. First, the SESS service model is proposed, which analyzes the operation mode and profit mechanism for the SESS. Then, the multi-level optimization model is transformed into a single-level linear programming model using Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions. A reformulation and decomposition method based on relaxation techniques is used to solve the model. Finally, numerical tests are implemented to test the reasonability and validity of the proposed planning method under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Accelerated Solution for Electricity and Heat Distributed Dispatch Considering Electric Boiler and Heat Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the electricity-heat integrated dispatch studies, the node method is widely used to model the heat dynamics. However, this representation significantly increases the computation complexity of the resulting dispatch model. To avoid this difficulty, a new representation of the heat dynamics is proposed in this paper. The coordination of electric boiler and heat dynamics is also considered to reveal the full potential of heating network and electric boiler in integrating wind power. In addition, a new distributed algorithm is developed where the standard alternating direction method of multipliers is combined with the heavy sphere method for acceleration. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated on a modified electricity-heat integrated system comprising a six-bus electrical system and a six-node heating system.

articleTitle: Steady-State Security Region for Integrated Electricity and Heating System with An Optimization-Checked-Based Concave Hull Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Steady-state security region (SSR) is a significant tool to facilitate the security issues in integrated electricity and heating systems (IEHS) since the deep coupling between the electric power system (EPS) and district heating system (DHS) increases the risks of cascading failure. However, the nonlinear and nonconvex nature of the SSR remains an obstacle to its efficient solution. This paper first comprehensively models the IEHS considering the dynamics of the coupling units and the DHS. Then, the SSR problem in the IEHS is formulated as two sets of nonlinear and sequential optimization problems to characterize the operational security boundaries. On this basis, a novel optimization-check-based concave hull method (OCCM) is proposed to efficiently and accurately solve the SSR problem. Numerical simulations are performed to verify the superiority of the proposed OCCM. The results highlight the influences of heating system integration on EPS's SSR and the impact of the dynamics on SSR computation.

articleTitle: DC Voltage Control of Multi-terminal MMC-HVDC Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With large-scale of renewable energy and power electronic devices connected to the grid, modular multilevel converter based high voltage DC (MMC-HVDC) systems exhibit low inertia and low damping characteristics. The virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control provides virtual inertia to the system and simultaneously improves its capability to damp oscillations by mimicking the mechanical characteristics of a synchronous generator (SG). To achieve stable control of DC voltage while providing AC frequency support, a DC voltage control method of multi-terminal MMC-HVDC based on VSG is proposed. The active power reference is provided to the active power-frequency regulator of VSG through an external DC voltage control loop, which greatly improves DC voltage stability and power-balancing performance of the system. The methods of PQ control and VSG control with and without DC voltage controller are applied to a four-terminal MMC-HVDC system respectively for simulation and the control performances are compared. Results show that the proposed DC voltage control method based on VSG can effectively balance the AC and DC side performances of the system.

articleTitle: A Switched-Capacitor Based Single-Stage Multi-Port DC Collector for Wave Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wave energy is a typical renewable energy, transferred into electric energy by permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), and integrated in DC form. Thus, this paper proposes a switched-capacitor based single-stage multi-port DC collector for wave energy. A single-stage step down converter based on switched-capacitor is proposed as submodule, by integrating and simplifying the traditional two-stage converter by buck converter and switched-capacitor converter. The large electrolytic capacitor for DC voltage is eliminated, and the interleaving buck converter is employed to achieve a high voltage gain and high power delivery, due to the complementary conduction in series switches in switched-capacitor converter. Moreover, the high voltage ports of submodules are series to achieve a higher DC voltage, and the low voltage ports are distributed for multiple generators. The operation frequencies for switched-capacitor and buck modules are independent to achieve a wide voltage range. Then, the characteristics of proposed multiport collector are discussed, such as voltage gain, power delivery, voltage stress. Finally, the stable operation and comparison results are discussed to verify the correct and effect of proposed multi-port DC collector.

articleTitle: Virtual Fault Resistance-Based High Impedance Fault Section Location for Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate identification and location of high impedance fault (HIF) in medium voltage distribution network is one of the technical problems in the industry. In this paper, a HIF location method based on virtual fault resistance is proposed. Firstly, the phase voltage and phase current phasors of the first cycle wave after the fault are obtained by Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) algorithm, and then the virtual fault resistance values of each phase are calculated. Then, the fault is located according to whether the Coefficient of Variation of each section exceeds the threshold. The proposed method is still applicable after distributed generators (DGs) access, and is not affected by the operation mode. It can identify HIF in both effective grounding and non-effective grounding of neutral points. A simulation model is built in PSCAD to verify the effectiveness of the proposed HIF section location method.

articleTitle: Improved Self-Synchronization Technology Using in Current Differential Protection of Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the time when the device detects the fault, the fault self-synchronization method can realize the data synchronization of current differential protection (CDP) of distribution network at a lower cost, but its synchronization accuracy is affected by the sensitivity of the fault detection algorithm. Therefore, an improved self-synchronization timing technique based on wavelet transform is proposed in this paper. The mutation signal is decomposed by wavelet multi-resolution analysis. The mutation point is determined by the decomposed signal. The simulation results show that wavelet transform is a powerful tool for current signal mutation detection, and this method is not affected by the neutral point grounding mode, fault type, fault initial phase angle and feeder type, and has high synchronization accuracy when the capacity of the distributed power supply at the end of the feeder, the T-connected load and the T-connected distributed power supply change.

articleTitle: Demand-Responsive Data Center Energy Supply Optimized Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing in recent years, data centers have become the mainstay that can support large-scale virtual computing of computers. Therefore, reducing energy consumption and carbon emissions of data centers has attracted extensive attention from academia and industry. Reduce server power consumption according to data center energy consumption characteristics. Reducing CPU utilization in the server can be achieved by scheduling the workload, so the workload approach used in this article is to change the load completion time. In contains in the energy management of energy storage devices and photovoltaic power generation system, the time-sharing electricity environment, using the workload in the scheduling server scheduling factors, and increase the constraint conditions and intermediate variables, the minimum purchase electricity as the goal, the establishment and refrigeration equipment and mid-cooling power load data center under the management environment of collaborative optimization scheduling model, and USES the branch and bound method to solve. Through the example analysis, the basic data of typical days in four seasons are collected to get the optimization results of the whole year. According to the calculation, the electricity price of the data center in the whole year has been reduced by 361,570 yuan, and the cost has been reduced by about 0.58%. This model, through collaborative optimization of renewable energy and technical means, has increased the economic benefits of the data center and better fits the concept of “green data center”.

articleTitle: Determination of Safe Inspection Range of Transmission Line UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been widely employed for transmission line inspection, significantly enhancing the operational efficiency of power transmission. During inspections, UAVs are susceptible to interference from power frequency electric fields. To mitigate the electromagnetic interference caused by the power frequency electric fields, a 500 kV double-circuit overhead transmission line simulation model was constructed. Utilizing the method of controlling variables, the distribution patterns of electric fields under different directions of the same phase and different phases in the same direction were analyzed. This analysis helped determine the safe operational range for UAVs in proximity to transmission towers. Based on this range, the transmission tower model was simplified to establish waypoints for the UAVs, thereby improving the efficiency and safety of the UAV inspection process.

articleTitle: Exploring Adversarial Robustness of LiDAR-Camera Fusion Model in Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we assess the adversarial robustness of LiDAR-camera fusion models in 3D object detection. We intro-duce an attack technique that, by simply adding a limited number of physically constrained adversarial points above a car, can make the car undetectable by the fusion model. Experimental results reveal that even without changes to the image data channel-and solely by manipulating the LiDAR data channel-the fusion model can be deceived. This finding raises safety concerns in the field of autonomous driving. Further, we explore how the number of adversarial points, the distance between the front-near car and the LiDAR-equipped car, and various angular factors affect the attack success rate. We believe our research can contribute to the understanding of multi-sensor robustness, offering insights and guidance to enhance the safety of autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Transferred DC Interruption Topology Based on Fuse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC circuit breaker is the key point for AC/DC networking. However, the topologies of DC circuit breaker in distribution adopting the scheme of HVDC transmission are no longer applicable when considering the investment and cost in DC distribution. Which means that it is important to balance the cost and performance of medium-voltage DC distribution circuit breakers by developing economical DC breaking technology. Aiming at the key point of economical and efficient interruption of DC side fault in AC/DC hybrid distribution, this paper proposes a transferred DC interruption topology based on DC fusing and transferred interruption technology. This topology is formed of DC fuse connected in parallel with transfer switch. As the low-cost DC current-limiting fuse is used to break the short-circuit current, thus reducing the cost of the DC switchgear, and realizing the balance in breaking and economy. The results of simulation calculation show that the proposed transferred DC interruption topology can interrupt 20kA short circuit current and meet the requirements of DC side faults' isolation in AC/DC hybrid distribution.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Linear Robust Optimal Power Flow Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distribution network has numerous devices, as well as random input and output of loads, and power supplies. Its precise physical model is difficult to obtain. Exploring a data-driven robust power flow model that does not rely on precise parameters is necessary. This paper proposes a data-driven linear robust optimal power flow model. The branch power flow and square of node voltage amplitude are modeled as linear regression models, and model errors are introduced into the linear power flow model as uncertainty variables. Kernel density estimation is used to obtain the uncertainty set of model errors at confidence level α, This model does not require any network parameters and fully considers model uncertainty, effectively improving the security of power system operation under data-driven models.

articleTitle: Lithium-ion Battery Degradation Curve Prediction Based on Multipartite Gaussian Process Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries provide energy for electric vehicles and have been widely used in engineering applications. To ensure the efficiency and stable operation of the system, and to prolong the battery life, it is crucial to predict the battery's future degradation curve. Moreover, applications like battery delivery tests in manufacturing require quick and less computing-intensive methods to predict the degradation curve using easy-to-access historical data. In this paper, a multipartite Gaussian process regression (GPR) framework is proposed to achieve the early prediction of the battery state of health <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$({\text{SOH}})$</tex> degradation curve at an early stage of the aging process. By setting multiple prediction starting points, our method divides the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SOH}$</tex> aging curve into different segments and updates the GPR model for future curve prediction, utilizing both the early aging data and the as-predicted data. The results of contrastive analysis on segment point setting highlight the significance of thoughtfully and strategically constructing segment rules for battery degradation curve prediction. The experiments conducted on the NASA dataset illustrate that our proposed method outperforms other data-driven methods in terms of prediction accuracy, with MAPE, RMSE, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mathrm{R}}^2$</tex> averagely to be <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.3825{{\% }},1.3363{{\% }}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$93.249{{\% }}$</tex>, respectively.

articleTitle: A Semantic Understanding Method for Patent Text Based on Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large language model has powerful natural language understanding and generation capabilities, which can automatically extract keywords and key information from literature, thus achieving fast and efficient patent retrieval. At the same time, the large model can also be customized according to user needs, improving retrieval accuracy and efficiency. A semantic understanding method for patent text based on large language model is proposed in this paper. This method first requires preprocessing of the dataset, inputting the problem into ChatGPT according to the specified instruction format, and then classifying the output content for analysis based on different classifications. Then, the entity recognition results are input into the patent system, and the knowledge graph in the patent system is used for inference analysis to obtain the corresponding answer to the problem. The research results show that the method based on the large language model has high accuracy and generalization ability, and can achieve semantic understanding and analysis of patent texts.

articleTitle: Levelized Cost of Energy Modeling of Wind Farms Based on Wind Turbine Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The aim of this study is to develop a wind farm levelized cost model based on the reliability of wind turbines in order to investigate the relationship between reliability and cost of wind power generation systems in real operations. The reliability of wind farms is crucial for the stability and sustainability of energy production. By employing reliability engineering and wind farm operational data, this study constructs a model that can assess the probability of failure and repair time of wind turbines under various environmental conditions, as well as the maintenance costs associated with reliability, while taking into account the fluctuations in electricity production and market prices of wind farms, in order to more comprehensively assess the levelized cost and optimize the maintenance schedules, resource allocations, and design of the wind farms to maximize improve reliability while reducing costs..

articleTitle: A Collaborative Control Method of Air Conditioner Groups Considering Rebound Reward and Punishment under Multi-Market Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As high-quality demand response resources, air conditioner groups play an important role in balancing the system active power, which can reduce the burden of peak-load time quickly. Certainly, the peak regulation optimization of air conditioners faces dual constraints from both carbon market and electricity market. In this paper, a two-stage cooperative control model of air conditioner groups under multiple market mechanism is proposed, involving the peak regulation and rebound optimization periods. A rebound reward and punishments calculation method of air conditioner groups is also designed. Considering optimization temperature range, optimization duration, single-period maximum carbon emission and maximum carbon emission, a cooperative control model of air conditioner groups with the goal of maximizing income is presented. Finally, the results show that the proposed approach is practical and useful for air conditioner groups in the electricity and carbon markets.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Dispatch of Wind Farms for Short-Term Power Overproduction Capability Maximizing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, wind farms are required to regulate their output powers in accordance with the dispatch instructions from the transmission system operators (TSOs) at normal and provide short-term power overproduction (S-TPO) to take part in the inertial support in case of emergency supply shortage. The S-TPO capability of the wind farm is affected by the power dispatch strategy inside the wind farm. This paper proposes an optimal power dispatch model of wind farms for S-TPO capability maximizing considering the wind turbine generation (WTG) capacity and rotor speed security. The nonlinear rotor speed security constraints are converted into linear constraints by a piecewise linearization method, and the dispatch model is finally transformed to a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem which is easy to solve by existing solvers. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified in a wind farm with 50 WTGs in northern China. The results suggest that the proposed dispatch method can increase the S-TPO capability of the wind farm by 6.67% compared to the existing method.

articleTitle: Urban Electricity Consumption Forecasts Under Abnormal Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the complexity and uncertainty of the power system, the scheduling and planning of the power grid has brought corresponding difficulties. In this paper, a long-term electricity consumption prediction model is developed for use under abnormal operating conditions. The fractional-order grey prediction model captures the shortfall of electricity consumption after the occurrence of abnormal working conditions, the restriction vector autoregressive model is used to achieve the prediction of electricity consumption, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the model to improve the prediction accuracy of the model. The results of the three prediction models are compared to verify the effectiveness of the model. The experimental results show that the model shows good performance in electricity consumption prediction and makes better use of all data information.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Method Based on VMD and Rank Set Pair Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The short-term load forecasting of power system is crucial for the safety, economy, stability, and reliability of power system operations. In this regard, this paper proposes a short-term load forecasting model based on variational mode decomposition (VMD) and rank set pair analysis (R-SPA). Initially, the load original sequence is decomposed into low-frequency components containing the main features, mid-frequency components containing detailed features and random components containing stochastic features of the original load by using VMD. Subsequently, the R-SP A model with different set capacities is employed to predict each component, followed by the reconstruction to obtain the final prediction value. Finally, the short-term load forecasting is accomplished through a rolling prediction approach. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed forecasting model has superior predictive performance.

articleTitle: User Adjustable Load Potential Analysis Method Based on Two-Level Clustering and SA-TCN Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of the steady development of the new power system and the continuous construction of the “double carbon” target, the application scenarios of power load forecasting are also showing an increasingly complex and diversified trend. Accurate power load forecasting response plays an important role in the safety, stability and economy of power system operation. Therefore, this paper proposes an adjustable potential analysis method based on SA-TCN (Self-Attention Temporal Convolutional Network). Firstly, based on the performance requirements of adjustable load proposed by power system supply and demand balance, the index system of adjustable load characteristics is constructed. Secondly, based on the Canopy and Kmeans two-level clustering method, the user data are classified according to the daily load rate and daily peak-valley difference rate, and the SA-TCN prediction model is used to predict the user's load. Finally, based on the historical load data of industrial users in a typical area and the index system of adjustable load characteristics, the advantages of the proposed model (SA-TCN) in the stability of prediction accuracy are verified by an example analysis, and the adjustable potential of load is analyzed from multiple perspectives.

articleTitle: Practice and Analysis of Electromagnetic Interference Influence of Relay Protection Devices Under Thermal Stress
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The relay protection devices are a critical element of the power system and is regularly subjected to high temperatures, high humidity, salt spray and electromagnetic interference. Such environmental stresses have the potential to substantially lower the reliability of the relay protection devices. Literature at this stage focuses on the impact of a single thermal stress or electromagnetic interference on relay protection devices, but the substation site environment is complex and the result of multiple external stresses. Therefore, two major factors, thermal stress and electromagnetic interference, are the focus of this paper. Firstly, the influence of electromagnetic interference and thermal stress on protection devices is studied; then, practical experiments are conducted to test the influence of interference differences between room temperature and high temperature; finally, the time domain changes of electromagnetic transmission characteristics when thermal stress is superimposed are analyzed. It is discovered that the equipment is vulnerable to environmental stresses specifically between 1MHz and 10MHz. Additionally, thermal stress can cause the electromagnetic interference frequency range to shift towards higher frequencies.

articleTitle: Differential Protection Method for Active Distribution Network Based on Frechet Distance Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of a large number of distributed generation (DG) changes the structure and fault characteristics, and the traditional protection methods face many challenges. Therefore, this article proposes a current differential protection method (CDP) that compares the waveform differences between the two ends of the line. When a fault occurs, the current waveforms at both ends of each line are extracted and normalized. Then the frechet distance algorithm is introduced to quantify the waveform similarity. Finally, based on the calculation results of the frechet distance, the braking coefficient of the CDP is constructed to achieve reliable discrimination of faulty line. A simulation model is built in PSCAD to verify the proposed method. The simulation results show that the proposed method is not affected by the fault type and the grid-connected capacity of DG, and can correctly identify faults with good reliability and selectivity.

articleTitle: A Privacy-Preserving Combined Heat and Power State Estimation Method Based on Physics-Informed Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: State estimation provides a data foundation for the integrated energy management system and is the key to ensuring the safe and efficient operation of the system. The measurement frequency and accuracy on the power system side is usually higher for combined heat and power system. It is meaningful to leverage the boundary measurement further to improve state estimation accuracy on the heating network side. In this paper, we additionally combine federated learning and the Paillier cryptosystem to achieve the combined estimation with data remaining local. The proposed method demonstrates improved accuracy in the heating network state estimation through case studies while preserving privacy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Contact Terminal Temperature of Vacuum Circuit Breaker under Complex and Unknown Boundary Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The monitoring of contact terminal temperature of vacuum circuit breakers is of great significance for fault prediction, life assessment, and structural improvement of circuit breakers. This article proposes a prediction method for steady-state temperature of vacuum circuit breaker's contact based on RBF neural network. Firstly, a finite element simulation model based on the actual characteristics of ZKTD 2S00/36-31.5kV vacuum circuit breakers is built, according to which, 793 electromagnetic and thermal model samples of circuit breakers with different boundary conditions are generated. Then, Random Forest regression, LASSO regression and ReliefF regression are used to rank the importance of temperature measurement points at different locations, based on the ranking results from 3 regression models, 4 optimal temperature measuring points are obtained. While the actual boundary conditions of the vacuum circuit breaker are unknown, the contact terminal temperature is accurately predicted by only using the temperatures of four temperature measuring points and the contact resistance values. Finally, a control experiment was set up to further verify the predictive ability of multiple temperature measuring points for contact terminal temperature under complex and unknown boundary conditions.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Stochastic Correlation Estimator Fault Location Method on Lossy Transmission Lines with Multi Uncertain Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A power transmission system is the backbone of Energy Internet and its importance in maintaining reliability cannot be ignored. The transmission lines are prone to electrical faults hence an intelligent and accurate fault localization method is necessary. One of the major challenges in locating a fault is the uncertainty associated with transmission line parameters. Recently, stochastic correlation estimator method has been reported to tackle the parameter uncertainty in univariate model of transmission system. However, this method has never been applied to a multivariate problem yet. This paper proposes a stochastic correlation estimator based fault location method for lossy transmission lines with multiple uncertain parameters. Simulation was carried out on a single conductor overhead 50 km transmission line with height and ground resistivity as random parameters. The results show that the actual fault position is within an estimated confidence fault interval even for multivariate uncertainty problem.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Fault Recovery Strategy Considering Hierarchical Division and Convergence of Islands
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the severe consequences after multi-point faults in distribution grids caused by frequent occurrence of extreme disasters, Utilizing the advantages of closed-loop design of distribution networks, a fault recovery strategy for distribution networks considering islanding hierarchical division and fusion is proposed. Firstly, we consider the influence of contact switches in the traditional islanding model and propose an islanding hierarchical classification method, which is solved by using a breadth-first algorithm and a hybrid particle swarm algorithm to obtain an islanding scheme; secondly, we establish an islanding fusion model, and the islanding fusion model is transformed into a mixed-integer second-order conic planning model by means of a relaxation of nonlinear constraints, and then solved; finally, the proposed method is validated through the simulation of the improved PG&E69 node distribution system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the improved PG&E69 node distribution system simulation. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation of the improved PG&E69 distribution system. The case study shows that the proposed distribution network fault restoration strategy can increase the amount of important loads to be restored and expand the scope of load restoration.

articleTitle: Multi-type Energy Storage System Operation Strategy Based on Grouping State of Charge Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy power output exhibits randomness and uncertainty. Energy storage systems (ESS) has been proved to be an effective means of mitigating the variability of renewable energy power output. Nevertheless, due to the limitation of ESS's cycling life, it needs to construct a rational operation strategy to enhance its efficiency. In this paper, a multitype energy storage system (MESS) composed of lithium-ion battery (LIB) and vanadium redox flow battery (VRB) is used to assist the photovoltaic (PV) in tracking the power scheduling, and the MESS operation strategy considering the VRB grouping state of charge (SOC) regulation is proposed. Firstly, the power allocation limits for MESS and the VRB grouping methodology are established using the allowable deviation ranges of PV's scheduled power. Secondly, the influence of VRB on the cycling life of LIB is considered in order to develop a strategy for VRB grouping SOC recovery and establish appropriate charging and discharging thresholds for VRB. Thirdly, a model for the operation of PV and energy storage system is established, and PV power tracking schedule and the cycling life of MESS are considered in this model. Finally, the proposed model is finally subjected to simulation using real PV data. The results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: LSTM-AdaBoost Electricity Sales Forecasting Model Based on One-Dimensional Time Series Input
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of power system, the research of artificial intelligence method for short-term electricity sales prediction has made remarkable achievements. As long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network can fit the time series and nonlinear characteristics of electricity sales data, the short-term electricity sales prediction based on LSTM has a remarkable effect. However, in the case of one-dimensional input, LSTM prediction method has some problems such as insufficient prediction accuracy. Therefore, adaptive boosting (AdaBoost) ensemble learning method is used to train several LSTM strong prediction models, and a short-term electricity sales prediction method based on LSTM-AdaBoost is proposed, and a case is analyzed. By comparing with a single LSTM and other single and integrated models, the results show that LSTM-AdaBoost has lower prediction error and higher prediction accuracy. This method has certain application value for the intelligent development of power system.

articleTitle: Condenser Configuration Method for Receiving-End Power Systems Considering Security and Stability Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The condenser can provide inertia and voltage support for the power system, which helps to solve the problems of consuming large-scale DC power. To guarantee the stable operation of the power system and minimize investment costs, a condenser configuration method for receiving-end power systems is proposed in this paper. Firstly, various security and stability constraints are derived, including short-circuit current constraint, voltage stability constraint and inertia constraint. Then, considering the security and stability constraints, the optimal condenser configuration model is established. Finally, the proposed condenser configuration method is verified in the modified IEEE-39 bus system.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Technology of Secondary System Configuration in Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The generation of SCD files for smart substations is complex, and these processes require manual configuration, which can easily lead to errors due to human factors. This paper addresses this issue by analyzing the configuration of SCD files, exploring the potential for standardization, and proposing an automatic generation method. The paper introduces the specific technical approach for automatic SCD configuration, covering various aspects such as station framework generation, automatic identification of virtual terminals, standard rule matching, and file verification. The effectiveness of the method is validated through application cases. By automating the configuration process, this method can reduce labor duplication, minimize the configuration error rate, improve configuration efficiency and quality, and ensure the accuracy of virtual circuit connections.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Cooperative Optimization of Wind Farm with Various Reactive Power Compensation Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-wind turbines interconnection is an effective method to solve the uncertainty problem, but at the same time, it also poses a challenge to the coordination of the output of various reactive power compensation devices in each wind farm. This paper presents a coordinated control strategy for multiple reactive power compensation devices in wind farm. Based on the power flow calculation model, the SPEA2 algorithm is used to solve the problem, considering the line loss, voltage drop, reactive power fluctuation and the minimum number of reactive power regulation. The simulation results show that the coordinated control strategy effectively reduces the fluctuation of wind farm and SVG reactive power output curve, and significantly alleviates voltage drop with minimal influence on line loss. In short, the coordinated control strategy of the multi-reactive compensation device optimizes the reactive power output of the system and has important practical significance.

articleTitle: ISSA-SVR Based Power Forecasting for Proxy Power Purchase Customers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the steady progress of the power purchase business of the grid company, the power purchase business system is gradually improved, and the accurate prediction of the power consumption of the proxy power purchase users lays the foundation for the division to guarantee the safe and stable supply of power. Therefore, this paper proposes a power consumption prediction model for agency power purchase users based on ISSA optimized support vector regression (SVR) and differential autoregressive moving average (ARIMA), taking into account the feedback from the prediction result calibration. Firstly, the adaptive weighting factor is introduced to improve the performance of SSA algorithm, and the kernel function coefficient g and penalty coefficient C are solved in the SVR model to establish the ISSA-SVR prediction model; then the residuals of the prediction results are used to establish the ARIMA error prediction model to predict the error of the test set; and finally, the initial prediction results are revised by the error prediction results calibration feedback. The test results show that after the residual correction, the prediction accuracy is significantly improved compared with the traditional prediction model and the ISSA-SVR model without calibration feedback.

articleTitle: Bidding Strategic of Virtual Power Plant Based on End-to-End Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Apply deep reinforcement learning for bidding strategy generation in electricity market, enables the market participant to obtain accurate feedback with the bidding action on the impact of market clearing outcomes, then optimize the action to be more profitable according to the feedback. However, current deep reinforcement learning methods focusing on handcrafted states, such as a fixed number with confidence coefficient of the generation amount, which limited the capability of dealing with virtual power plant bidding with uncertainty renewable energy generation amount. This paper uses the pretext tasks to pre-train the feature extractors, but omits the task headers in bidding task to keep more information, instead of compressing the information to a number. This paper also proposes an end-to-end method, which takes the historical data as the input and outputs the action. Leveraging feature extraction networks to discover the information of uncertainty energy in the end-to-end method, then using the deep reinforcement learning method for bidding action generation. Our method outperforms methods using regression model to predict the generation and put the prediction result to states with an average increasement of 37.57% per day.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Frequency Stability Analysis for Active Power Regulation in Variable Speed Pumped Storage Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Pumped storage technology is crucial for supporting power systems towards de-carbonization and sustainability. Recently, variable-speed pumped storage plants (VSPSPs) have become a new developing direction because of the features of variable-speed units (VSUs) compared to traditional fixed-speed units (FSUs), including rapidity, high efficiency, flexibility, and reliability in operation and regulation. However, the operating stability of VSPSPs during active power regulation needs further investigations, because the VSUs with doubly fed induction machines (DFIMs) are de-coupled with power grids and the robustness of the rotational speed decreases. In this paper, the goal is to study the dynamic stability of VSPSPs in active power regulation, based on MATLAB and Simulink as the main tools. First, a numerical model integrating hydraulic-mechanical-electrical subsystems of VSPSPs with DFIM is adopted by using MATLAB/Simulink, and a thirteenth-order state matrix is established for theoretical eigen-analysis as the core approach. Then, a Chinese VSPSP is adopted as the engineering case. The dynamic stability of the system is studied by state matrix, and the time-domain simulations are conducted for further validation and illustration. The matching mechanism between the controller parameters and the featured parameters in hydraulic designs is discussed. The results show that, even under the grid-connected condition, the VSU could also lose stability during the active power regulation. These results could provide suggestions for the design and controller parameter tuning of VSPSPs for increasing the stability of operation and regulation.

articleTitle: Improved Capacitor Voltage Balancing Control for MMC Considering Voltage Convergence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Capacitor voltage balancing control is one of the important issues for a modular multilevel converter (MMC) to obtain high efficiency and reliability. In high-voltage MMCs using nearest level modulation (NLM) combined with the all-sorting algorithm, frequent and uncertain submodule (SM) switching actions lead to additional switching losses. To reduce the switching frequency of MMC, an improved capacitor voltage balancing method considering voltage convergence is proposed in this paper. The effectiveness of the SM switching is analyzed first. Then, the convergence of the capacitor voltage is predicted by analyzing the change of increment and sequence for capacitor voltage. According to the predicted results, the improved capacitor voltage balancing method is proposed, which can noticeably reduce the switching loss of the converter while not affecting the normal operation of MMCs. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A Benchmark System for the Dynamic Study of New Power Systems with High Penetration of Nonsynchronous Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 7th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy generation and HVDC, high penetration of non-synchronous power sources (NSPS) becomes a mark of the new power system, and the system transient characteristics will no longer be dominated by synchronous generators. This paper establishes a small-scale benchmark system on PSCAD/EMTDC for the purpose of the dynamic characteristics investigating of the new power system. The structure and parameters of the system comes from the simplification of a real world provincial HVDC-HVAC hybrid power system containing various types of converters. Simulations are carried out on the benchmark system with varied penetration level of non-synchronous sources. The evolution of system dynamic behavior and the stability performance are investigated and compared.
